Você deseja trabalhar na startup que se preocupa com a experiência de cada cliente e em como entregar sucesso durante toda a sua jornada conosco?


Se sua resposta é SIM, chegou o seu momento! 😎💻


Bora mudar o mercado odontológico junto com a gente? 🦷🚀🎉


O QUE ESSA PESSOA IRÁ FAZER?

  • Conduzir reuniões de onboarding e setup técnico de produto com IA embarcada, realizando a integração com a API oficial da Meta e plataformas parceiras;
  • Guiar o cliente passo a passo na validação do Gerenciador de Negócios da Meta, verificação do número de WhatsApp e parametrização inicial da IA;
  • Adaptar o ritmo e a linguagem do atendimento ao conhecimento digital de cada consultório odontológico;
  • Interagir com times internos (Suporte, Produto, Desenvolvimento) para destravar pendências de integração ou ajustes na API;
  • Acompanhar cada clínica nos primeiros 30 dias após a implantação, ajustando a configuração até a IA estar agendando consultas, e acompanhar os indicadores de ativação, tempo médio de setup e CSAT da implantação;
  • Manter atualizada a documentação interna de procedimentos de integração e roteiros de solução de problemas;
  • Manter um atendimento humanizado, próximo e alinhado à cultura do Simples Dental.

O QUE DESEJAMOS?

  • Experiência em implantação, onboarding ou Customer Success de software (SaaS);
  • Capacidade demonstrada de conduzir usuários pouco técnicos através de processos de configuração digital;
  • Familiaridade com tecnologia, integrações via Webhooks/APIs e ecossistema SaaS;
  • Domínio do Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Planilhas);
  • Organização, excelente gestão de tempo e priorização.

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Conhecimento em plataformas de mensageria e distribuição de chamados (como Blip, Z-API, Intercom, Zendesk, Umbler);
  • Vivência em CRM (Pipedrive, HubSpot, Salesforce) e automação de fluxos de atendimento;
  • Experiência prévia em operações de onboarding SaaS com volume elevado de implantações;
  • Experiência prática na configuração da API Oficial da Meta (WhatsApp Business Cloud API / Meta Business Manager);
  • Noções sobre funcionamento de ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial ou bots de agendamento;
  • Experiência com trabalho remoto.

Informações adicionais

O QUE OFERECEMOS?

Além de trabalhar na empresa mais legal e carinhosa que você já viu (é o que os nossos colaboradores dizem).

  • Aula de Inglês | Sem custo para a pessoa colaboradora;

  • Reembolso de diária em coworking | Para todos os estados;
  • Licença paternidade e maternidade estendida;
  • Cesta de bebê a bordo para futuros papais e mamães;
  • Convênio com Farmasesi | Somente para SC;
  • Convênio com Educação Sesi | Somente para SC;
  • Day off de aniversário;
  • Notebook e monitor enviados até você;
  • Voucher de R$2000,00 para comprar o restante dos equipamentos que precisar.

Somos uma empresa jovem com muita experiência e muito a aprender. raw.description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Summary of Position

In this role you can shine on the front lines as a trusted advisor for our clients. Acting in a multi-faceted role as coach, analyst, strategic advisor, project manager, and product expert, you’ll focus on helping our clients improve the benefits they reap from working with Teladoc Health products and platforms. You’ll manage your own strategic portfolio of Teladoc Health’s small to medium-sized clients, ensuring they are continually driving value for their business in the form of increased member enrollments, participation, and renewals. Ultimately your efforts will lead to better health for your clients’ members.

As you manage your own client portfolio, you’ll also support the team’s Client Managers with more complex client accounts, and thus gain the experience you need to grow into a management or leadership role in the department. This is your chance for both growth opportunity and personal gratification, as you support a mission that measurably improves people’s lives.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Support a portfolio of Teladoc Health clients, which may include enterprise employers, health plans and providers
  • Work with clients to define and execute a Teladoc Health program strategy, integrated with their broader benefit offerings
  • Work with Teladoc Health Client Executives and clients to define and execute a Teladoc Health program strategy, integrated with their broader benefit offerings
  • Manage client issues and escalations, collaborating with partner teams such as Client Strategy/Launch, Member Support, Operations, Analytics, R&D, and Sales, as required
  • Lead team projects to develop processes, new tools, and intellectual capital that will better support team efforts
  • Support senior team members in cross-functional project efforts and ad hoc reporting
  • Support senior team members in development of client or meeting materials
  • Develop metrics for success/ROI based on each client’s goals and review progress on a regular basis
  • Ensure clients and their members are utilizing key product features to maximize success
  • Identify client challenges and risk areas, develop solutions, and execute proactively to avoid churn

Qualifications Expected for Position

  • 3+ years of experience working in a customer-facing role at a digital health, healthcare, wellness, benefits or SaaS company
  • Strong interpersonal, relationship-building and listening skills, with a natural, effective consultative style
  • A sincere interest in your clients and co-workers
  • The flexibility and agility to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment
  • A strong focus on results, with a passion for finding smarter, better ways to achieve goals
  • Strong problem-solving skills and keen attention to detail
  • High level of productivity, reliability, responsibility, attendance, dependability, organization and accuracy/thoroughness

The base salary range for this position is $55,000 - $65,000. In addition to a base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and benefits (subject to eligibility requirements) listed here: Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. Total compensation is based on several factors including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable for all full-time positions.


We follow a Flexible Vacation Policy, intended for rest, relaxation, and personal time. All time off must be approved by your manager prior to use. You will also receive 80 hours of Paid Sick, Safe, and Caregiver Leave annually. This applies to full-time positions only. If you are applying for a part-time role, your recruiter can provide additional details.


As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified.

We’ve been alerted that scammers will sometimes impersonate our employees and make fictitious job offers.The only official email address domain used by Teladoc Health is “@teladochealth.com,” and we are only recruiting for the positions listed below. Additionally, we will never ask you to send any payment to our company or employees, and all Teladoc Health equipment is provided at no charge to our employees. If you have been contacted by any other email domain, offered a position that’s not on our website, or received any other suspicious communication, please do not engage, mark the email as phishing and file a report at .


Teladoc Health will not sponsor or transfer employment work visas for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.


Why join Teladoc Health?

  • Teladoc Health is transforming how better health happens. Learn how when you join us in pursuit of our impactful mission.
  • Chart your career path with meaningful opportunities that empower you to grow, lead, and make a difference.
  • Join a multi-faceted community that celebrates each colleague’s unique perspective and is focused on continually improving, each and every day.
  • Contribute to an innovative culture where fresh ideas are valued as we increase access to care in new ways.
  • Enjoy an inclusive benefits program centered around you and your family, with tailored programs that address your unique needs.
  • Explore candidate resources with tips and tricks from Teladoc Health recruiters and learn more about our company culture by exploring #TeamTeladocHealth on LinkedIn.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, religion, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, membership in an employee organization, medical condition, family history, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, parental status, or pregnancy). In our innovative and inclusive workplace, we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind.


Teladoc Health respects your privacy and is committed to maintaining the confidentiality and security of your personal information. In furtherance of your employment relationship with Teladoc Health, we collect personal information responsibly and in accordance with applicable data privacy laws, including but not limited to, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Personal information is defined as: Any information or set of information relating to you, including (a) all information that identifies you or could reasonably be used to identify you, and (b) all information that any applicable law treats as personal information. Teladoc Health’s Notice of Privacy Practices for U.S. Employees’ Personal information is available at this link.

raw.title: Head of Workplace Engineering
raw.excerpt: Join our expanding Workplace Engineering team!  We’re recruiting a Head of Workplace Engineering to run IT at M-KOPA as a product, with automation first, so 2,500+ colleagues can keep serving Africa’s Every Day Earners.
raw.description:
Join our expanding Workplace Engineering team! We’re recruiting a Head of Workplace Engineering to run IT at M-KOPA as a product, with automation first, so 2,500+ colleagues can keep serving Africa’s Every Day Earners.

The Impact

Your engineering will keep a pan-African fintech running across five offices, four warehouses, 100+ retail sites and 10 call centres in six countries. We’ve now served 10 million customers, unlocked $2+ billion in credit and created income for 35,000+ agents. It’s your chance to be part of something that’s transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

The Opportunity

🎯 Mission-driven engineering: Every device provisioned, access request automated and call-centre line kept up helps the people serving our customers.

🏆 Global recognition: Named by TIME 100 as one of the world’s most influential companies, and by the Financial Times as one of Africa’s fastest-growing for four consecutive years (2022-2025).

🚀 Scale challenges: Run IT across six countries, from call-centre agents to the executive team, using repeatable, templated builds for new sites and markets.

🌱 Environmental impact: We’re carbon-negative, with over 2 million tonnes of emissions avoided.

What You’ll Do

You’ll lead our IT function, including the Helpdesk and IT Infrastructure teams, and be accountable for the cost, security, reliability and user experience of our internal estate. We’re not hiring a traditional IT manager. We want an engineer who would rather write the automation than raise the ticket.

  • Own the IT roadmap and budget, treating internal services as products with clear users and measured adoption

  • Run the corporate Azure and Microsoft estate as code, deployed through CI/CD

  • Automate joiner/mover/leaver, device provisioning, licensing and access requests, driven from the HR system of record

  • Own identity, end-user devices, networks across all our sites, and contact-centre telephony across ~10 call centres

  • Move support from reactive tickets to self-service and automated resolution, using AI and agentic tooling where it genuinely removes work

  • Own IT security hygiene, business continuity and compliance, with audit evidence generated from systems

Your Environment 💻

  • Microsoft and cloud: Azure, Entra ID, Intune, M365

  • Infrastructure as code: Bicep and/or Terraform, Git, pull requests, CI/CD

  • Scripting: PowerShell, Python, TypeScript or similar

  • Integrations: APIs and workflow tooling across HR, identity, ITSM and finance systems

This role covers internal IT. The infrastructure behind our customer-facing products sits with Engineering.

Our Approach 🚀

  • Automation first, everything versioned and repeatable

  • Data over anecdote

  • A team that builds rather than firefights

  • Product mindset: start from the user and the business outcome, not the tool

What You Need

You also need to be good with people. Our users range from call-centre agents to the executive team, and you should be the person they want to talk to when something is broken.

  • A strong engineering background: you write code regularly and are comfortable with Git, pull requests and CI/CD

  • Deep Azure and Microsoft experience: Entra ID, Intune, M365, Azure networking and core services

  • Hands-on infrastructure as code with Bicep and/or Terraform in production

  • A track record of automating IT operations at scale, with the before and after to show for it

  • Experience leading teams, including non-engineering teams such as a service desk

  • Approachable: you explain technical trade-offs in plain language and build trust at every level

Nice to have: multi-country IT experience (ideally in high-growth or emerging markets); networking fundamentals (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, ISPs) and contact-centre telephony; vendor management; applying LLMs or agentic workflows to internal operations; relevant certifications. We care more about what you’ve built than where you learnt it.

Probably not a fit if your experience is mainly managing vendors and tickets rather than building.

Location & Benefits

  • Based in Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Ghana, Uganda, the UK or the EU, with significant travel of up to 25% at times, especially early in the role

  • Benefits package, which includes Bonus & Growth Shares

  • Work with diverse teams across the UK, Europe and Africa

  • Professional development programmes and coaching partnerships

  • Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected to the mobile internet

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use their M-KOPA product to generate income, and 35,000 livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.1 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided, with over 127,000 circular economy products provided

Ready to build the systems that keep a pan-African fintech running, while advancing your career in IT engineering?Apply now!

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

raw.excerpt: SHIFT: Day (United States of America)Seeking Breakthrough Makers Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives.
raw.description:
SHIFT:

Day (United States of America)

Seeking Breakthrough Makers

Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives. Our diverse community of more than 20,000 Breakthrough Makers will inspire you to pursue passions, develop expertise, and drive innovation.

At CHOP, your experience is valued; your voice is heard; and your contributions make a difference for patients and families. Join us as we build on our promise to advance pediatric care—and your career.


CHOP does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, or any other legally protected categories in any employment, training, or vendor decisions or programs. CHOP recognizes the critical importance of a workforce rich in varied backgrounds and experiences and engages in ongoing efforts to achieve that through equally varied and non-discriminatory means.


A Brief Overview
The Children's Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) is dedicated to advancing the development and clinical translation of genome editing and other novel advanced gene therapies. This role plays a key role in advancing CHOP's research priorities and gene therapy programs.

This position collaborates with senior clinical, research, and administrative leaders in strategic planning efforts that drive innovation, advance investigational genome editing programs, and maximize the impact of scientific discoveries. This role also serves as an institutional subject matter expert in regulatory compliance, leading the preparation and submission of pre-IND and IND applications, advising on FDA regulatory requirements, and providing strategic oversight through clinical development to support Biologics License Application (BLA) submission for genome editing-based therapeutics.

Working closely with investigators, institutional leadership, regulatory agencies, and industry collaborators, the position leads scientific and strategic efforts across CHOP's gene therapy portfolio, advancing the discovery, translational development, and early clinical progression of gene therapy and genome editing programs. Success in this role requires expertise in advanced therapeutic development, strong cross-functional leadership, and the ability to mentor scientific and regulatory personnel while advancing transformative genome editing medicines.

What you will do

  • Develop regulatory strategies for gene editing and other advanced genetic medicine programs from target discovery through IND-enabling studies and early clinical development
  • Direct implementation of the regulatory strategy for gene therapy programs
  • Provide regulatory expertise for the long-term scientific and portfolio strategy of gene therapy programs
  • Act as the subject matter expert to identify and develop solutions for regulatory requirements in support of major regulatory submission programs as needed, including strategies to progress towards a BLA
  • Oversee all gene editing and other innovative gene therapy related regulatory submissions
  • Fully accountable for the timely development and submission of regulatory documents (e.g., pre-IND and end-of-phase briefing books, INDs, NDA/BLAs, CTAs, MAAs, responses to regulatory queries, IND safety reports, etc.)
  • Communicate directly with regulatory agencies including the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA)
  • Advise teams on the CMC and nonclinical aspects of product development
  • Contribute to the creation and implementation of clinical development plans designed to maximize the likelihood of successful regulatory applications
  • Support sponsor-investigators in the development and writing of the scientific and regulatory rationale for CHOP gene editing study protocols and IND/IDEs (for example, inclusion/exclusion criteria, clinical endpoints, dose justification, dose escalation rationale, etc.)
  • Contribute to intellectual property and business development strategy
  • In collaboration with faculty and Clinical In Vivo Gene Therapy group members, interact with relevant academic and industry collaborators and serve as key point of contact on behalf of CHOP
  • Mentor and help guide junior members of gene therapy regulatory and research teams
  • Monitor current and proposed regulatory, scientific, and pertinent legal issues globally, and perform competitive intelligence to provide an assessment of the impact on product development and regulatory approval success
  • Ensure programs meet scientific, regulatory, quality, and safety standards

Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree - Required
  • Master's Degree - Preferred

Experience Qualifications

  • At least twelve (12) years of gene therapy clinical research experience - Required
  • At least twelve (12) years of related regulatory experience including gene therapy INDs, BLA preparation and FDA, IRB & other regulatory authority collaboration - Required
  • At least twelve (12) years of gene therapy grant writing experience - Required
  • At least twelve (12) years of intellectual property development experience - Required

Skills and Abilities

  • Advanced proficiency with establishing novel treatment U.S. and E.U. regulatory and clinical strategy and implementation, including from pre-clinical to registration phases across multiple therapeutic areas
  • Advanced proficiency with clinical research management, trial conduct, and clinical trial oversight
  • Advanced knowledge of FDA and other regulatory agency gene therapy guidelines, including IND/IDE requirements, DSMP and DSMB charter development
  • Advanced knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations for human research subject protections including ICH/GLP/GCP/GMP guidelines
  • Advanced knowledge of gene therapy regulatory pathways, designations and pharmaceuticals including FDA Orphan Designation, breakthrough therapy and novel potential regulatory pathways
  • Advanced knowledge of product manufacturing including related quality assurance & quality control systems

To carry out its mission, CHOP is committed to supporting the health of our patients, families, workforce, and global community. As a condition of employment, CHOP employees who work in patient care buildings or who have patient facing responsibilities must receive an annual influenza vaccine. Learn more.EEO / VEVRAA Federal Contractor | Tobacco Statement

SALARY RANGE:

$100,000.00 - $375,000.00 Annually

Salary ranges are shown for full-time jobs. If you're working part-time, your pay will be adjusted accordingly.

This job is eligible for an incentive program.

At CHOP, we are committed to fair and transparent pay practices. Factors such as skills and experience could result in an offer above the salary range noted in this job posting. Click here for more information regarding CHOP's Compensation and Benefits.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

  • Make decisions quickly, solve problems directly and own execution from idea to results

What We're Looking For

  • Strong track record building, launching or scaling a product, business or business unit

  • Experience owning P&L, revenue, growth or other measurable business outcomes

  • Strong product and commercial judgement

  • Ability to work across product, engineering, operations and commercial functions

  • Experience building and leading strong teams

  • Hands-on approach - comfortable moving between strategy and detailed execution

  • Strong ownership, speed and ability to operate with limited structure

  • Experience in fintech, consumer technology or AI is an advantage

raw.description:
As vCluster’s AI Infrastructure Specialist, you will work directly with customers at the earliest and most critical stage of their journey: from bare metal GPU nodes through to a production-ready deployment. This is not a traditional professional services role; you operate pre-sale as part of a proof of value engagement scoped to reach production. You will be one of the first team members a neocloud or AI Factory engages with at a technical depth, and the playbooks you develop will scale the motion for the next hire and customer.

vCluster is gaining rapid traction with GPU AI Clouds and enterprises building AI Factories: organizations that need to offer Kubernetes as a managed service on bare metal GPU infrastructure, and need to do it fast. This role exists to make that happen.

As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, your role will include:

  • Lead Technical Deployments: Drive end-to-end technical deployments for GPU neocloud and AI Factory customers, from initial bare metal configuration to a validated vCluster environment.

  • Infrastructure Optimization: Configure and troubleshoot bare metal GPU node infrastructure, including CNI configuration, GPU Operator setup, distributed storage backends, and RDMA/InfiniBand.

  • Validation: Deploy and validate Kubernetes and vCluster to provide GPU-powered managed K8s.

  • Knowledge Transfer: Work alongside customer teams to build self-sufficiency, ensuring they can operate and grow the platform independently.

  • Scaling through Documentation: Document reusable playbooks and deployment architectures so your learnings become the next customer's head start.

  • Feedback Loop: Collaborate with Engineering and Product to surface recurring infrastructure challenges, acting as a direct feedback loop from the field into the roadmap.

  • Strategic Partnering: Join Sales in the pre-sales process where deep infrastructure work is required to achieve a meaningful proof of value.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Production K8s Mastery: 5+ years of experience deploying and operating Kubernetes in production, ideally on bare metal or in high-complexity environments.

  • GPU Fluency: Practical knowledge of NVIDIA GPU Operators, CUDA tooling, and systems-level configuration for GPU nodes.

  • Networking Fundamentals: Deep understanding of CNI plugins, overlay networks, load balancing, and connectivity diagnosis in layered environments.

  • Storage Expertise: Experience with persistent volume configuration, CSI drivers, and distributed systems like Ceph, Rook, Weka, or Longhorn.

  • Operational Agility: Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you are often writing the playbook in real time.

  • Modern Tech Mindset: You thrive in environments that reject legacy tech and prefer a modern stack where you can solve a variety of problems from pipelines to internal services.

Bonus points for:

  • Automation Skills: Experience writing automation scripts with Bash, Python, or Go.

  • Kubernetes Depth: Relevant certifications such as CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) or experience writing Kubernetes Operators.

  • AI/ML Familiarity: Experience with inference serving, GPU scheduling, and the tooling around LLM deployment.

  • Documentation: Experience building AI Automation in documentation to contribute to a shared knowledge base.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

CIeNET is seeking an AI Infrastructure Systems Support Engineer to support large-scale server infrastructure deployment and operations.

In this role, you will troubleshoot Linux-based infrastructure, investigate automated server deployment failures, diagnose networking and hardware-related issues, and collaborate with global engineering teams to ensure smooth data center operations.

This position is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in Linux system administration, networking, infrastructure support, and incident troubleshooting.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor, investigate, and resolve infrastructure deployment and system support tickets.
  • Troubleshoot Linux operating system issues, configuration problems, and automated deployment failures.
  • Analyze system logs, kernel messages, networking diagnostics, and deployment workflow failures.
  • Diagnose DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP, PXE boot, and network connectivity issues.
  • Identify potential server hardware, NIC, BIOS, BMC, and firmware failures, escalating issues to specialized engineering teams when required.
  • Support troubleshooting of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized infrastructure environments.
  • Collaborate with global engineering teams to resolve infrastructure incidents.
  • Maintain accurate ticket documentation, troubleshooting runbooks, and shift handoff reports.
  • Participate in rotating shifts to support global infrastructure operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with Linux operating systems.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience with computer networking.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP (IPv4/IPv6), and network troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with server hardware components, BIOS, BMC, NICs, and firmware.
  • Practical experience troubleshooting Kubernetes environments, including workload scheduling and networking.
  • Experience using ticketing systems for incident tracking and escalation.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Ability to communicate technical issues clearly and document incident resolutions.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, shift-based environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting data center infrastructure or large-scale server deployments.
  • Familiarity with PXE boot, netboot, and automated OS provisioning.
  • Experience with Bash or Python scripting.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, K3s, or container networking.
  • Experience with DCIM/IPAM solutions such as NetBox.
  • Experience working with globally distributed support teams.

Working Environment

This is a primarily remote role supporting global infrastructure operations through a follow-the-sun model.

Engineers will work approximately 40 hours per week across rotating eight-hour shifts. Schedules may include weekends and holidays based on operational coverage needs.

Successful candidates must be reliable, responsive, technically capable, and comfortable coordinating with engineering teams across different time zones.

raw.description:
About Kojo

It's time to build. Whether it's creating more housing, upgrading our infrastructure, or adapting to climate change, one thing is clear: the construction industry is at the center of solving our biggest problems. We’re making buildings cheaper and easier to build by transforming the way commercial construction companies buy their materials. Join us.

Founded in 2018, Kojo is now one of the fastest-growing construction technology companies in the world. Construction accounts for $10 trillion in global spend annually and we can’t live without its output - our roads, schools, hospitals, and offices. Despite this, there’s been very little innovation over the past 70 years in how materials - which constitute up to 40% of project costs - are bought and sold. This is our opportunity.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thrives on solving complex problems, building high-quality software, and taking ownership from idea to production.

At Kojo, engineers don't simply implement tickets, they partner closely with Product, Design, and Customer teams to define solutions, make technical decisions, and deliver meaningful customer impact.

This is a role for someone who enjoys working across the stack, embraces ambiguity, and wants to help shape both our product and our engineering culture.

What You'll Do

Build

  • Design, build, and operate reliable, scalable, and maintainable software.

  • Own features and systems from technical design through production.

  • Improve system performance, reliability, and developer experience.

  • Continuously raise the quality of our codebase through thoughtful engineering practices.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead complex technical initiatives from ambiguous problem to successful delivery.

  • Make architectural decisions by balancing short-term execution with long-term sustainability.

  • Drive technical discussions and help establish engineering best practices.

  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance.

Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product, Design, Customer Success, and fellow engineers to solve customer problems.

  • Contribute to engineering and product roadmap discussions.

  • Collaborate across teams as priorities evolve.

Ownership

  • Take responsibility for production systems and customer outcomes.

  • Identify opportunities to improve our systems, tooling, and engineering processes.

  • Own problems, not just tickets, and help create clarity in ambiguous situations.

What You've Accomplished

We're more interested in the impact you've had than the number of years you've worked.

We're excited to meet candidates who have:

  • Significant experience designing, building, and shipping high-quality production software.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and an understanding of systems from application code through infrastructure.

  • Experience taking products or major features from concept to production.

  • Led technical projects involving multiple engineers and stakeholders.

  • Made architectural decisions and can clearly explain the trade-offs behind them.

  • Strong backend engineering experience, including APIs (REST and/or GraphQL), databases (PostgreSQL or similar), authentication, and distributed systems concepts.

  • Experience working across modern web technologies and willingness to contribute across the stack when needed.

  • Experience with technologies similar to ours. Our stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, React, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and AWS, but we care far more about strong engineering fundamentals than prior experience with any specific framework.

Nice to Have

Experience with one or more of the following:

  • AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda)

  • Docker

  • Elasticsearch

  • Observability tools such as Datadog or Sentry

What Success Looks Like

Successful Senior Software Engineers at Kojo:

  • Own problems, not just tickets.

  • Turn ambiguous problems into simple, maintainable solutions.

  • Deliver consistently while maintaining a high quality bar.

  • Know when to move quickly and when to invest in long-term engineering quality.

  • Help other engineers succeed through collaboration and mentorship.

  • Leave systems and codebases better than they found them.

  • Continuously improve how we build software, not just what we build.

What You Care About

Customer Obsession

You care deeply about solving real customer problems and delivering meaningful value.

Ownership

You take responsibility for outcomes, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, and follow through.

Craftsmanship

You value clean, maintainable software and thoughtful technical decisions.

Pragmatism

You balance speed with quality and know how to make thoughtful trade-offs.

Growth

You actively seek feedback, continuously learn, and help those around you grow.

How We Use AI

AI is part of how we build at Kojo.

Engineers are expected to thoughtfully incorporate AI tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar into their daily workflow whenever they meaningfully improve productivity and software quality.

We use AI for tasks like scaffolding, debugging, documentation, testing, and accelerating repetitive work, but AI never replaces engineering judgment.

You remain accountable for the architecture, trade-offs, correctness, security, and quality of everything that ships. AI is a force multiplier for great engineers, not a substitute for them.

Working at Kojo

Salary: Your salary will be dependent upon many factors, including your experience level, skillset, market dynamics and balancing internal equity relative to other Kojo employees. The compensation and benefits information that we provide is based on Kojo’s good-faith estimate as of the date of the job posting and may be modified in the future.

Benefits: This position is also eligible for a new hire equity grant and all US-based full time employees are eligible for our full suite of perks and benefits. For more information about our perks and benefits, check out

Location: Kojo’s team members work from home 100% of the time across North and South America. If applicable, we’ll identify the travel and/or location-specific requirements of a position in the text above. Otherwise, team members can expect to work business hours congruent with their local time zone and remotely.

Inclusive Workplace: Kojo values diverse perspectives and is committed to building an inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, citizenship, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.



Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of Kojo. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Kojo will never ask for any personal account information, such credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for full stack engineers to build fast across BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for product-minded engineers who can move across frontend, backend, internal tools and customer journeys to turn ideas into working products quickly.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship full product features across frontend, backend, APIs and databases.

  • Create customer and internal workflows for onboarding, accounts, payments, rewards, travel, FX, support automation, KYC and risk.

  • Turn ambiguous product problems into working systems with clean UX and reliable backend logic.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI engineers to launch fast and improve after release.

  • Build internal tools and automation that reduce manual work and help teams operate at scale.

  • Own your work beyond release: monitor, debug, learn and improve.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong full stack engineering experience with real shipped products.

  • Comfortable across frontend, backend, APIs, databases and production debugging.

  • Good frontend execution using React, Next.js, Vue or similar modern stack.

  • Good backend fundamentals around APIs, data models, authentication, integrations and reliability.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify messy workflows.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and own outcomes end-to-end.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want to work on one narrow layer.

  • People who need complete specs before starting.

  • Developers who ship UI without understanding backend or operations impact.

  • Candidates who avoid production support.

  • People who make vague claims without showing real shipped work.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Portugal. We are hiring for this market specifically, so applicants should already be based in Portugal.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

About the Role:

Join our Revenue Operations team as a business partner to our growing Payer and Operations organizations, as well as provide data-driven strategic insights. You'll own the operational support of our channel customer journey, building the data, metrics, and operating cadence that drive measurable growth.

This is a senior, outcomes-focused role. Success means proactively turning complex data into clear recommendations, moving work from analysis to action, and driving cross-functional alignment to deliver results.

What You’ll Own:

  • Upskill and uptool the Payer Access organization to drive scale and growth in a highly complex environment.
  • Build and maintain a unified Payer Access data model, standardizing funnel stages, metrics, and attribution.
  • Identify and resolve data gaps, system disconnects, and process inefficiencies.
  • Develop dashboards and insights that help field reps and leaders improve funnel health, lead progression, deal closure, retention, account management prioritization, leading to enrollment and revenue growth.
  • Lead stakeholder reviews with clear recommendations, strategic insights, decisions, owners, and next steps.
  • Partner with field teams to build practical analytics that incorporate frontline insights and drive productivity.
  • Collaborate across Operations, Marketing, Product and Engineering, Channel Sales/Channel Growth, Alliances, Employer Sales, and Customer Experience to improve data quality, integrations, and reporting.
  • Establish operating rhythms to track funnel performance, drive accountability, and enable continuous improvement.
  • Lead payer annual planning, including capacity, territories, quotas, incentive compensation, roadmaps, and targeting.

About You:

You have built or optimized multi-stage funnels across systems and teams, bringing structure to ambiguous, fragmented data through strong data modeling, systems thinking, and stakeholder influence.

  • You ship. A strong bias toward action; you move work from analysis to decision to completion on time with clear milestones, flagging timeline changes before they impact stakeholders.
  • You lead with the “so what.” You distill complexity into a clear takeaway, business impact, and recommended action—enabling decisions rather than further exploration—and resist unnecessary metric complexity.
  • You prioritize ruthlessly. You scope tightly, focus on the highest-impact work, and decline or defer lower-value requests rather than spreading effort thin.
  • You create clarity for others. You drive discussions to decisions, owners, and next steps, bring proposed paths forward rather than escalating ambiguity, and own business outcomes end-to-end.
  • You build with the field, not just for it. You incorporate frontline intelligence so the people who use your models trust and adopt them.

What You Bring:

  • 7+ years in Revenue Operations, Growth Operations, or Analytics within complex, multi-system environments.
  • Experience building and optimizing end-to-end funnels (B2B2C, marketplace, healthcare, or lifecycle marketing preferred).
  • Proven ability to deliver decision-ready analyses on time and translate complex data into clear recommendations for executive audiences.
  • Strong judgment in balancing analytical rigor with speed, defining scope, and knowing when insights are actionable.
  • Demonstrated success driving cross-functional alignment and influencing stakeholders independently.
  • Strong analytical skills (Excel, BI tools; SQL a plus) with expertise in funnel metrics, conversion analysis, and operating models.
  • Experience partnering with Customer Success, Sales, or Growth teams to drive behavior change and improve business outcomes.
  • Experience with healthcare data, eligibility files, or similar data ingestion workflows preferred.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

Omada is thrilled to share that we’ve been certified as a Great Place to Work! Please click here for more information.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Omada is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. Harris Computer is hiring a Staff AI Engineer (QA) to join their, expanding team! We’re seeking a seasoned expert to pioneer the quality and reliability of our cutting-edge AI and machine learning solutions for healthcare. As a Staff AI Engineer focused on Quality Assurance, you will be the technical authority responsible for ensuring our AI systems are robust, fair, accurate, and safe.


This is a unique opportunity to define the future of AI quality in a domain where it matters most, mentoring a talented team and establishing the gold standard for testing intelligent systems that impact patient care.


This is a full-time, remote position open to candidates in the U.S. or Canada.


What your impact will be:

  • Build the core AI system end-to-end, from the service layer and data pipelines to the evaluation infrastructure, and own its architecture.
  • Design and build the evaluation infrastructure, including dataset management, automated test harnesses, and replay of AI systems against historical workflows.
  • Build and maintain evaluation datasets with clinician-reviewed correct answers, ensuring they evolve as our systems change.
  • Create error metrics weighted by severity, so mistakes with clinical or financial impact are prioritized accordingly.
  • Build production monitoring for accuracy, overrides, and safety issues, with actionable alerts for the engineering team.
  • Write adversarial tests for AI systems, including hidden or malicious instructions in documents and invented content.
  • Work with product and clinical leads to define accuracy thresholds and the criteria for expanding or pulling back an AI capability.
  • The candidate must possess a curiosity and willingness to actively adopt and leverage emerging AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and drive efficiency along with being comfortable using a range of AI-enabled tools (such as copilots, chat-based AI, and automation solutions) as part of everyday work.

What we’re looking for:

  • 7 or more years in software or machine learning engineering, with at least 3 years focused on evaluation, testing, or quality for AI systems.
  • A track record of designing and building complete systems from scratch, taking them from prototype to production.
  • A track record of building and running evaluation systems that teams use in production, not just for one-off analyses.
  • At least 2 years of experience evaluating large language model (LLM) systems in a production environment.
  • Strong statistical skills for measuring accuracy, including sampling, confidence intervals, and error analysis.
  • 1 year + of experience designing evaluation sets for document extraction, classification, or structured output.
  • Deep knowledge of explainable AI (XAI) techniques and AI-powered tools (e.g., SHAP, LIME, Claude).
  • Clear written communication, including design documents, and the ability to explain complex trade-offs to clinicians, engineers, and executives.

What would make you stand out:

  • Experience working within the healthcare or another highly regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with AI-specific testing techniques like metamorphic testing, adversarial testing, or data validation with tools like Great Expectations.
  • A history of mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction across multiple teams.

What we offer:

  • Plenty of opportunities to grow your career
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • 3 weeks of vacation plus 5 personal days to recharge
  • Employee stock ownership, RRSP program, 401k matching
  • A chance to give back through community involvement
  • Flexible work arrangements to suit your lifestyle

Salary range: $120,000-160,000 USD depending on experience and qualifications.

Harris provides mission critical software solutions for the Public Sector, Healthcare, Utilities and Private Sector verticals throughout North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.

Working for Harris is the perfect opportunity to fulfill your professional goals as well as achieve your personal dreams!

Our employees enjoy a casual work environment that offers comfort while providing superior service to our customers. We offer a comprehensive benefit package as well as other additional “Perks”!

  • We empower our employees to make a difference
  • We have an award-winning culture
  • We offer opportunity to learn
  • We are financially strong and we are owned by the largest software company in Canada (CSI)

raw.description:
Join our expanding Workplace Engineering team! We’re recruiting a Head of Workplace Engineering to run IT at M-KOPA as a product, with automation first, so 2,500+ colleagues can keep serving Africa’s Every Day Earners.

The Impact

Your engineering will keep a pan-African fintech running across five offices, four warehouses, 100+ retail sites and 10 call centres in six countries. We’ve now served 10 million customers, unlocked $2+ billion in credit and created income for 35,000+ agents. It’s your chance to be part of something that’s transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

The Opportunity

🎯 Mission-driven engineering: Every device provisioned, access request automated and call-centre line kept up helps the people serving our customers.

🏆 Global recognition: Named by TIME 100 as one of the world’s most influential companies, and by the Financial Times as one of Africa’s fastest-growing for four consecutive years (2022-2025).

🚀 Scale challenges: Run IT across six countries, from call-centre agents to the executive team, using repeatable, templated builds for new sites and markets.

🌱 Environmental impact: We’re carbon-negative, with over 2 million tonnes of emissions avoided.

What You’ll Do

You’ll lead our IT function, including the Helpdesk and IT Infrastructure teams, and be accountable for the cost, security, reliability and user experience of our internal estate. We’re not hiring a traditional IT manager. We want an engineer who would rather write the automation than raise the ticket.

  • Own the IT roadmap and budget, treating internal services as products with clear users and measured adoption

  • Run the corporate Azure and Microsoft estate as code, deployed through CI/CD

  • Automate joiner/mover/leaver, device provisioning, licensing and access requests, driven from the HR system of record

  • Own identity, end-user devices, networks across all our sites, and contact-centre telephony across ~10 call centres

  • Move support from reactive tickets to self-service and automated resolution, using AI and agentic tooling where it genuinely removes work

  • Own IT security hygiene, business continuity and compliance, with audit evidence generated from systems

Your Environment 💻

  • Microsoft and cloud: Azure, Entra ID, Intune, M365

  • Infrastructure as code: Bicep and/or Terraform, Git, pull requests, CI/CD

  • Scripting: PowerShell, Python, TypeScript or similar

  • Integrations: APIs and workflow tooling across HR, identity, ITSM and finance systems

This role covers internal IT. The infrastructure behind our customer-facing products sits with Engineering.

Our Approach 🚀

  • Automation first, everything versioned and repeatable

  • Data over anecdote

  • A team that builds rather than firefights

  • Product mindset: start from the user and the business outcome, not the tool

What You Need

You also need to be good with people. Our users range from call-centre agents to the executive team, and you should be the person they want to talk to when something is broken.

  • A strong engineering background: you write code regularly and are comfortable with Git, pull requests and CI/CD

  • Deep Azure and Microsoft experience: Entra ID, Intune, M365, Azure networking and core services

  • Hands-on infrastructure as code with Bicep and/or Terraform in production

  • A track record of automating IT operations at scale, with the before and after to show for it

  • Experience leading teams, including non-engineering teams such as a service desk

  • Approachable: you explain technical trade-offs in plain language and build trust at every level

Nice to have: multi-country IT experience (ideally in high-growth or emerging markets); networking fundamentals (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, ISPs) and contact-centre telephony; vendor management; applying LLMs or agentic workflows to internal operations; relevant certifications. We care more about what you’ve built than where you learnt it.

Probably not a fit if your experience is mainly managing vendors and tickets rather than building.

Location & Benefits

  • Based in Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Ghana, Uganda, the UK or the EU, with significant travel of up to 25% at times, especially early in the role

  • Benefits package, which includes Bonus & Growth Shares

  • Work with diverse teams across the UK, Europe and Africa

  • Professional development programmes and coaching partnerships

  • Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected to the mobile internet

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use their M-KOPA product to generate income, and 35,000 livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.1 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided, with over 127,000 circular economy products provided

Ready to build the systems that keep a pan-African fintech running, while advancing your career in IT engineering?Apply now!

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

SHIFT:

Day (United States of America)

Seeking Breakthrough Makers

Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives. Our diverse community of more than 20,000 Breakthrough Makers will inspire you to pursue passions, develop expertise, and drive innovation.

At CHOP, your experience is valued; your voice is heard; and your contributions make a difference for patients and families. Join us as we build on our promise to advance pediatric care—and your career.


CHOP does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, or any other legally protected categories in any employment, training, or vendor decisions or programs. CHOP recognizes the critical importance of a workforce rich in varied backgrounds and experiences and engages in ongoing efforts to achieve that through equally varied and non-discriminatory means.


A Brief Overview
The Children's Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) is dedicated to advancing the development and clinical translation of genome editing and other novel advanced gene therapies. This role plays a key role in advancing CHOP's research priorities and gene therapy programs.

This position collaborates with senior clinical, research, and administrative leaders in strategic planning efforts that drive innovation, advance investigational genome editing programs, and maximize the impact of scientific discoveries. This role also serves as an institutional subject matter expert in regulatory compliance, leading the preparation and submission of pre-IND and IND applications, advising on FDA regulatory requirements, and providing strategic oversight through clinical development to support Biologics License Application (BLA) submission for genome editing-based therapeutics.

Working closely with investigators, institutional leadership, regulatory agencies, and industry collaborators, the position leads scientific and strategic efforts across CHOP's gene therapy portfolio, advancing the discovery, translational development, and early clinical progression of gene therapy and genome editing programs. Success in this role requires expertise in advanced therapeutic development, strong cross-functional leadership, and the ability to mentor scientific and regulatory personnel while advancing transformative genome editing medicines.

What you will do

  • Develop regulatory strategies for gene editing and other advanced genetic medicine programs from target discovery through IND-enabling studies and early clinical development
  • Direct implementation of the regulatory strategy for gene therapy programs
  • Provide regulatory expertise for the long-term scientific and portfolio strategy of gene therapy programs
  • Act as the subject matter expert to identify and develop solutions for regulatory requirements in support of major regulatory submission programs as needed, including strategies to progress towards a BLA
  • Oversee all gene editing and other innovative gene therapy related regulatory submissions
  • Fully accountable for the timely development and submission of regulatory documents (e.g., pre-IND and end-of-phase briefing books, INDs, NDA/BLAs, CTAs, MAAs, responses to regulatory queries, IND safety reports, etc.)
  • Communicate directly with regulatory agencies including the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA)
  • Advise teams on the CMC and nonclinical aspects of product development
  • Contribute to the creation and implementation of clinical development plans designed to maximize the likelihood of successful regulatory applications
  • Support sponsor-investigators in the development and writing of the scientific and regulatory rationale for CHOP gene editing study protocols and IND/IDEs (for example, inclusion/exclusion criteria, clinical endpoints, dose justification, dose escalation rationale, etc.)
  • Contribute to intellectual property and business development strategy
  • In collaboration with faculty and Clinical In Vivo Gene Therapy group members, interact with relevant academic and industry collaborators and serve as key point of contact on behalf of CHOP
  • Mentor and help guide junior members of gene therapy regulatory and research teams
  • Monitor current and proposed regulatory, scientific, and pertinent legal issues globally, and perform competitive intelligence to provide an assessment of the impact on product development and regulatory approval success
  • Ensure programs meet scientific, regulatory, quality, and safety standards

Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree - Required
  • Master's Degree - Preferred

Experience Qualifications

  • At least twelve (12) years of gene therapy clinical research experience - Required
  • At least twelve (12) years of related regulatory experience including gene therapy INDs, BLA preparation and FDA, IRB & other regulatory authority collaboration - Required
  • At least twelve (12) years of gene therapy grant writing experience - Required
  • At least twelve (12) years of intellectual property development experience - Required

Skills and Abilities

  • Advanced proficiency with establishing novel treatment U.S. and E.U. regulatory and clinical strategy and implementation, including from pre-clinical to registration phases across multiple therapeutic areas
  • Advanced proficiency with clinical research management, trial conduct, and clinical trial oversight
  • Advanced knowledge of FDA and other regulatory agency gene therapy guidelines, including IND/IDE requirements, DSMP and DSMB charter development
  • Advanced knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations for human research subject protections including ICH/GLP/GCP/GMP guidelines
  • Advanced knowledge of gene therapy regulatory pathways, designations and pharmaceuticals including FDA Orphan Designation, breakthrough therapy and novel potential regulatory pathways
  • Advanced knowledge of product manufacturing including related quality assurance & quality control systems

To carry out its mission, CHOP is committed to supporting the health of our patients, families, workforce, and global community. As a condition of employment, CHOP employees who work in patient care buildings or who have patient facing responsibilities must receive an annual influenza vaccine. $100,000.00 - $375,000.00 Annually

This job is eligible for an incentive program.

raw.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
raw.excerpt: As vCluster’s AI Infrastructure Specialist, you will work directly with customers at the earliest and most critical stage of their journey: from bare metal GPU nodes through to a production-ready deployment.
raw.description:
As vCluster’s AI Infrastructure Specialist, you will work directly with customers at the earliest and most critical stage of their journey: from bare metal GPU nodes through to a production-ready deployment. This is not a traditional professional services role; you operate pre-sale as part of a proof of value engagement scoped to reach production. You will be one of the first team members a neocloud or AI Factory engages with at a technical depth, and the playbooks you develop will scale the motion for the next hire and customer.

vCluster is gaining rapid traction with GPU AI Clouds and enterprises building AI Factories: organizations that need to offer Kubernetes as a managed service on bare metal GPU infrastructure, and need to do it fast. This role exists to make that happen.

As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, your role will include:

  • Lead Technical Deployments: Drive end-to-end technical deployments for GPU neocloud and AI Factory customers, from initial bare metal configuration to a validated vCluster environment.

  • Infrastructure Optimization: Configure and troubleshoot bare metal GPU node infrastructure, including CNI configuration, GPU Operator setup, distributed storage backends, and RDMA/InfiniBand.

  • Validation: Deploy and validate Kubernetes and vCluster to provide GPU-powered managed K8s.

  • Knowledge Transfer: Work alongside customer teams to build self-sufficiency, ensuring they can operate and grow the platform independently.

  • Scaling through Documentation: Document reusable playbooks and deployment architectures so your learnings become the next customer's head start.

  • Feedback Loop: Collaborate with Engineering and Product to surface recurring infrastructure challenges, acting as a direct feedback loop from the field into the roadmap.

  • Strategic Partnering: Join Sales in the pre-sales process where deep infrastructure work is required to achieve a meaningful proof of value.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Production K8s Mastery: 5+ years of experience deploying and operating Kubernetes in production, ideally on bare metal or in high-complexity environments.

  • GPU Fluency: Practical knowledge of NVIDIA GPU Operators, CUDA tooling, and systems-level configuration for GPU nodes.

  • Networking Fundamentals: Deep understanding of CNI plugins, overlay networks, load balancing, and connectivity diagnosis in layered environments.

  • Storage Expertise: Experience with persistent volume configuration, CSI drivers, and distributed systems like Ceph, Rook, Weka, or Longhorn.

  • Operational Agility: Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you are often writing the playbook in real time.

  • Modern Tech Mindset: You thrive in environments that reject legacy tech and prefer a modern stack where you can solve a variety of problems from pipelines to internal services.

Bonus points for:

  • Automation Skills: Experience writing automation scripts with Bash, Python, or Go.

  • Kubernetes Depth: Relevant certifications such as CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) or experience writing Kubernetes Operators.

  • AI/ML Familiarity: Experience with inference serving, GPU scheduling, and the tooling around LLM deployment.

  • Documentation: Experience building AI Automation in documentation to contribute to a shared knowledge base.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: $140K - $165K

Employment Logistics: The Senior Director, Driver Capacity Planning & Network Strategy leads the strategy, governance, and execution of driver and fleet capacity planning across OnTrac’s Last Mile network. This role ensures driver, Regional Service Provider (RSP), vehicle, and territory capacity align with forecasted demand, growth objectives, service requirements, and network economics. The Senior Director establishes the methodologies and operating mechanisms that translate volume forecasts into actionable resource strategies across markets and territories, advises senior leadership on capacity risks and investment priorities, and leads a multi-level capacity planning organization through subordinate leaders and team members.
