Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and company policies. The Must-Haves:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience 15+ years of relevant experience in capacity planning, transportation, logistics, supply chain, network operations, workforce planning, or a related discipline, including experience leading a function through subordinate leaders Advanced knowledge of capacity planning, forecasting, workforce and resource planning, network strategy, and resource optimization methodologies Comprehensive understanding of Last Mile, transportation, logistics, or similarly complex distributed networks, including driver, fleet, territory, and delivery-partner capacity Advanced analytical and financial acumen, with the ability to translate complex forecasts and operational data into enterprise strategy, investment priorities, and executive-level recommendations Demonstrated experience leading leaders, building high-performing teams, and developing organizational capabilities and succession pipelines Ability to travel up to 15% ​​It is the responsibility of every position to understand and adhere to the security guidelines outlined in OnTrac’s Acceptable Use policy and to conduct their activities accordingly.​

Your Mission in Motion: A summary of key responsibilities for the role is outlined below. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business objectives.

Lead capacity strategy and governance: Define short-, medium-, and long-range driver and fleet capacity strategies, methodologies, operating mechanisms, thresholds, and escalation triggers that support forecasted growth and service commitments. Translate demand into capacity requirements: Convert volume forecasts, territory demand, and growth projections into driver, vehicle, RSP, fleet-mix, and market-level capacity plans based on route density, service requirements, and volume characteristics. Direct RSP and network capacity decisions: Establish frameworks for evaluating RSP readiness, utilization, driver availability, and fleet capacity, including when existing partners should scale or additional RSP capacity is required. Manage capacity across the network: Set guardrails for balancing capacity and moving volume across territories, markets, and delivery partners during demand fluctuations, volume surges, network shifts, launches, and expansions. Evaluate network scenarios and trade-offs: Assess capacity, service, utilization, and cost considerations to recommend territory expansion, consolidation, capacity redistribution, fleet deployment, and network design decisions. Align plans and guide executive decisions: Partner with Operations, Transportation, Finance, Product, and Business Development to align forecasts, investments, and operating plans, and present scenarios, risks, and business cases to senior leadership. Measure and improve capacity performance: Establish reporting for forecast accuracy, capacity health, network utilization, RSP readiness, and emerging risks while improving planning processes, analytics, and network scalability. Lead the function and its resources: Manage the function’s budget and lead a multi-level capacity planning organization by establishing priorities, strengthening accountability, developing leaders, and building succession pipelines.

Paving your way to your success:

You develop scenario models and evaluate capacity, service, utilization, and cost trade-offs across markets, territories, and operating partners. You establish scalable planning governance, performance measures, and operating mechanisms within a complex, matrixed environment. You anticipate disruptions, identify emerging capacity risks, and develop adaptive responses that protect network performance and service commitments. You communicate with influence, aligning senior and executive stakeholders across the enterprise as well as external delivery partners. You evaluate fundamental business issues by analyzing complex variables, operational interdependencies, and their broader financial and network implications.

CIeNET is seeking an AI Infrastructure Systems Support Engineer to support large-scale server infrastructure deployment and operations.

In this role, you will troubleshoot Linux-based infrastructure, investigate automated server deployment failures, diagnose networking and hardware-related issues, and collaborate with global engineering teams to ensure smooth data center operations.

This position is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in Linux system administration, networking, infrastructure support, and incident troubleshooting.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor, investigate, and resolve infrastructure deployment and system support tickets.
  • Troubleshoot Linux operating system issues, configuration problems, and automated deployment failures.
  • Analyze system logs, kernel messages, networking diagnostics, and deployment workflow failures.
  • Diagnose DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP, PXE boot, and network connectivity issues.
  • Identify potential server hardware, NIC, BIOS, BMC, and firmware failures, escalating issues to specialized engineering teams when required.
  • Support troubleshooting of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized infrastructure environments.
  • Collaborate with global engineering teams to resolve infrastructure incidents.
  • Maintain accurate ticket documentation, troubleshooting runbooks, and shift handoff reports.
  • Participate in rotating shifts to support global infrastructure operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with Linux operating systems.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience with computer networking.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP (IPv4/IPv6), and network troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with server hardware components, BIOS, BMC, NICs, and firmware.
  • Practical experience troubleshooting Kubernetes environments, including workload scheduling and networking.
  • Experience using ticketing systems for incident tracking and escalation.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Ability to communicate technical issues clearly and document incident resolutions.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, shift-based environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting data center infrastructure or large-scale server deployments.
  • Familiarity with PXE boot, netboot, and automated OS provisioning.
  • Experience with Bash or Python scripting.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, K3s, or container networking.
  • Experience with DCIM/IPAM solutions such as NetBox.
  • Experience working with globally distributed support teams.

Working Environment

This is a primarily remote role supporting global infrastructure operations through a follow-the-sun model.

Engineers will work approximately 40 hours per week across rotating eight-hour shifts. Schedules may include weekends and holidays based on operational coverage needs.

Successful candidates must be reliable, responsive, technically capable, and comfortable coordinating with engineering teams across different time zones.

Benefits

  • Extended Healthcare Plan (Medical, Disability, Dental & Vision)
  • Group Life - AD&D - Critical Illness Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Work From Home

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. About AmeriPharma

AmeriPharma is a rapidly growing healthcare company where you will have the opportunity to contribute to our joint success on a daily basis. We value new ideas, creativity, and productivity. We like people who are passionate about their roles and people who like to grow and change as the company evolves.

Job Summary

The Staffing Coordinator is responsible for coordinating nursing services for specialty pharmacy, home infusion, and ambulatory infusion patients. This position serves as a central point of communication between patients, nurses, agencies, pharmacy personnel, intake staff, and clinical leadership to ensure timely and appropriate staffing of patient care services.
This role requires the ability to manage multiple active patient cases simultaneously, review and interpret clinical and operational documentation, prioritize competing demands, maintain accurate documentation, and follow established workflows while exercising sound judgment and attention to detail. The Staffing Coordinator is expected to work independently, maintain strong organizational skills, and ensure continuity of communication throughout the staffing process.

Schedule Details

Location: Fully Remote

Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:30AM-5:00PM CST

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Collaborates with the Director of Nursing to facilitate and oversee care coordination, communicate patient care information to internal and external staff, and ensure information and orders are updated and complete.
  • Review patient records, orders, intake documentation, and staffing requirements to facilitate nursing placement.
  • Utilize multiple systems and tracking tools to manage active staffing cases and ensure timely follow-up.
  • Coordinate nursing services through AmeriPharma nurses, contracted agencies, and external staffing resources according to established staffing workflows.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of staffing activities within company systems.
  • Monitor staffing progress and proactively address barriers that may impact patient care delivery.
  • Communicate effectively with patients, nurses, agencies, pharmacy staff, intake personnel, and clinical leadership.
  • Escalate staffing concerns, documentation deficiencies, scheduling conflicts, and patient care concerns according to company procedures.
  • Maintain ongoing tracking and follow-up of multiple active patient cases through completion of staffing activities.
  • Ensure compliance with departmental procedures, documentation standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Demonstrate accountability for assigned cases and follow-through on all required actions.\
  • Additional duties and responsibilities in different areas of the department on an as-need basis or determined by management.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, collaboration, and service excellence.
  • Other duties as assigned

Organizational Skills

  • Ability to manage multiple active cases and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to track numerous open tasks while maintaining accuracy and timeliness.

Attention to Detail

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify missing, incomplete, or conflicting information.
  • Ability to consistently follow established workflows and documentation requirements.

Communication Skills

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with patients, clinicians, agencies, and internal departments.

Problem Solving

  • Ability to identify obstacles, evaluate available information, and determine appropriate next steps within established guidelines.
  • Ability to recognize situations requiring escalation.

Clinical Information Management

  • Ability to review, understand, and accurately communicate clinical information related to infusion therapies, nursing requirements, treatment schedules, and vascular access devices.
  • Ability to apply clinical and operational information to staffing decisions while working within established protocols.

Technology Skills

  • Proficiency in electronic medical record systems, scheduling platforms, spreadsheets, and Google applications.
  • Ability to navigate multiple systems simultaneously while maintaining documentation accuracy.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Experience as a staffing/scheduling coordinator or in a similar role.
  • General knowledge of medical terminology.
  • Access to a reliable high-speed internet connection and a dedicated distraction free workspace.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to multitask and operate within several different computer software systems.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and delegate them when appropriate.
  • Ability to function well in a high-paced and at times stressful environment.

  • Experience in a medical or healthcare setting, with knowledge of medical terminology.

Education and Experience

  • Associate degree preferred; equivalent healthcare, administrative, or operations experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 2 years of healthcare coordination, scheduling, staffing, patient services, medical office, infusion, pharmacy, or related experience preferred.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment requiring multitasking, prioritization, and attention to detail preferred.
  • Experience working with electronic medical records or healthcare software systems preferred.

Critical Success Factors

This is a mid-level healthcare operations position that requires independent judgment, strong organizational abilities, attention to detail, and the ability to effectively manage multiple patient cases through completion.

To be successful in this role, an individual must consistently demonstrate:

  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple active priorities simultaneously.
  • Accountability and follow-through.
  • Professional communication.
  • Adaptability in a changing environment.
  • Ability to learn and apply complex workflows.
  • Independent problem-solving and decision-making within established guidelines.
  • Ability to accept and implement feedback and coaching.

Our goal is to achieve superior clinical and economic outcomes while maintaining the utmost compassion and care for our patients. It is our joint and individual responsibility daily to demonstrate to outpatients, prescribers, colleagues, and others that We Care!

raw.description:
About Kojo

It's time to build. Whether it's creating more housing, upgrading our infrastructure, or adapting to climate change, one thing is clear: the construction industry is at the center of solving our biggest problems. We’re making buildings cheaper and easier to build by transforming the way commercial construction companies buy their materials. Join us.

Founded in 2018, Kojo is now one of the fastest-growing construction technology companies in the world. Construction accounts for $10 trillion in global spend annually and we can’t live without its output - our roads, schools, hospitals, and offices. Despite this, there’s been very little innovation over the past 70 years in how materials - which constitute up to 40% of project costs - are bought and sold. This is our opportunity.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thrives on solving complex problems, building high-quality software, and taking ownership from idea to production.

At Kojo, engineers don't simply implement tickets, they partner closely with Product, Design, and Customer teams to define solutions, make technical decisions, and deliver meaningful customer impact.

This is a role for someone who enjoys working across the stack, embraces ambiguity, and wants to help shape both our product and our engineering culture.

What You'll Do

Build

  • Design, build, and operate reliable, scalable, and maintainable software.

  • Own features and systems from technical design through production.

  • Improve system performance, reliability, and developer experience.

  • Continuously raise the quality of our codebase through thoughtful engineering practices.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead complex technical initiatives from ambiguous problem to successful delivery.

  • Make architectural decisions by balancing short-term execution with long-term sustainability.

  • Drive technical discussions and help establish engineering best practices.

  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance.

Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product, Design, Customer Success, and fellow engineers to solve customer problems.

  • Contribute to engineering and product roadmap discussions.

  • Collaborate across teams as priorities evolve.

Ownership

  • Take responsibility for production systems and customer outcomes.

  • Identify opportunities to improve our systems, tooling, and engineering processes.

  • Own problems, not just tickets, and help create clarity in ambiguous situations.

What You've Accomplished

We're more interested in the impact you've had than the number of years you've worked.

We're excited to meet candidates who have:

  • Significant experience designing, building, and shipping high-quality production software.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and an understanding of systems from application code through infrastructure.

  • Experience taking products or major features from concept to production.

  • Led technical projects involving multiple engineers and stakeholders.

  • Made architectural decisions and can clearly explain the trade-offs behind them.

  • Strong backend engineering experience, including APIs (REST and/or GraphQL), databases (PostgreSQL or similar), authentication, and distributed systems concepts.

  • Experience working across modern web technologies and willingness to contribute across the stack when needed.

  • Experience with technologies similar to ours. Our stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, React, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and AWS, but we care far more about strong engineering fundamentals than prior experience with any specific framework.

Nice to Have

Experience with one or more of the following:

  • AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda)

  • Docker

  • Elasticsearch

  • Observability tools such as Datadog or Sentry

What Success Looks Like

Successful Senior Software Engineers at Kojo:

  • Own problems, not just tickets.

  • Turn ambiguous problems into simple, maintainable solutions.

  • Deliver consistently while maintaining a high quality bar.

  • Know when to move quickly and when to invest in long-term engineering quality.

  • Help other engineers succeed through collaboration and mentorship.

  • Leave systems and codebases better than they found them.

  • Continuously improve how we build software, not just what we build.

What You Care About

Customer Obsession

You care deeply about solving real customer problems and delivering meaningful value.

Ownership

You take responsibility for outcomes, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, and follow through.

Craftsmanship

You value clean, maintainable software and thoughtful technical decisions.

Pragmatism

You balance speed with quality and know how to make thoughtful trade-offs.

Growth

You actively seek feedback, continuously learn, and help those around you grow.

How We Use AI

AI is part of how we build at Kojo.

Engineers are expected to thoughtfully incorporate AI tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar into their daily workflow whenever they meaningfully improve productivity and software quality.

We use AI for tasks like scaffolding, debugging, documentation, testing, and accelerating repetitive work, but AI never replaces engineering judgment.

You remain accountable for the architecture, trade-offs, correctness, security, and quality of everything that ships. AI is a force multiplier for great engineers, not a substitute for them.

Working at Kojo

Salary: Your salary will be dependent upon many factors, including your experience level, skillset, market dynamics and balancing internal equity relative to other Kojo employees. The compensation and benefits information that we provide is based on Kojo’s good-faith estimate as of the date of the job posting and may be modified in the future.

Benefits: This position is also eligible for a new hire equity grant and all US-based full time employees are eligible for our full suite of perks and benefits. For more information about our perks and benefits, check out

Location: Kojo’s team members work from home 100% of the time across North and South America. If applicable, we’ll identify the travel and/or location-specific requirements of a position in the text above. Otherwise, team members can expect to work business hours congruent with their local time zone and remotely.

Inclusive Workplace: Kojo values diverse perspectives and is committed to building an inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, citizenship, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.



Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of Kojo. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Kojo will never ask for any personal account information, such credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for full stack engineers to build fast across BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for product-minded engineers who can move across frontend, backend, internal tools and customer journeys to turn ideas into working products quickly.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship full product features across frontend, backend, APIs and databases.

  • Create customer and internal workflows for onboarding, accounts, payments, rewards, travel, FX, support automation, KYC and risk.

  • Turn ambiguous product problems into working systems with clean UX and reliable backend logic.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI engineers to launch fast and improve after release.

  • Build internal tools and automation that reduce manual work and help teams operate at scale.

  • Own your work beyond release: monitor, debug, learn and improve.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong full stack engineering experience with real shipped products.

  • Comfortable across frontend, backend, APIs, databases and production debugging.

  • Good frontend execution using React, Next.js, Vue or similar modern stack.

  • Good backend fundamentals around APIs, data models, authentication, integrations and reliability.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify messy workflows.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and own outcomes end-to-end.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want to work on one narrow layer.

  • People who need complete specs before starting.

  • Developers who ship UI without understanding backend or operations impact.

  • Candidates who avoid production support.

  • People who make vague claims without showing real shipped work.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Portugal. We are hiring for this market specifically, so applicants should already be based in Portugal.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

About the Role:

Join our Revenue Operations team as a business partner to our growing Payer and Operations organizations, as well as provide data-driven strategic insights. You'll own the operational support of our channel customer journey, building the data, metrics, and operating cadence that drive measurable growth.

This is a senior, outcomes-focused role. Success means proactively turning complex data into clear recommendations, moving work from analysis to action, and driving cross-functional alignment to deliver results.

What You’ll Own:

  • Upskill and uptool the Payer Access organization to drive scale and growth in a highly complex environment.
  • Build and maintain a unified Payer Access data model, standardizing funnel stages, metrics, and attribution.
  • Identify and resolve data gaps, system disconnects, and process inefficiencies.
  • Develop dashboards and insights that help field reps and leaders improve funnel health, lead progression, deal closure, retention, account management prioritization, leading to enrollment and revenue growth.
  • Lead stakeholder reviews with clear recommendations, strategic insights, decisions, owners, and next steps.
  • Partner with field teams to build practical analytics that incorporate frontline insights and drive productivity.
  • Collaborate across Operations, Marketing, Product and Engineering, Channel Sales/Channel Growth, Alliances, Employer Sales, and Customer Experience to improve data quality, integrations, and reporting.
  • Establish operating rhythms to track funnel performance, drive accountability, and enable continuous improvement.
  • Lead payer annual planning, including capacity, territories, quotas, incentive compensation, roadmaps, and targeting.

About You:

You have built or optimized multi-stage funnels across systems and teams, bringing structure to ambiguous, fragmented data through strong data modeling, systems thinking, and stakeholder influence.

  • You ship. A strong bias toward action; you move work from analysis to decision to completion on time with clear milestones, flagging timeline changes before they impact stakeholders.
  • You lead with the “so what.” You distill complexity into a clear takeaway, business impact, and recommended action—enabling decisions rather than further exploration—and resist unnecessary metric complexity.
  • You prioritize ruthlessly. You scope tightly, focus on the highest-impact work, and decline or defer lower-value requests rather than spreading effort thin.
  • You create clarity for others. You drive discussions to decisions, owners, and next steps, bring proposed paths forward rather than escalating ambiguity, and own business outcomes end-to-end.
  • You build with the field, not just for it. You incorporate frontline intelligence so the people who use your models trust and adopt them.

What You Bring:

  • 7+ years in Revenue Operations, Growth Operations, or Analytics within complex, multi-system environments.
  • Experience building and optimizing end-to-end funnels (B2B2C, marketplace, healthcare, or lifecycle marketing preferred).
  • Proven ability to deliver decision-ready analyses on time and translate complex data into clear recommendations for executive audiences.
  • Strong judgment in balancing analytical rigor with speed, defining scope, and knowing when insights are actionable.
  • Demonstrated success driving cross-functional alignment and influencing stakeholders independently.
  • Strong analytical skills (Excel, BI tools; SQL a plus) with expertise in funnel metrics, conversion analysis, and operating models.
  • Experience partnering with Customer Success, Sales, or Growth teams to drive behavior change and improve business outcomes.
  • Experience with healthcare data, eligibility files, or similar data ingestion workflows preferred.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

raw.description:
Harris Computer is hiring a Staff AI Engineer (QA) to join their, expanding team! We’re seeking a seasoned expert to pioneer the quality and reliability of our cutting-edge AI and machine learning solutions for healthcare. As a Staff AI Engineer focused on Quality Assurance, you will be the technical authority responsible for ensuring our AI systems are robust, fair, accurate, and safe.


This is a unique opportunity to define the future of AI quality in a domain where it matters most, mentoring a talented team and establishing the gold standard for testing intelligent systems that impact patient care.


This is a full-time, remote position open to candidates in the U.S. or Canada.


What your impact will be:

  • Build the core AI system end-to-end, from the service layer and data pipelines to the evaluation infrastructure, and own its architecture.
  • Design and build the evaluation infrastructure, including dataset management, automated test harnesses, and replay of AI systems against historical workflows.
  • Build and maintain evaluation datasets with clinician-reviewed correct answers, ensuring they evolve as our systems change.
  • Create error metrics weighted by severity, so mistakes with clinical or financial impact are prioritized accordingly.
  • Build production monitoring for accuracy, overrides, and safety issues, with actionable alerts for the engineering team.
  • Write adversarial tests for AI systems, including hidden or malicious instructions in documents and invented content.
  • Work with product and clinical leads to define accuracy thresholds and the criteria for expanding or pulling back an AI capability.
  • The candidate must possess a curiosity and willingness to actively adopt and leverage emerging AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and drive efficiency along with being comfortable using a range of AI-enabled tools (such as copilots, chat-based AI, and automation solutions) as part of everyday work.

What we’re looking for:

  • 7 or more years in software or machine learning engineering, with at least 3 years focused on evaluation, testing, or quality for AI systems.
  • A track record of designing and building complete systems from scratch, taking them from prototype to production.
  • A track record of building and running evaluation systems that teams use in production, not just for one-off analyses.
  • At least 2 years of experience evaluating large language model (LLM) systems in a production environment.
  • Strong statistical skills for measuring accuracy, including sampling, confidence intervals, and error analysis.
  • 1 year + of experience designing evaluation sets for document extraction, classification, or structured output.
  • Deep knowledge of explainable AI (XAI) techniques and AI-powered tools (e.g., SHAP, LIME, Claude).
  • Clear written communication, including design documents, and the ability to explain complex trade-offs to clinicians, engineers, and executives.

What would make you stand out:

  • Experience working within the healthcare or another highly regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with AI-specific testing techniques like metamorphic testing, adversarial testing, or data validation with tools like Great Expectations.
  • A history of mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction across multiple teams.

What we offer:

  • Plenty of opportunities to grow your career
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • 3 weeks of vacation plus 5 personal days to recharge
  • Employee stock ownership, RRSP program, 401k matching
  • A chance to give back through community involvement
  • Flexible work arrangements to suit your lifestyle

Salary range: $120,000-160,000 USD depending on experience and qualifications.

About Harris Computer:

Harris provides mission critical software solutions for the Public Sector, Healthcare, Utilities and Private Sector verticals throughout North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.

Working for Harris is the perfect opportunity to fulfill your professional goals as well as achieve your personal dreams!

Our employees enjoy a casual work environment that offers comfort while providing superior service to our customers. We offer a comprehensive benefit package as well as other additional “Perks”!

  • We empower our employees to make a difference
  • We have an award-winning culture
  • We offer opportunity to learn
  • We are financially strong and we are owned by the largest software company in Canada (CSI)
  • We have fun!

raw.excerpt: About the Role We are looking for a friendly, proactive and organised Patient Intake & Customer Service Specialist to support the intake process for families seeking autism services.
raw.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a friendly, proactive and organised Patient Intake & Customer Service Specialist to support the intake process for families seeking autism services.

In this role, you will be one of the first points of contact for parents, guiding them through the initial intake process, explaining requirements, collecting necessary information and ensuring all outstanding documentation is received.

This is a communication-heavy, outbound calling role that requires someone who is confident speaking with parents, comfortable handling a high volume of calls and able to take ownership of follow-ups without constant supervision.

You do not need previous ABA or autism services experience. The client is happy to provide training to someone with strong customer service skills, excellent communication and a genuine willingness to learn.

Requirements


Key Responsibilities

1. Parent Communication & Customer Service

  • Make outbound calls to parents seeking autism services and assist them with the initial intake process.
  • Communicate calmly, professionally and empathetically with parents, understanding that families may be navigating a sensitive or stressful situation.
  • Clearly explain intake requirements, next steps and any outstanding information needed.
  • Respond to questions and provide helpful guidance throughout the intake process.
  • Maintain a friendly, approachable and professional manner during all interactions.

2. Intake Coordination & Documentation

  • Guide parents through the intake process and assist with completing the required forms.
  • Send intake forms and follow up to ensure they are completed and returned.
  • Request outstanding documents and information needed to progress each case.
  • Contact doctors' offices and other relevant parties to obtain missing documentation where necessary.
  • Monitor each case and ensure outstanding requirements are followed up on until resolved.

3. Outbound Calling & Daily Activity Targets

  • Make a minimum of 50 outbound call attempts per day, with a target of approximately 80 attempts daily.
  • Maintain consistent follow-up with parents and other relevant parties.
  • Ensure calls, conversations and follow-up activities are accurately recorded.
  • Manage a high volume of daily activity while maintaining a good standard of customer service.

4. Administration, Tracking & Reporting

  • Update call records, communication notes and intake progress in Monday.com daily.
  • Maintain accurate daily spreadsheets tracking calls, intake forms sent, follow-ups and related activity.
  • Keep intake records organised and ensure all case information is up to date.
  • Identify outstanding items and take responsibility for following up to keep cases moving.

5. Communication & Team Support

  • Communicate questions, challenges and progress updates directly to Eliana.
  • Raise potential delays or issues that may prevent an intake from progressing.
  • Work independently while following the client's established processes and guidance.
  • Take ownership of daily responsibilities and ensure follow-ups are not left incomplete.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Previous customer service, client support, patient services, intake or administrative experience is preferred.
  • Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.
  • Confident making outbound calls and speaking with different people throughout the day.
  • Strong listening skills and the ability to communicate with empathy and patience.
  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets and updating digital records.
  • Able to manage multiple cases and follow-ups simultaneously.
  • Strong initiative and the ability to work independently without constant prompting.
  • Reliable, consistent and comfortable working towards daily activity targets.
  • Good problem-solving skills and the ability to identify what needs to happen next.

Preferred Experience

  • Previous experience in healthcare, medical administration, patient intake or referral coordination.
  • Experience handling high-volume outbound calls.
  • Familiarity with Monday.com or similar task and workflow management platforms.
  • Experience collecting patient information, coordinating forms or obtaining supporting documentation.

Previous ABA or autism services experience is not required. Training will be provided.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Friendly, warm and naturally comfortable speaking to people.
  • Calm, patient and empathetic when dealing with parents and families.
  • A clear and confident communicator who can hold natural conversations without relying heavily on scripts.
  • Proactive and takes ownership of tasks and outstanding follow-ups.
  • Quick-thinking, resourceful and comfortable asking questions when needed.
  • Highly organised and consistent with daily administration.
  • Hardworking, dependable and motivated by achieving daily activity targets.

This role is best suited to someone who enjoys speaking with people, takes pride in helping others and knows how to keep things moving without needing to be reminded of every next step.

What We're Researching

We're running a paid study on clinical dermatology image classification to improve diagnostic accuracy tools. This work feeds into a larger initiative to standardize how skin conditions are visually assessed. We need experienced practitioners to help build a reliable foundation of expertly annotated medical images.

How It Works

You will participate in an independent image-annotation task reviewing approximately 200 clinical dermatology images. For each image, you will complete a short standardized form to classify the visual presentation. The estimated time to review and annotate each image is 1-2 minutes. This is a fully asynchronous desktop activity that you can complete at your own pace.

Who This Is For

We are looking for medical professionals with dedicated clinical experience in dermatology. We welcome board-certified dermatologists, dermatology residents, physician assistants specializing in dermatology, and dermatology nurse practitioners. You must be comfortable making clinical assessments based solely on visual evidence.

What You'll Do

  • Review approximately 200 clinical dermatology images independently

  • Complete a short standardized assessment form for each provided image

  • Assess and classify visual presentations of various skin conditions

  • Maintain a consistent pace of 1-2 minutes per image during the review process

Who Should Apply

  • Active clinical experience in dermatology

  • Comfortable assessing medical images without full patient histories

  • Access to a reliable desktop or laptop computer for the annotation platform

Compensation

$210 per hour

Start your paid interview now

Terac is building the world's largest pool of vetted human experts for AI. Researchers, AI labs, and product teams use Terac to recruit, screen, and pay study participants across industries, languages, and skill sets.

Best Life

ABC Fitness is seeking an Associate General Counsel to lead a significant portfolio of legal work across our global software, payments, and fitness technology business. Reporting to the General Counsel, this leader will provide hands-on legal guidance on complex commercial matters and strategic partnerships while coaching and developing a strong, responsive legal team.

This role is accountable for legal outcomes across functions, not solely individual matters. The Associate General Counsel will advise executive stakeholders, lead selected complex matters and negotiations, establish scalable decision frameworks, and develop a strong legal team with clear ownership and sound judgment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own legal strategy and outcomes for an assigned portfolio spanning enterprise commercial contracting, strategic partnerships, privacy, regulatory advisory, and other business-critical matters; set clear priorities and service expectations while remaining engaged in the most consequential or complex legal work.
  • Lead, coach, and develop legal professionals through hands-on mentorship, performance management, succession planning, capacity allocation, and thoughtful delegation; build a team that exercises sound judgment and independently manages appropriate matters.
  • Lead selected high-impact SaaS, software licensing, payments, vendor, enterprise customer, and strategic partnership negotiations; direct legal strategy across the broader transaction portfolio, coach attorneys through difficult negotiations, and set consistent risk-based escalation and approval standards.
  • Serve as a strategic legal partner to Product, Technology, Sales, Partnerships, Finance, People, and Operations leadership; influence cross-functional decisions involving new offerings, integrations, data rights, intellectual property, liability, and commercial commitments.
  • Set a coordinated legal approach to privacy, data protection, and responsible AI-related risks, working with subject matter experts on governance, international data transfers, contractual safeguards, incidents, and evolving regulatory obligations.
  • Oversee material legal and compliance risks touching software, payments, consumer protection, employment and personnel matters, including sensitive employee claims, disputes and litigation, and cross-border operations; elevate significant issues to the General Counsel with clear options and recommended actions.
  • Own legal operating effectiveness within the assigned portfolio, including resource and budget stewardship, outside counsel oversight, matter prioritization, contracting playbooks, and service metrics; balance hands-on deal support with sustainable team capacity and scalable ways of working.
  • Lead cross-functional improvements to legal governance and technology-enabled workflows, including responsible use of automation and AI-assisted tools, while protecting confidentiality, privilege, accuracy, and legal judgment.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Juris Doctor (JD) or qualifying equivalent law degree and active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.
  • Extensive, progressively responsible legal experience in SaaS, software, technology, payments, fintech, or similarly complex commercial environments, with demonstrated success advising executive stakeholders, exercising independent legal judgment, and managing consequential legal matters.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and developing legal professionals, including direct people management, effective delegation, feedback, performance management, and a willingness to work alongside the team on complex matters when needed.
  • Experience setting priorities and exercising delegated decision-making authority over a broad, high-stakes legal portfolio, including organizational trade-offs, complex escalations, and decisions that affect multiple business functions.
  • Expertise in leading sophisticated commercial deals and partnerships, including software and technology contracting, strategic negotiations, intellectual property and data rights, and enterprise risk allocation; able to remain an effective practicing counsel while developing others.
  • Ability to guide privacy, data protection, regulatory, and AI-related legal questions through effective specialist collaboration, pragmatic controls, and clear executive advice.
  • Experience partnering directly with executive leadership and influencing decisions across multiple functions and jurisdictions, including experience supporting legal matters in a multinational business environment.
  • Sound business judgment, concise executive communication, disciplined resource management, and an inclusive leadership approach grounded in collaboration and continuous improvement.

AND IT'S GREAT TO HAVE

  • Experience in a global, private equity-backed SaaS, payments, or technology company.
  • Direct involvement with payment processing partnerships, platform integrations, channel agreements, or multinational commercial structures.
  • Familiarity with GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other cross-border privacy and technology regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience designing legal department operating models, budgeting, contract lifecycle management, and service metrics.
  • Experience shaping practical governance for AI-enabled products or implementing responsible AI-assisted legal operations.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Legal team performance: A capable team operates with clear priorities, strong development plans, defined decision rights, and consistent accountability. The Associate General Counsel remains directly involved in selected high-impact matters while coaching others to take ownership.
  • Enterprise impact: Executives receive timely, practical guidance on significant commercial, partnership, and regulatory decisions, including direct counsel from the Associate General Counsel on high-stakes matters.
  • Risk stewardship: Material legal risks are identified early, routed through effective governance, and managed in proportion to business impact.
  • Operational scale: Contracting, external counsel utilization, and legal service delivery improve in predictability, consistency, and efficiency.
  • Cross-functional trust: Legal is recognized as a collaborative partner that helps ABC innovate and grow responsibly.

About the Role:

We are seeking an exceptional Data Analyst to join our DIG (Data & Insights Group) team. Our team delivers insightful, high-quality dashboards, pipelines, and reports to internal teams delivering value that would have otherwise been overlooked. Think of us like bridge builders: we build the support beams, develop the infrastructure, and create the custom analyses that allow other teams to leverage data to make decisions.

The Data Analyst leverages advanced analytical techniques and business knowledge to support data-driven decision-making across multiple business departments. Since one of DIG’s main goals is to uncover hidden but valuable insights, you will explore ad data for opportunities and bring them forward with evidence and recommendations.You will also collaborate with stakeholders to develop visualizations and reports that effectively communicate findings, while supporting process improvements and project delivery.

  • Own internal client-facing analysis end-to-end. This means you will build, maintain and produce key reports for internal clients across our data ecosystem, from scoping to delivery
  • Be a thought partner for our client-facing teams (especially sales). Here you will use a deep understanding of both the external client’s needs and the adtech ecosystem to partner with stakeholders, answering questions via analytically robust reports and presentations.

Ad tech is an exciting, ever-evolving landscape that takes patience to fully understand (and even then you’ll still need to continue learning) so you need to have a love for learning.

  • Bachelor's Degree OR 3+ years of related experience (Required)

  • Track record of translating data insights into actionable recommendations for stakeholders.

Benefits

  • Half-Day Fridays (except Q4)
  • Team Happy camaraderie—celebrating wins, learning from challenges, and fostering continuous career growth
  • A workplace culture where you can be yourself, contribute meaningfully, and be valued for your impact
Compensation: $75,000 - $95,000 total compensation, inclusive of base pay ($67,500-$83,000) and bonuses. Compensation range will be determined by each candidate's location and expertise.

Location: This opportunity is Remote in the United States, except for candidates within commuting distance of our NYC or Chicago offices, where this opportunity is hybrid with 3 days in the office.

What you'll bring

Most companies talk about AI. The harder thing is knowing what to do with it. Customers today don't need an introduction to the technology. They need someone who can look at how their business actually works, understand where the pressure is, and tell them honestly what AI can change and what it can't. That's the conversation at the heart of these roles. At SAP, you'll be working across 25 industries with some of the most complex organisations in the world, including 97 of the world's 100 most sustainable companies. If AI is what gets you out of bed, this is where that goes somewhere real.

You are at the start of your commercial career and ready to build it in enterprise technology. No prior experience in sales is required — what matters is your curiosity, your communication instincts, and your drive to learn how to turn conversations into pipeline. You will be joining a team where AI tools are part of everyday selling, and where the foundations you build now will shape everything that follows. You build trust through clear communication, bring emotional intelligence to every interaction, and solve problems with a customer-focused mindset.

  • Genuine curiosity about how businesses operate and how technology is reshaping the way companies grow — and the appetite to develop that interest into real commercial expertise
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage professionally with new contacts and internal stakeholders across digital and direct channels
  • A willingness to develop cold outreach skills, including cold calling, through structured coaching and live practice in a fully supported environment
  • Comfort learning and applying digital tools and AI-powered sales platforms as part of everyday work, with an open and experimental approach to new ways of working
  • The ability to research accounts and industries, gathering prospect intelligence that sharpens outreach and supports early-stage campaign preparation
  • An organised, detail-oriented approach — you follow through, manage your time well, and take ownership of the work you are given
  • Degree not required for this role.

We also look for people who build trust naturally, communicate with clarity, keep the customer at the centre of what they do, and bring emotional intelligence and genuine problem-solving ability to the challenges they face.

In addition to the skills and experience specific to this role, all positions at SAP require candidates who are comfortable using AI tools — including agentic AI — in their day-to-day work, from crafting effective inputs and automating routine tasks, to evaluating AI-generated outputs for quality and driving adoption of AI practices within their teams.

What you'll build

You will take your first steps in enterprise technology sales — developing the skills, habits, and commercial instincts that will grow with you across your career. Working alongside experienced Digital Demand Managers and sales development colleagues, you will contribute to real pipeline generation from the outset and build a foundation that positions you for progression.

  • Support multi-touch digital outreach campaigns by preparing prospect research, building account context, and contributing to engagement activity across new and existing accounts
  • Begin applying AI value selling techniques and strategic AI synthesis under guidance, developing your ability to personalise outreach and position SAP's capabilities in early-stage conversations
  • Develop your sales qualification skills — learning to evaluate leads, document opportunities accurately, and prepare clean, well-structured handovers that support the Digital Sales pipeline
  • Build cold calling confidence through structured coaching, live practice, and real-time feedback — opening new conversations and contributing to account coverage across your territory
  • Work closely with Digital Demand Managers and senior colleagues to build your understanding of territory management, pipeline fundamentals, and consistent customer engagement

Where you belong

You will be part of the Customer Value Group — a global sales community that believes in building careers, not just filling roles. As early talent, you will be mentored day-to-day by experienced sales development colleagues, supported by structured academies and certifications, and given genuine territory exposure from the start. The team values curiosity as much as commercial drive, and it invests in the people who show up ready to learn and grow. There is a clear path forward — from the skills you develop here to the level you reach next. This is a community that grows with you, and a first step in enterprise technology sales that genuinely goes somewhere.

As we transform into the autonomous enterprise, we are proactively engaging with talent who will play a key role in building the capabilities required to deliver on our 2027 priorities.

With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives.
As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience.

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone, regardless of background, feels included and can run at their best. You bring the core capabilities of a Workday Delivery Lead across Financials, HCM or full-platform (Financials and HCM) programs, along with an understanding of how Workday opportunities are won, and the ability to turn delivery experience into clear, credible content and staffing support for the sales cycle.

The Work:

As the Go To Market (GTM) Lead, you will connect delivery with the Edge Workday sales team to support the growth of the delivery portfolio. You will take input from the sales team on the assets they need, coordinate with functional and technical leads to produce polished, prospect-facing content such as case studies, reference materials and solution overviews, and coordinate GTM webinars. You will ramp up delivery resources to support sales cycles and coordinate the individuals who support sales opportunities. You will be responsible for client success and the referenceability of the projects you lead.

As the Delivery Lead, you will team with mid-market clients on their Workday transformation programs through your combined mid-market and Workday delivery expertise, which includes your ability to:

· Lead day-to-day delivery of Workday Financials, HCM or full-platform programs for mid-market clients across solution design, budget management, resource planning and quality assurance

· Serve as the primary escalation point for delivery issues, proactively identifying risks and implementing mitigation strategies

· Partner with client stakeholders to align on scope, timelines and deliverable expectations throughout the project lifecycle

· Manage onshore/offshore delivery team structures, coordinating across time zones for seamless execution and knowledge transfer

· Drive cutover planning, rehearsals and execution, ensuring a controlled and successful transition to the live Workday environment

· Oversee project financials, including EAC, revenue recognition, margin management and change order processing

· Facilitate governance rituals, including steering committee meetings, project status reporting and executive briefings

· Ensure adherence to Accenture delivery standards, quality frameworks and client contractual obligations

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements


What You Need

  • Active Workday Pro certification in Financials (such as Record to Report) or HCM (such as HCM Core)
  • A minimum of 12 years of experience in enterprise technology delivery or project leadership, including at least 5 years of hands-on Workday functional experience in Financials and/or HCM
  • A minimum of 3 full-lifecycle Workday implementations managed end to end, from initiation through go-live and hypercare, with accountability for scope, schedule and delivery quality across teams of 5+ resources
  • A minimum of 3 years leading offshore or distributed delivery teams of 5+ resources across 2+ time zones
  • A minimum of 3 years of executive-level stakeholder engagement, including steering committee presentations, escalation management and status reporting to VP-level or C-suite audiences
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent (12 years) work experience (If an Associate’s Degree, 6 years of work experience)

Bonus Points If:

  • Experience delivering Workday solutions for mid-market clients (revenues of about $300M to $3B) and familiarity with their constraints and compressed timelines
  • Experience delivering both Workday Financials and HCM, including full-platform programs
  • Active PMP (Project Management Professional) certification from PMI
  • A minimum of 2 go-live cutovers managed, including cutover runbooks, mock cutovers and go/no-go decisions
  • A minimum of 3 years managing project financials, resource plans and delivery risk across 3+ simultaneous workstreams
  • Familiarity with Workday deployment methodology and agile delivery practices
  • Experience supporting pre-sales or go-to-market activities, such as proposals, solution orals, client demos or webinars

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. IT Manager

Position Title: IT Manager

Department: Global Resource Team

Reports to: CFO/COO

This position is: Full time and exempt; support-raised

Location: Dallas, TX or remote

The IT Manager plays a key role in managing and advancing the organization’s technology infrastructure, systems, and security posture. This position oversees IT operations, drives the integration, evaluation and implementation of new platforms and systems, and ensures that all technology solutions align with organizational goals and compliance standards. The IT Manager also serves as the primary point of contact for cybersecurity, system performance, data storage/backup and technology risk management while providing guidance and technology support to staff across all departments.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Launch Global is both an equal opportunity employer and a Christian organization. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, age, or disability of a qualified individual in accordance with applicable federal and state law.

Pursuant to Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, as amended (42 U.S.C. § 2000e-1(a)), Launch Global hires individuals who affirm and adhere to our Statement of Faith and agree to conduct themselves in accordance with our sincerely held religious beliefs.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Systems & Platform Management

    • Lead the evaluation, selection, and implementation of new systems, platforms, and tools to improve efficiency and scalability.
    • Own system lifecycle management; including integration, updates, vendor coordination, and documentation.
    • Partner with leadership and department heads to identify technology needs and recommend solutions aligned with organization objectives.

Cybersecurity & Risk Management

    • Develop, implement, and maintain cybersecurity policies, procedures, and best practices.
    • Monitor and respond to potential security threats, vulnerabilities, and incidents.
    • Conduct regular system audits, data protection reviews, and compliance assessments.
    • Manage backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity processes.

Website & Digital Systems Maintenance

    • Maintain and oversee organizational external website(s) as well as internal staff intranet, ensuring functionality, security, and alignment with brand and communication goals.
    • Coordinate with the Communications team to implement web updates, integrations, and performance improvements.
    • Provide internal IT oversight for externally sourced website development.
    • Monitor web hosting, analytics, and domain management.

Support & Training

    • Provide advanced technical support to staff and manage escalation of IT issues.
    • Train employees on cybersecurity awareness and efficient use of systems.
    • Champion and train on secure AI solutions for the operations team and other departments.
    • Develop and maintain IT documentation, guides, and asset inventories.

Strategic & Administrative

    • Partner with leadership on IT budgeting, procurement, and technology roadmapping.
    • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic initiatives for digital transformation.
    • Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and organizational policies.
    • Proactively identify and execute technology improvements.

General Characteristics and Skills

    • Displays a track record of achieving results by relying on God in prayer and humility exercised in bold faith.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
    • Displays values of humility, eagerness, and excellence.
    • Excellent organizational and time management skills, including ability to prioritize appropriately.
    • Ability to juggle multiple tasks seamlessly.
    • Solid judgment and decision-making skills.
    • Interpersonal skills on par with the ability to meet and exceed these particular job expectations.
    • Ability to foster team development and healthy team culture.
    • Work well under pressure and deadlines.
    • Willingness to pursue a healthy work, life balance.
    • Ability to assess and implement improvements.
    • Ability to think critically and resourcefully.
    • Willingness to receive coaching and make necessary changes based on feedback from the development team and other leaders.

Additional Job Requirements

    • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
    • Undergraduate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
    • 5+ years of progressively responsible experience in IT systems administration, cybersecurity, or infrastructure management.
    • Ministry/nonprofit experience preferred.
    • Experience leading platform evaluations and system implementations.
    • Experience integrating multiple systems or platforms to improve efficiency and workflow.
    • Raise and maintain financial support for support-raised-position (Ministry Partner Development).
    • Participation in the monthly Day of Prayer and Evaluation (DOPE).
    • Understand, affirm and adhere to Launch Global’s Statement of Faith.
    • Agree to uphold Launch Global’s Vision and Mission
      • Vision: The multiplication of healthy churches among unreached people groups.
      • Mission: Launch Global exists to mobilize churches to develop laborers and leaders who multiply healthy churches among unreached people groups.
    • Demonstrate all the character, Launch Global, and biblical values as stated in the Launch Global Staff Handbook.
    • Uphold a close and growing relationship with Jesus Christ.
    • Participate in a child safety training program upon hire and other similar employment-related requirements.
    • Travel approximately 10% per year to attend Launch Global conferences, retreats, and in-person meetings.

Have questions about support raising? Check out our Ministry Partner Development (MPD) 101 document!

raw.description:
My jsme Teya!

Teya vznikla na základě jednoduchého přesvědčení: lokální podniky si zaslouží víc.

Jsou to kavárny, restaurace, salony, obchody a podnikatelé, kteří vdechují život našim ulicím, vytvářejí pracovní místa a drží komunity pohromadě. Finanční služby jim však život příliš dlouho jen ztěžovaly – zbytečně složitými nástroji, špatnou podporou a komplexností, která je při podnikání jen brzdí.

Teya existuje proto, aby to změnila.

Budujeme finanční platformu pro lokální podniky po celé Evropě – platformu postavenou na jednoduchých nástrojích, propracovaném designu a reálné lidské podpoře. Naši členové na nás spoléhají, že jim pomůžeme podnikat s jistotou, a tato zodpovědnost formuje způsob, jakým pracujeme. Postupujeme rychle. Záleží nám na kvalitě. Jdeme do hloubky detailů. A věříme, že skvělé výsledky a upřímná pohostinnost by měly jít ruku v ruce.

Pokud chceš vytvářet smysluplné produkty, řešit reálné problémy a přinést lokálním podnikům skutečnou změnu, ozvi se nám!

Co tě u nás čeká? 🚀

Hledáme obchodníka do terénu, který se připojí k našemu rychle rostoucímu obchodnímu týmu. Je to skvělá příležitost pro každého, kdo chce nastartovat kariéru v obchodu, rozvíjet reálné komerční dovednosti a růst v dynamicky se rozvíjející firmě.

  • Akce v terénu: Tvým úkolem je aktivně oslovovat majitele obchodů, restaurací nebo kaváren. Ukážeš jim, jak jim Teya usnadní život, a že jsme pro ně ta nejlepší volba.

  • Přímý kontakt: Osobní setkání s majiteli firem, pochopení jejich potřeb, výzev a cílů a doporučení těch správných produktů a řešení od Teyy.

  • Budování vztahů: Prodejem to u nás nekončí. S klienty zůstáváš v kontaktu, pomáháš jim s nastavením a staráš se o to, aby byli dlouhodobě spokojení.

  • Učení a aplikace: Znalost našich produktů a řešení, kterou získáš díky našemu strukturovanému tréninkovému programu.

  • Týmová podpora: Nejsi na to sám. V týmu si radíme a sdílíme tipy. Navíc se inspirujeme od kolegů z Velké Británie, Maďarska, Chorvatska nebo Islandu.

  • Zpětná vazba: Sdílení zpětné vazby z terénu, která nám pomáhá zlepšovat naše produkty a zákaznickou zkušenost.

Co k tomu potřebuješ? ✅

  • Jazyky:Češtinu/slovenštinu (C1) a angličtinu na plynulé úrovni (B2) – budeš v kontaktu s českými klienty i kolegy ze zahraničí.

  • Drive: Zkušenost s obchodem alespoň 1 rok, práce s klienty, vedení obchodních jednání, plánování, reportování a doručování cílů.

  • Komunikace: Musíš si umět s lidmi povídat, vysvětlit jim složité věci jednoduše a umět je přesvědčit.

  • Týmový duch: I když jsi v terénu sólo, pořád jsi součástí party, která táhne za jeden provaz. Mrkni na náš Instagram @, ať vidíš, s kým do toho jdeš!

  • Odolnost: Fintech roste raketově. Musíš umět reagovat na změny a nebát se dynamického prostředí.

Co za to?💰

  • Férová fixní mzda + motivující bonusy – tvoje snaha se cení!

  • Flexibilita – nemáme pevnou pracovní dobu a na home office se vždy domluvíme

  • 26 dní volna + 3 sick days – protože odpočinek je základ

  • BenefitPlus karta, Stravenky a Příspěvek na Dopravu (Lítačka) – vše, co potřebuješ pro pohodlný pracovní život, od Multisportky přes obědy až pocestování po městě.

  • Péče o duševní zdraví s Hedepy – abychom ti pomohli udržet si psychickou pohodu a balanc.

  • Pravidelné týmové meetingy a školení – dny plné inspirace, sdílení zkušeností, skvělé atmosféry i příběhů našich zákazníků

Chceš do toho jít?

Celý proces se snažíme držet svižný a přátelský – stejně jako naše kultura. Žádná zbytečná kola navíc, ale férový a otevřený přístup.

💥 Přihlas se hned teď a do pár dnů se ti ozveme! 🚀

Job Description

Join Us as a Clinical Trial Coordinator – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to provide administrative and technical support to the Project Team. As a Clinical Trial Coordinator, you'll coordinate and facilitate project activities and may serve as a study lead, acting as a cross-functional liaison for the project team. You will act as a buddy during the onboarding phase and provide training to new staff as needed. Additionally, you will support departmental and cross-functional initiatives for process improvements and enhancements.

What You’ll Do:

  • According to the specific role (Local), coordinates, oversees and completes functions on assigned trials activities detailed on the task matrix.
    • Performs department, Internal, Country and Investigator file reviews as assigned and documents findings in appropriate system.
    • Ensures allocated tasks are performed on time, within budget and to a high quality standard. Proactively communicates any risks to project leads and line manager as appropriate.
    • Supports the maintenance of study specific documentation and global support with specific systems, tools and trackers including but not limited to: study team lists, tracking of project specific training requirements, system access management for organization/vendor/clients, and tracking of project level activity plans in appropriate system. Ensures (e)TMF is up to date by following file review schedules and documents findings in appropriate system.
    • Provides system support (i.e. GoBalto & eTMF).
    • Supports RBM activities.
    • Performs administrative tasks on assigned trials including but not limited to: timely processing of documents sent to Client (e)TMF as assigned, performing (e)TMF reviews, performing mass mailings and communications as needed, providing documents and reports to internal team members.
    • Supports scheduling and organization of client and/or internal meetings with completion of related meeting minutes.
    • Reviews and tracks local regulatory documents.
    • Transmits documents to client and centralized IRB/IEC.
    • Analyzes and reconciles study metrics and findings reports. Assists with clarification and resolution of findings related to site documentation.
    • Maintains vendor trackers.
    • Assists with coordination, compilation and distribution of Investigator Site File (ISF) and Pharmacy binder materials and non-clinical study supplies to sites.
    • Assists with study-specific translation materials and translation QC upon request.
    • May attend Kick off meeting and take notes when required.

    Education and Experience Requirements:
    •Bachelor's degree in Life Science.
    •Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (preferred).
    In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

    Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
    • Ability to work in a team or independently as required
    • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with proven ability to handle multiple tasks efficiently and effectively
    • Proven ability to effectively analyze project-specific data/systems to ensure accuracy and efficiency
    • Strong customer focus
    • Demonstrated flexibility and adaptability to reprioritize workload and provide efficient support to meet changing project timelines
    • Demonstrated ability to attain and maintain a good working knowledge of applicable Country Regulations, ICH Good Clinical Practices, and organization/Client SOPs and WPDs for all non-clinical/clinical aspects of project implementation, execution and closeout
    • Excellent English language and grammar skills and proficient local language skills as needed
    • Good presentation skills
    • Excellent computer skills, proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and ability to obtain knowledge and master all clinical trial database systems
    • Ability to successfully complete PPD clinical training program
    • Self-motivated, positive attitude with effective strong interpersonal skills

    Working Conditions and Environment:
    •Work is performed in an office or home office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
    •Occasional drives to site locations. Potential Occasional travel required
