raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Build backend services, APIs and workflows for the AI Neobank app.

  • Support products across insurance, payments, wallet, savings, investing, travel and financial services.

  • Design reliable systems for user accounts, transactions, partner integrations, reconciliation, notifications and operations.

  • Work with product and mobile teams to ship customer-facing journeys quickly.

  • Integrate with banks, payment gateways, insurers, data providers and other partners.

  • Improve system reliability, observability, security and performance.

  • Build systems that are practical, auditable and ready for regulated financial products.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of backend engineering experience.

  • Strong fundamentals in APIs, databases, system design and production debugging.

  • Experience building scalable services and integrating third-party systems.

  • Good understanding of security, reliability, data quality and operational edge cases.

  • Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, quality and risk.

  • Comfortable working with product, mobile, operations and business teams.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, insurance, lending, banking or regulated products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Builds systems that work in the real world, not just on diagrams.

  • Thinks through edge cases, failure modes and operational impact.

  • Can move fast without creating fragile foundations.

  • Takes ownership of production issues and long-term reliability.

  • Explains clearly what they personally built versus what the team delivered.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.

  • People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk.

  • Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.

  • Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems.

  • People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Singapore. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Singapore.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Alleyoop is a beauty brand built around easy, effective makeup, sold directly to consumers through our website, retail partners, and TikTok Shop. Creators are central to how we tell our story, connect with customers, and grow our brand.

We're expanding our marketing team and looking for an experienced Creator Partnerships Manager to help strengthen our creator community, drive engaging content, and grow our affiliate and social commerce programs.

About the role

We're looking for a Creator Partnerships Manager to manage and grow our creator and influencer partnerships across TikTok Shop, Trybe, LTK, Instagram, and other social platforms.

Reporting to the Social Commerce Director, you'll take ownership of day-to-day creator relationships, partnership execution, gifting programs, and content coordination while identifying opportunities to improve engagement, content quality, and performance.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands creator marketing, knows how to build strong relationships with influencers, and can independently manage multiple campaigns and partnerships.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, commercially minded, and comfortable working in a fast-paced beauty or consumer brand environment.

Key responsibilities:

Creator Partnerships & Relationship Management

  • Manage and strengthen relationships with creators, influencers, and affiliate partners across TikTok Shop, Trybe, LTK, Instagram, and other platforms.
  • Identify, evaluate, and recruit creators who align with the brand's audience, positioning, and marketing goals.
  • Oversee creator onboarding, communication, negotiations, and ongoing relationship management.
  • Manage creator applications, gifting requests, and partnership inquiries.
  • Build and maintain an engaged creator community that consistently generates high-quality content.

Campaign Management & Execution

  • Own the day-to-day execution of creator campaigns, product launches, gifting initiatives, and seasonal promotions.
  • Coordinate creator participation in TikTok LIVEs, affiliate campaigns, and promotional events such as Black Friday/Cyber Monday.
  • Manage creator deliverables, timelines, follow-ups, and content submissions to ensure campaigns launch successfully.
  • Collaborate with social, creative, and marketing teams to align creator content with broader brand initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve creator participation, campaign efficiency, and content output.

Content Management & Performance

  • Review creator-generated content for brand alignment, quality, and potential performance.
  • Identify high-performing creator content that can be repurposed for paid advertising, organic social, and other marketing channels.
  • Track creator performance, engagement, affiliate activity, and content effectiveness.
  • Share actionable insights and recommendations to improve creator selection, campaign performance, and content strategy.
  • Stay informed about emerging creator trends, TikTok Shop developments, and social commerce opportunities.

Creator Operations & Program Optimization

  • Oversee product gifting, sample requests, and shipment coordination.
  • Manage creator agreements, contracts, content usage rights, and deliverable tracking.
  • Maintain accurate creator databases, campaign trackers, and content libraries using Notion, Google Workspace, and relevant platforms.
  • Improve creator workflows and processes to support a growing partnerships program.
  • Work closely with the Social Commerce Director to identify opportunities to scale creator partnerships and affiliate initiatives.

Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, affiliate marketing, social commerce, or a related field.
  • Proven experience independently managing creator relationships and influencer marketing campaigns.
  • Hands-on experience with TikTok, Instagram, and creator or affiliate marketing platforms.
  • Strong understanding of creator-generated content, influencer engagement, and social media trends.
  • Experience coordinating campaigns from creator discovery and outreach through execution and performance tracking.
  • Excellent written communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple creators and campaigns simultaneously.
  • Comfortable using performance data to evaluate partnerships and recommend improvements.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of projects, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and creator management or project tracking tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience managing creator partnerships through TikTok Shop, LTK, or Trybe.
  • Experience working with beauty, cosmetics, skincare, lifestyle, or other DTC consumer brands.
  • Understanding of affiliate marketing, creator commissions, and social commerce performance metrics.
  • Experience identifying and securing usage rights for creator content used in paid advertising.
  • Familiarity with Notion and creator relationship management tools.
  • Experience scaling creator gifting, seeding, or affiliate programs.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who goes beyond coordinating tasks and can take real ownership of creator partnerships.

You should be comfortable managing relationships independently, identifying strong creators, keeping campaigns organized, and using performance insights to make partnerships more effective.

You'll thrive in this role if you're proactive, resourceful, detail-oriented, and genuinely excited about beauty, creator-led marketing, and the growing opportunities within social commerce.

Head of Change Management – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Head of Change Management is responsible for developing, leading, and implementing the organization's change management framework to support business transformation, organizational development, digital adoption, and operational improvement initiatives.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role manages organizational change activities associated with technology implementation, business process redesign, operating model changes, regulatory initiatives, restructuring, and cultural transformation.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, HR, IT, business unit heads, and programme management teams to assess organizational impacts, improve change readiness, manage resistance, and ensure employees successfully adopt new systems, processes, and ways of working.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Change Management Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and implement the organization's change management strategy, frameworks, and methodologies.
  • Translate transformation objectives into structured change management plans and implementation roadmaps.
  • Establish change management standards, governance structures, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Assess organizational readiness and identify potential challenges associated with planned changes.
  • Align change management activities with corporate strategy and transformation priorities.

B. Organizational Change & Transformation

  • Lead change initiatives involving organizational restructuring, operating model redesign, business process improvement, and operational transformation.
  • Conduct change impact assessments to identify effects on employees, departments, workflows, and systems.
  • Develop implementation plans to support smooth transitions across business functions.
  • Coordinate change activities across multiple projects and transformation programmes.
  • Ensure new organizational structures, processes, and procedures are effectively adopted.

C. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Identify key stakeholders and develop appropriate engagement strategies.
  • Collaborate with senior management, department heads, employees, and external partners.
  • Develop and deliver change communication plans, presentations, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Address employee concerns, manage resistance, and build commitment to transformation initiatives.
  • Establish feedback channels to monitor stakeholder sentiment and change effectiveness.

D. Digital & Technology Change Adoption

  • Lead change management activities related to digital transformation and technology implementation.
  • Support the adoption of enterprise systems, automation platforms, digital tools, and business applications.
  • Coordinate with IT teams to assess the organizational impact of technology changes.
  • Develop employee training, awareness, and user adoption programmes.
  • Monitor system adoption and ensure successful transition to new digital working practices.

E. People, Culture & Capability Development

  • Partner with HR to align change initiatives with workforce planning and organizational development.
  • Lead initiatives to improve organizational culture, employee engagement, and leadership alignment.
  • Identify employee capability gaps and coordinate training and development activities.
  • Support managers in leading teams through organizational transitions.
  • Promote adaptability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

F. Change Impact, Risk & Readiness Management

  • Conduct organizational change impact assessments and readiness evaluations.
  • Identify risks, resistance points, and implementation challenges.
  • Develop mitigation plans to minimize disruption to business operations.
  • Monitor change readiness, employee adoption, and implementation effectiveness.
  • Ensure change initiatives comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and regulatory requirements.

G. Performance Monitoring & Benefits Realization

  • Establish change management KPIs, adoption metrics, and performance dashboards.
  • Track employee engagement, training completion, stakeholder readiness, and adoption rates.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of change management activities.
  • Monitor whether transformation initiatives achieve their intended business outcomes.
  • Prepare progress reports and recommendations for senior management and programme steering committees.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Management, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree or MBA in Business Administration, Organizational Development, or Change Management is preferred.
  • 10–15+ years of progressive experience in change management, organizational development, business transformation, or programme management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior change management or organizational transformation leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide or business-unit change initiatives.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of change management frameworks, stakeholder engagement, change impact assessment, and organizational readiness.

raw.description:
Job title

Product & Client Insights Manager

Department

Business Operations

Reports to

Director, Business Operations

Classification

Full-Time, Exempt

Work Location

Remote - U.S. with preference of candidates in Eastern or Central Time Zones

Travel Requirement

Occasional travel is an essential requirement of this position, including attendance at BELAY's annual company Summit and other business meetings as needed.

Job purpose

The Product & Client Insights Manager leads BELAY's client insights, market research, and product and service innovation initiatives across Assistant and Financial Solutions. This role is responsible for developing actionable insights that inform client retention strategies, enhance the client experience, and identify opportunities for new or improved service offerings, including AI-enabled solutions.

This is a data-driven role built for action. This person connects quantitative performance data with qualitative client feedback to find out why clients stay, why they leave, and where our offerings should improve or expand. That includes tracking how AI is changing what clients expect and what competitors are delivering. Every recommendation must rest on measurable findings, not assumptions or anecdotes. This person then sees each one through: building the business case, getting approval, and leading implementation with Client Success, Delivery, Operations, Finance, Sales, and Marketing until the change is live and its impact is measured.

This role sits in Operations because insight only matters when it changes how we deliver. Success is measured by results, not reports: measurable gains in retention, client-health insights that leaders trust and act on, improvements that launch and get adopted, and new-solution pilots, including AI-enabled ones, that prove or disprove their value with data.

Essential Functions

As a BELAY Corporate Team member, you will professionally represent the company in all virtual and in-person interactions. You are expected to exemplify our mission, vision, and core values while fostering a collaborative and positive team environment.

Voice of the Client & Insights

  • Build and run BELAY’s Voice of the Client program (interviews, focus groups, surveys, and feedback loops) across Assistant and Financial Solutions, giving leadership a direct, recurring view of what clients value, where they struggle, and why they stay or leave.
  • Own the development, accuracy, and ongoing analysis of enterprise client insights, retention reporting, and client health metrics by integrating quantitative data and qualitative feedback from Salesforce, Gong, client surveys, billing, utilization, and churn metrics.
  • Use quantitative analysis, backed by client feedback, to identify trends, root causes, and emerging risks.
  • Own the insight and retention dashboard and present it in the Monthly Operating Review, showing trends, actions taken, and measurable outcomes.
  • Turn findings into prioritized, evidence-based recommendations with expected impact and success criteria, and bring leadership the decisions that need their approval.

Client Experience & Retention Strategy

  • Become BELAY's subject-matter expert on every service we deliver, across Assistant and Financial Solutions, inclusive of all products and services offered by BELAY and BELAY Financial.
  • Lead the development and execution of client retention strategies in partnership with cross-functional leaders, with accountability for measuring and improving retention outcomes.
  • Protect retention of our client base by utilizing cohort and churn analysis to identify root causes of attrition, and execute and implement corrective actions to measurably improve retention.
  • Partner with relevant teams to develop and implement client and talent onboarding enhancements that support new product launches and address identified service gaps.
  • Drive adoption of changes with Client Success, Delivery, and Operations leaders, and report back on whether each change actually moved retention.

Market Research & Competitive Intelligence

  • Track competitors, adjacent providers, and the online communities where our clients gather, including what they offer, how they price, and where they fall short.
  • Identify emerging market trends, unmet client needs, and white space where BELAY can lead.
  • Bring leadership early warning on industry shifts, including AI, with a plan to respond before they become urgent.

Product & Service R&D

  • Turn client insights and market trends into new solution concepts, enhancements, and packaging ideas.
  • Build business cases, run pilots with defined success metrics, and take only data-proven concepts from test to launch.
  • Partner with Finance, Sales, and Marketing on pricing, positioning, and go-to-market for new offerings.

AI Strategy & Service Protection

  • Maintain deep, hands-on knowledge of AI tools in the market, especially tools that automate or compete with Executive Assistant work.
  • Test AI tools continuously against BELAY's services. Know what they can do, what they can't, and where they threaten our model.
  • Serve as the internal advisor on AI risk to the EA business, and bring leadership early warnings with a plan to respond.
  • Partner with BELAY’s AI Automation Engineer & Enablement Lead and pilot AI + human service models where AI makes our Assistants faster and more valuable, so the human relationship stays the core of what clients buy.
  • Train internal teams to use the AI capabilities in Gong, Outreach, and other client and sales systems to extract insights, spot trends, and turn findings into action.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in product strategy, client experience, market research, or service design, in staffing, accounting and financial services, professional services, or other service-based businesses.
  • Proficient in analyzing complex datasets and turning findings into executive-level recommendations, including KPI and dashboard development; comfortable pulling, cleaning and blending data across systems such as CRM, billing, and survey tools.
  • Track record of defining and tracking client KPIs such as retention, churn, LTV and NPS, and of setting baselines and success metrics to measure the impact of initiatives.
  • Able to independently run client research (interviews, focus groups, surveys) and combine it with quantitative metrics to validate findings and set priorities.
  • Proven track record of taking new offerings from concept to launch and implementing operational change, including onboarding or enablement programs, not just recommending them.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating or piloting client-facing AI tools
  • Strong commercial acumen: able to size a market, build a business case, and present it to executive leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SQL or BI tools such as Looker, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Familiarity with staffing or technology solutions beyond traditional assistant services.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Gong, and Outreach.
  • Experience building or running a formal Voice of the Client or client feedback program.
  • Experience piloting AI-enabled or AI + human service models.
  • Customer experience certification, such as CCXP (Certified Customer Experience Professional).

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting findings and recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Ability to influence and drive adoption across Client Success, Delivery, Operations, Finance, Sales, and Marketing without direct authority.
  • Project management skills to take initiatives from concept to launch.
  • Excellent organization and time management, with the ability to prioritize multiple projects and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote environment.

Working Conditions

BELAY is a remote-first organization. This role requires a dedicated home office, regular use of virtual collaboration tools, and a work schedule that aligns with business needs and BELAY's core collaboration hours. Occasional travel or flexibility outside standard business hours may be required based on the role.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting and computer use.
  • Frequent participation in virtual meetings.
  • Ability to communicate effectively through video conferencing, email, and phone.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Direct Reports

None. This is an individual contributor role with the opportunity to build a team as the function grows.

Disclaimer

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Responsibilities may change from time to time based on business needs, and team members may be assigned additional duties as needed.

Legal Disclosures

Pay Range: $90,000 - $105,000 total compensation

Health Insurance: Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance are available to eligible employees. BELAY covers 70% of employee premiums and 65% of dependent premiums for medical, and 70% of employee premiums for dental and vision. Company-paid life insurance ($15,000 coverage) and short-term/long-term disability coverage (STD: 60% of weekly earnings up to $1,500; LTD: 60% of monthly earnings up to $10,000) are provided at no cost to full-time employees.

Retirement Benefits: 401(k) plan through Vanguard, with a 4% employer discretionary match. Employees are eligible after 90 days of employment.

Paid Time Off: Full-time (40 hr/week) employees receive 15 days of PTO annually; full-time (30 hr/week) employees receive 12 days. Additional PTO is awarded at 3- and 5-year tenure milestones.

Paid Holidays: 12 paid holidays annually (New Year’s Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, President’s Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Day After Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, and one floating holiday of the employee’s choosing).

Paid Sick Leave: Full-time employees’ PTO accrual generally satisfies state and local paid sick leave requirements in the states where BELAY hires. BELAY follows all state specific requirements.

Method of Application: Apply online via the link provided in this posting.

Application Window: The posting will remain open until filled.

Contact Information: Questions regarding this posting may be directed to . .

EEO Statement: BELAY is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Location Requirements:

This role is remote within the U.S. However, due to employment and tax compliance considerations, we are currently unable to hire employees in the following states: California, New York, Illinois, Oregon, Minnesota.

About Americans United

Americans United for Separation of Church and State is a nonpartisan educational and advocacy organization dedicated to advancing the constitutional principle of church-state separation as the only way to ensure freedom of religion, including the right to believe or not believe, for all of us. Founded in 1947, Americans United is a diverse and dynamic organization composed of people from all walks of life: lawyers and lobbyists, students and activists, religious leaders and impassioned Americans. AU includes people of faith and people who don’t profess any particular faith. It is a community that welcomes people of all genders, races, ethnicities, religions or beliefs, sexual orientations, ages, socioeconomic backgrounds, and abilities. Because we work on a wide variety of issues with many different communities, we value what diversity and diverse perspectives bring to our work. 

Position Summary

Americans United for Separation of Church and State (AU) seeks a Development Intern to assist the Development Department in its national fundraising efforts. The Development Intern will report to the Sr. Manager of Prospect Research and work primarily to support the organization’s development department.

Interns have the opportunity to meet and learn from staff across the Development Department and organization, including communications, policy, and legal departments. All interns also have the opportunity to be published on AU’s Wall of Separation blog.

The Development Intern will be responsible for a variety of tasks in support of the department, including but not limited to:

  • Updating AU’s database as needed
  • Ensure contact information and other critical donor data is entered in donor’s database record in a timely manner and adheres to consistent formatting and entry standards
  • Review responses to “month in review", facilitate follow-up as needed
  • Assist with screening new donors and other sources
  • Oversee Call Time process: send reminders, create bios for GO’s and/or repeat donors.
  • Prepare brief event bios, if needed
  • Once established, assist with prospect research metrics measuring the scope efficiency, and impact of prospect research efforts.
  • Assisting with grants management, including tracking, deadlines, and data organization
  • Assisting with reporting and proposal preparation
  • Conducting foundation research (Google search, Wealth Engine, Foundation Directory Online, and EveryAction, etc.)
  • Assisting with meeting preparation and events as needed
  • Drafting letters and emails
  • Assisting other department tasks as needed

The strongest candidates will be able to demonstrate a commitment to the separation of religion and government, be responsible and hard-working on a remote and virtual environment, and be excited to work with diverse staff and supporters, and have some or all of these skills:

  • Writing concisely and persuasively
  • Meeting deadlines and communicating about progress
  • Organized and eager to learn new skills
    Familiarity with Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, and Google Drive

Americans United is an equal-opportunity employer and places strong emphasis on a diverse environment in which individuals are valued regardless of their gender, race, ethnicity, cultural background, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic.

Time Commitment

The internship is 25 hours/week from January 11, 2027 - April 30, 2027 (with some flexibility to accommodate the intern’s academic or other scheduling needs). The organization will also consider candidates for the remaining academic year. Interns will attend weekly all-staff meetings, team meetings and 1:1 meetings with their supervisor.

How to Apply

Submit as attached Word documents or PDFs:

  • A resume (one page) outlining your relevant academic, campus, and professional experience
  • A cover letter (one page) describing how your experience relates to the Development Internship and explaining why AU’s mission is important to you

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis with priority given to applications received by November 30, 2026. Interviews will begin being scheduled December 7, 2026, and hiring decisions made by December 18, 2026. No calls, please.

Benefits

The Development Intern will be paid a stipend of $7,360. Interns receive substantive experience with in-depth exposure to some of the most important issues facing the country. Interns are encouraged and provided time to learn across the organization.

AU can provide documentation for academic credit upon successful conclusion of the internship.

Salary: Stipend: $7,360

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer, Merchant Platform to help prospective merchants understand, evaluate, and plan how they could use Bask Health's technology to launch and operate their own telehealth businesses.

You'll partner with Account Executives throughout the sales process, leading technical discovery, demonstrating platform capabilities, and designing proposed solutions around merchant requirements.

You'll focus on how Bask's merchant-facing tools work together, including storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, integrations, and operational workflows.

This is a technical presales role for someone who enjoys working directly with customers, understands modern software platforms, and can translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.

You'll collaborate with Sales, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams to evaluate feasibility, explain platform capabilities, and help prospective merchants make informed decisions.

We're looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with clear communication and can guide customers through complex platform evaluations.

What You'll Do

  • Lead technical discovery for prospective merchants evaluating Bask's platform.
  • Partner with Account Executives on complex merchant platform sales opportunities.
  • Understand prospective merchants' business models, customer experiences, and operational requirements.
  • Translate merchant requirements into proposed technical solutions.
  • Deliver tailored demonstrations of Bask's merchant-facing platform capabilities.
  • Explain how storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout, and operational workflows connect.
  • Help prospective merchants evaluate how Bask could support their existing or planned businesses.
  • Design proposed platform configurations based on merchant needs.
  • Evaluate technical requirements involving storefront experiences and customer journeys.
  • Lead technical discussions about platform architecture and integrations.
  • Explain available APIs, webhooks, and integration approaches where applicable.
  • Assess the feasibility of proposed integrations with merchant systems.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to investigate complex integration requirements.
  • Partner with Product to clarify current functionality and platform limitations.
  • Develop technical diagrams and solution documentation for customer evaluations.
  • Support technical proof-of-value activities before commercial agreements are finalized.
  • Prepare demonstrations that address specific merchant use cases.
  • Help prospective merchants understand how patient experiences connect to commercial storefront workflows.
  • Evaluate requirements involving checkout, payments, and transaction-related processes.
  • Identify potential technical risks early in the sales process.
  • Help customers understand implementation considerations without taking ownership of implementation delivery.
  • Support technical responses to customer questionnaires and requests for information.
  • Explain platform capabilities to founders, executives, developers, and operations teams.
  • Help prospective merchants compare different approaches to configuring their businesses on Bask.
  • Collaborate with Sales to develop technically accurate proposals.
  • Support the technical evaluation of nonstandard customer requirements.
  • Coordinate internal reviews when prospective solutions require Engineering or Product input.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of merchant requirements and technical assumptions.
  • Develop reusable demonstration materials for common merchant use cases.
  • Help establish consistent technical discovery processes for merchant platform opportunities.
  • Provide technical guidance during strategic customer evaluations.
  • Identify recurring merchant requirements that may inform product improvements.
  • Share customer feedback with Product and Engineering.
  • Support the development of technical sales documentation and reference materials.

raw.description:
A La Carte Solutions (ALC) is recruiting on behalf of a confidential client for a Director, Technical Development & Innovation position. This opportunity is with a growing, science-led consumer products company focused on high-performance formulations, product quality, and innovation. This position is not an internal role with A La Carte Solutions.

The organization is expanding its technical capabilities, developing new technologies and products, and strengthening its network of external research and manufacturing partners.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Director, Technical Development & Innovation to lead the technical development of new products, formulations, and technologies.

Reporting to the VP, Product Development & Manufacturing, this individual will translate approved product and commercial requirements into technically sound, scalable, and production-ready solutions.

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone with strong technical expertise, practical manufacturing experience, and the ability to collaborate with external research laboratories, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.

The Director will oversee technical development from innovation through feasibility, including formulation, product science, testing and validation, claims substantiation, regulatory readiness, and quality.

A major focus will be advancing early-stage formulas into robust products ready for test-market evaluation and manufacturing scale-up, while also supporting improvements to existing products and potential expansion into new categories.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Development & Product Innovation

  • Lead technical development of new products, product improvements, and formulation changes.
  • Translate product requirements into formulations, specifications, performance targets, and development plans.
  • Oversee formulation development, refinement, and optimization.
  • Advance early-stage formulas into technically feasible, scalable products.
  • Oversee bench and pilot development activities in partnership with external laboratories and engineering teams.
  • Evaluate technical alternatives based on performance, quality, cost, manufacturability, scalability, and risk.
  • Establish technical readiness criteria before products advance toward commercialization.

New Technology & Manufacturing

  • Lead development and validation of new formulations and technologies.
  • Partner with the Process Engineering Manager on pilot-scale development and manufacturing readiness.
  • Evaluate new materials, equipment, processes, and external technical capabilities.
  • Provide technical specifications and documentation needed for successful manufacturing transfers.
  • Identify and resolve formulation, material, and manufacturing challenges.

Product Testing, Validation & Quality

  • Develop and oversee product testing and validation strategies.
  • Lead claims substantiation and support regulatory readiness.
  • Establish product-performance benchmarks and testing standards.
  • Hire and manage the Quality Assurance Manager and oversee the Product Testing & Validation Manager.
  • Lead the development of a quality management system (QMS).
  • Ensure product specifications, quality controls, and regulatory considerations are incorporated throughout development.
  • Support root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and technical risk management.

External Partnerships & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with external R&D partners, testing laboratories, suppliers, and co-manufacturers.
  • Evaluate supplier and manufacturing capabilities.
  • Support domestic and international sourcing initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Product Development, Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, and other business functions.
  • Provide technical recommendations to leadership and support product commercialization decisions.

Team Leadership & Strategic Execution

  • Build and develop technical capabilities, processes, and teams.
  • Manage technical development, testing, and external-resource budgets.
  • Establish clear technical documentation and development standards.
  • Prioritize multiple development initiatives while maintaining quality and efficiency.
  • Communicate technical findings, risks, and recommendations to leadership.

Position Details

  • Job Title: Director, Technical Development & Innovation
  • Location: Fully Remote, with regular travel to laboratories and manufacturing partners
  • Compensation: $150,000–$165,000 annually, plus bonus potential
  • FLSA Classification: Exempt
  • Reports To: VP, Product Development & Manufacturing

This opportunity is ideal for a technically strong, hands-on leader who enjoys building capabilities, solving complex formulation challenges, and turning innovative concepts into commercially viable products.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in product development, research and development (R&D), engineering, technical operations, or related technical roles within consumer packaged goods (CPG) or manufacturing.
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical teams, functions, or complex product development programs.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of formulation-driven product development, manufacturing processes, and scale-up.
  • Experience refining early-stage formulations into robust products, including work with binder systems, durability, friability, powders, minerals, or granulated materials.
  • Proven experience taking products from initial concept or bench development through pilot testing, manufacturing validation, and commercial production.
  • Experience working with external R&D partners, equipment manufacturer laboratories, testing facilities, and contract manufacturers.
  • Experience collaborating directly with co-manufacturers, toll manufacturers, suppliers, and external manufacturing partners.
  • Strong ability to evaluate technical feasibility, product performance, manufacturing capabilities, cost, and risk.
  • Experience with product testing, validation, quality management systems, claims substantiation, or regulatory requirements.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex technical projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Food Science, Process Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Advanced degree preferred; equivalent relevant experience considered.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in pet products, consumer packaged goods, food, wellness, household products, consumables, or other formulation-driven industries.
  • Experience working in both established manufacturing environments and smaller, high-growth organizations.
  • Experience building technical processes, systems, and organizational capabilities.
  • Familiarity with global suppliers, international sourcing, and external manufacturing networks.
  • Technical experience with process engineering, agglomeration, coatings, minerals, powders, or tableting.
  • Experience developing products distributed through major retail channels.

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be a technically credible, strategic, and hands-on leader who can:

  • Make informed technical decisions and solve complex formulation challenges.
  • Balance innovation with practical manufacturing requirements.
  • Build processes and capabilities in a growing organization.
  • Communicate technical information clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Collaborate effectively across departments while maintaining ownership of technical outcomes.
  • Adapt to changing priorities and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrate accountability, sound judgment, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset.

Benefits

Compensation & Opportunity

  • Competitive annual base salary of $150,000–$165,000, plus bonus potential.
  • Fully remote position with regular travel to laboratories and manufacturing partners.
  • Opportunity to take a leadership role in technical development and product innovation for a growing consumer products company.
  • Direct collaboration with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Opportunity to build and strengthen technical development and quality capabilities.
  • Hands-on involvement in bringing new technologies and products from early-stage research through commercialization.

Additional employee benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

Please Note: This position is being recruited by A La Carte Solutions on behalf of a confidential client. The selected candidate will be employed by the client organization, not A La Carte Solutions.

raw.title: Lead Account Executive, Commerce Growth
raw.excerpt: About Darkroom Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow.
raw.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

The Account Executive, Commerce Growth owns a new-business revenue number across Darkroom's commerce practice: Amazon (marketplace management and retail media), TikTok Shop and social commerce, Retention Marketing (email, SMS, lifecycle), and Digital Products (GEO / AI-search, SEO, CRO, web builds, and web support).

You lead with the marketplaces. Amazon and TikTok Shop are where your hunt starts - these are a couple of the highest-intent entry points in the market right now, and the fastest route into a brand's commerce P&L. Retention and Digital Products are how you widen the deal: once you are inside a brand's commerce operation, you are the person who sees that their email program is flat, their PDPs do not convert, and they are invisible in AI search - and who scopes and closes that work too.

You are a commercial, closer-minded operator who builds a book through partnerships, industry events, and targeted outreach - and who also fields and closes the inbound that arrives in your practice. You will become the person the market associates with Darkroom's commerce offering: at the conferences, in the platform partner ecosystems, and in the rooms where these deals get done.

You will also own the upsell and cross-sell motion for your departments - working the existing client base alongside our Managing Directors and Will Margaritis (SVP, Strategy) to identify and close expansion into your services.

This is a high-accountability role with clear revenue KPIs and uncapped commission that rewards self-sourced pipeline. If you want to own the commerce practice, build a durable network, and close tech-enabled marketing services you believe in, this is the role for you.

Location: NYC strongly preferred.

Your Practice

You own new business and expansion across four service clusters. The first two lead; the second two attach.

Lead with:

  • Amazon - marketplace strategy and management, catalog and content, Amazon Ads / retail media, and DSP.

  • TikTok Shop & Social Commerce - shop setup and operations, affiliate and creator-led selling, live and Spark Ads-driven commerce, and the adjacent social marketplaces as they mature.

Attach and expand into:

  • Retention Marketing - email, SMS, and lifecycle (Klaviyo and the broader retention stack).

  • Digital Products - GEO / AI-search optimization, SEO, conversion-rate optimization, web builds, and ongoing web support.

You will build deep fluency in all four, the platforms behind them, and the buyer in each - so that when a brand says "we're getting killed on Amazon," "we need to stand up TikTok Shop before Q4," or "our email program is flat," you are already scoping the deal. You will also carry the Shadow story into these conversations, since our AI commerce layer is a material part of why brands choose us over a category specialist.

What You'll Do

Primary - Source and close new business, marketplace-first

  • Own a quarterly new-business number across the commerce practice, led by Amazon and TikTok Shop.

  • Build and work a partner ecosystem as a durable referral engine - Amazon and TikTok Shop partner networks, Shopify Plus, aggregators and brand holdcos, 3PLs and logistics partners, marketplace tooling, plus Klaviyo, retention and CRO tech, and AI-search / SEO platforms for your attach services.

  • Represent Darkroom at industry events and conferences in your practice (Amazon Accelerate, Prosper Show, unBoxed, TikTok Shop and creator-commerce summits, Shoptalk, eTail, K:BOS, BrightonSEO / MozCon, MAICON and emerging GEO/AEO events), and build the local/in-market relationships that surface deals.

  • Develop and pursue a named target ("whale") list of brands that fit the commerce practice, alongside a category focus defined during your first 30 days (subscription, fashion, beauty, CPG, etc.).

  • Field and close inbound that arrives in your practice.

  • Run a deliberate attach motion on every new deal: land the marketplace engagement, then scope retention and digital products into the same relationship rather than leaving it for later.

  • Lead the full commercial process: scoping, pricing, proposal, and close.

  • Work with our marketing team to understand inbound strategy across content creators, SEO, and other deal sources.

Primary - Own the upsell & cross-sell motion

  • Run a standing weekly expansion meeting with the Managing Directors of your departments and Will Margaritis (SVP, Strategy), where you work the client base for upsell and cross-sell opportunities and drive the flagged deals to close.

  • The MDs surface the opportunity from delivery insight; Will clears account health and capacity; you own the commercial motion and the close.

  • Proactively identify expansion through client conversations, performance data, and account signals - you are the person the account team calls when an opportunity emerges.

Secondary - Practice fluency and onboarding

  • Maintain deep, current command of Darkroom's commerce service catalog - marketplaces, social commerce, retention, and digital - and the platforms behind it.

  • Be present on onboarding calls for new clients in your practice to establish the expansion relationship from day one.

  • Maintain clean pipeline documentation in HubSpot and Notion (Sourced By, Closed By, Origination, deal stages) - comp is calculated off these fields.

What You Will Not Do

  • High-volume cold prospecting for net-new logos outside your practice - that is the outbound BDR's function. You source through partnerships, events, and targeted relationships.

  • Deliver QBRs.

  • Execute campaign changes, marketplace operations, or optimizations - that is the account team's responsibility.

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • 5+ years in a full-cycle Account Executive or equivalent sales role with a documented closing track record. Agency, MarTech, marketplace/commerce, or SaaS experience strongly preferred.

  • Commerce credibility. You can hold your own with an Amazon or e-commerce lead - unit economics, retail media, marketplace mechanics, TikTok Shop and creator-led selling - and you can speak fluently enough about retention/lifecycle, SEO and the shift to AI-search / GEO, CRO, and web builds to earn a technical buyer's trust.

  • Closer DNA. You have carried a quota and closed new-business and expansion deals. You are energized by revenue outcomes, and you source your own pipeline rather than waiting for leads.

  • Multi-service instinct. You do not sell one line item. You see the whole commerce operation and build the deal accordingly.

  • Network-builder. You know how to turn platform partners and conferences into a durable pipeline, not one-off business cards.

  • Commercially instinctive. When you hear "we're launching on TikTok Shop next quarter" or "we're rebuilding our site next year," you are already scoping the deal.

  • Self-directed operator. Highly organized, proactive, fast-moving. You do not need to be managed into motion.

  • Tool-proficient. HubSpot (or equivalent CRM), Notion, Google Workspace, Slack; comfortable reading performance data and dashboards, including marketplace and ads reporting.

  • Polished communicator. Fluent English, strong video presence, comfortable presenting to founders, CMOs, and heads of e-commerce at growth-stage brands.

How You'll Be Measured

  • Quarterly new-business quota attainment (new MRR + variable, per the Sales Quota & Commission Plan).

  • Marketplace-led new business closed (Amazon, TikTok Shop).

  • Attach rate - share of new commerce deals that land with more than one service.

  • Upsell and cross-sell revenue closed.

  • Self-sourced pipeline generated (partnerships, events, outbound relationships).

  • Inbound deals closed in your practice.

  • Pipeline hygiene in HubSpot.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership - but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape - just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

  • Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

  • Compensation Structure: The base salary range for this role is $90,000-$100,000 per year, plus uncapped commission on new-business, upsell, cross-sell, and inbound revenue, with accelerators that reward self-sourced pipeline (partnerships, events, and outbound relationships pay a higher origination bracket than inbound). Full mechanics shared during the interview process.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace-we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Senior Product Manager

At Pinnacle Live, you’ll do more than fill a role, you’ll help shape the future of live events, hospitality, and production excellence.

Company Overview

Pinnacle Live is a premium, in-house AV and event production company operating at premier hotels and resorts across North America. We exist to Elevate Experiences — combining cutting-edge production with a deeply human touch, holding ourselves to a standard where exceptional is the baseline. We're guided by three core values: Excellence is our attitude. Innovation is our mindset. Our people make the difference. If you show up prepared, take ownership of your craft, and want to grow alongside a team that holds itself to high standards, we'd love to meet you.

Pinnacle Live is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where every team member can thrive.

Job Summary

The Senior Product Manager serves a key role in leading the definition and development of systems supporting Pinnacle Live for the venue and above venue teams. The Senior Product Manager will also be responsible for working with all cross functional teams to identify best practices, create competitive differentiation, drive revenue and increase efficiencies. This role will also stay on top of industry trends and innovative technologies to identify solutions and opportunities to help bridge gaps between departments, such as procurement, sales, operations and systems. Attend industry events and tradeshows related to role and responsibilities.

The Senior Product Manager will act as a SME (subject matter expert) and an advanced ("super") user. They are responsible for understanding user needs, formalizing these needs into functional requirements and supporting the development, testing, and/or configuration of the systems needed. They will be responsible for multiple applications and ownership of applications may adjust over time as business priorities change.

Essential Functions

  • Define and own the long-term product strategy aligned with company goals.
  • Translate strategy into actionable roadmaps and quarterly plans - make tough trade-offs using data, business value, and resource constraints.
  • Liaison among technology solutions, sales, operations, finance, and customer experience to ensure systems.
  • Drive product development through the full lifecycle (discovery → delivery → iteration) while working with service providers including consulting and product companies.
  • Lead by influence—creating alignment without formal authority.
  • Engaged with the development team to provide feedback and requirements of the field.
  • Act as initial unit tester; work with the business partners in creating testing plans (UAT) before deploying to the field.

Education & Experience

  • Minimum of three (3) years' experience in a customer service-facing role
  • Exceptional relationship builder, internally and externally
  • Strong business communication, presentation, and writing skills
  • Proficiency in various technology systems, including platforms, custom applications and AI.
  • Production and Staging experience is preferred

Required Skills & Knowledge

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed herein are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • Highly skilled communicator; exceptional interpersonal and relationship-building skills
  • Highly skilled at project management; proven success working in a fast-paced environment
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments, is flexible, and able to adapt to changing scenarios
  • Problem solver mindset: ability to remove obstacles for clients through strong organizational skills
  • Highly skilled customer service mindset: willing to go above and beyond
  • Ability to work within a fast-paced and evolving dynamic, welcoming change and navigating conflicting priorities when applicable
  • Understands technical architecture, APIs, and constraints well enough to have credible conversations with engineers and spot feasibility issues early.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Core Competencies

  • Customer Service – Utilizes the skills necessary to communicate with clients, solve problems, demonstrate patience and understanding, ensure customer satisfaction, and resolve customer complaints.
  • Attention to Detail – Efficiently allocate cognitive resources to achieve thoroughness and accuracy when accomplishing tasks.
  • Effective Communicator – Has the ability to work on multiple projects at one time, balancing communication with active listening, confidence, and concrete and clear conversation.
  • Critical Thinking - Identifies root cause of problems and prevents the problems from recurring within assigned department. Considers impact of team's decisions.
  • Job Knowledge - Uses in depth knowledge of concepts, principles, and procedures and applies them to varied and complex situations within assigned department. Keeps up to date on developments that affect job.
  • Product Knowledge – Ability to communicate information and answer questions based on our products and services.
  • Organizational Skills – Uses best practices such as time management, prioritizing through to-do lists, consistent communication, multi-tasking, and adaptability.
  • Persuasiveness / Negotiating - Influences and shapes issues and desired outcomes.
  • Presentation Skills – Creates and delivers presentations.

Travel Demands

Travel as needed within North America

Work Schedule

Business hours are Monday - Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Extended business hours and weekends will be required.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit at a desk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds, at times.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet. The employee will be required to work long hours as needed.

Pinnacle Live is an E-verify and Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

Pinnacle Live is committed to welcoming, valuing, and supporting every person and their unique contributions. We are actively working to foster an environment where diversity, equity, inclusion, belonging, and mutual respect thrive. We recognize that diversity is intersectional, and that actively valuing diversity demands that we continually strive to establish a welcoming atmosphere for all.

Pinnacle Live welcomes, openly acknowledges, empowers, and celebrates the diversity of all our team members, clients, and partners, and affirms the identities and experiences of all our members. We strive to create an environment where we actively embrace all forms of diversity.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Build backend services, APIs and workflows for the AI Neobank app.

  • Support products across insurance, payments, wallet, savings, investing, travel and financial services.

  • Design reliable systems for user accounts, transactions, partner integrations, reconciliation, notifications and operations.

  • Work with product and mobile teams to ship customer-facing journeys quickly.

  • Integrate with banks, payment gateways, insurers, data providers and other partners.

  • Improve system reliability, observability, security and performance.

  • Build systems that are practical, auditable and ready for regulated financial products.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of backend engineering experience.

  • Strong fundamentals in APIs, databases, system design and production debugging.

  • Experience building scalable services and integrating third-party systems.

  • Good understanding of security, reliability, data quality and operational edge cases.

  • Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, quality and risk.

  • Comfortable working with product, mobile, operations and business teams.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, insurance, lending, banking or regulated products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Builds systems that work in the real world, not just on diagrams.

  • Thinks through edge cases, failure modes and operational impact.

  • Can move fast without creating fragile foundations.

  • Takes ownership of production issues and long-term reliability.

  • Explains clearly what they personally built versus what the team delivered.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.

  • People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk.

  • Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.

  • Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Thailand. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Thailand.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Working closely with C-suite executives and research leadership, consultants will drive organizational transformation, process improvement, and enterprise-wide initiatives across key areas such as financial operations, organizational design, workforce management, technology, and research administration. We are seeking professionals with complementary areas of expertise who can bring strategic insight and hands-on leadership to a diverse range of client engagements.

Specialized Expertise: Deep experience in three or more of the following areas:

Today it is the first unified Litigation AI system built to manage the entire case lifecycle, helping legal teams decide what matters and what comes next. Backed by top-tier VCs, Syllo empowers leading law firms and Fortune 500 companies to move faster and mitigate risk. Awarded ILTA Transformative Project of the Year and ALM eDiscovery Technology of the Year for 2026, we deliver enterprise-grade Litigation AI. We’re building a team to push the boundaries of what technology can achieve.

About the Role

You will lead a pod of four to six Client Services Specialists who support AmLaw 100 firms and Fortune 500 legal departments on their largest matters. These teams run bet-the-company litigation, MDLs, and government investigations on Syllo. Clients rely on your pod not just to hit production deadlines, but to deploy AI that transforms raw data into a winning case strategy.

This role combines team leadership with hands-on matter work. You set the standard for your pod. You advise on AI driven strategy, help audit the output, and join the call when a partner needs to hear the plan. We hold a high bar because our clients’ court deadlines don’t move.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the pod. Coach and develop four to six Client Services Specialists. Know each person’s technical depth and client judgment, and raise both.
  • Own delivery quality. Set the documentation, quality control, and handoff standards your pod follows. No matter loses ground when work changes hands.
  • Lead flagship accounts. Own the service plan for your largest clients, from onboarding through the close of each matter.
  • Engineer AI workflows. Build advanced AI workflows on Syllo, designed around what each matter needs to achieve.
  • Advise litigators. Help partners and senior litigation leads build Syllo into case strategy, from early case assessment through trial preparation.
  • Scope large matters. Define technical requirements before major ingestions and court-ordered productions, so the plan holds when the volume arrives.
  • Resolve escalations. Serve as the technical escalation point for difficult data issues, compressed production deadlines, and sensitive accounts.
  • Partner with Sales. Work with Account Directors on account health, renewals, and expansion, and brief client leadership on results.
  • Shape the product. Bring specific feature requests and specific wins from your matters to Product and Marketing.

What You Bring

  • Litigation depth. You have run early case assessment, large-volume processing, complex productions, deposition preparation, and privilege logs under court deadlines. You can explain the tradeoffs to a partner.
  • Team development. You have turned specialists into people clients ask for by name.
  • Composure with senior clients. You can tell a partner a deadline is at risk, explain why, and present the recovery plan in the same conversation.
  • Hands-on habits. You still like doing the work. Leading the pod does not mean leaving the platform.
  • Commercial judgment. You understand what drives cost and value in legal technology, and you connect client feedback to renewals and product decisions.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 8+ years in litigation support, eDiscovery delivery, or client success at a law firm, legal services provider, or legal technology company.
  • 3+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep experience on at least one major review platform, such as Relativity or Everlaw.
  • A record of running several large matters at once.
  • Prior work as a litigation attorney, senior paralegal, or lead litigation support specialist is a strong plus.

Total rewards and benefits

At Syllo, we believe in taking care of our team so they can focus on building the future of legal tech.

Compensation: Competitive base salary + equity options.

Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, and voluntary insurance options. Vacation, sick leave, and paid holidays. Access to benefit counselors and fitness class reimbursements.

Equal opportunity employer

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We provide a fair and accessible hiring process. If you require accommodations during the application or interview stage, please let us know.

$150,000—$180,000 USD

Engagement Manager

London, 4x days per week in-office

Vega is looking for exceptional engagement managers to lead client deliveries from end-to-end, and embody client partnership as our competitive advantage. This role acts as the bridge between sophisticated enterprise clients, product, and engineering - holding scope, timelines, and requirements together to drive a truly market-leading client experience.

About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the day-to-day relationship, requirements shaping, and delivery coordination for a small portfolio of enterprise customers - ensuring they receive maximum value from the platform and a white-glove partnership experience, whilst protecting Product & Engineering teams from unstructured or ad-hoc demand.

    • Including running check-ins, business reviews, roadmap discussions, discovery workshops, etc.

  • Act as the main bridge between enterprise clients and Vega’s product & engineering teams, translating customer needs into clear, prioritised, and deliverable work - with clear success criteria and scalability with the platform.

  • Work with Product to ensure there is a clear linkage between customer demand and product direction - collaborating to understand the trade-offs between effort, impact, and complexity and prioritise customer-driven requests across the product surface and multiple customers.

  • Actively build and shape the playbook for how we run engagements at scale, with processes and automations to coordinate with engineering, track progress, communicate release plans and updates to customers, etc.

  • Support the Growth team to ensure customers adopt and realise value from new features, identify expansion opportunities through deeper platform usage, and maximise opportunities for customer retention and satisfaction.

  • Strong candidates will usually have experience working directly with engineering teams and enterprise stakeholders, particularly in environments involving integrations, configuration-heavy products, or complex customer requirements.

What we look for:

  • Experience delivering complex technology projects in enterprise contexts, with a strong focus on customer success or implementation leadership - having done so in a start-up / scale-up context is a strong plus, or as a project leader in consulting focused on tech delivery.

  • Strong interpersonal skills, ability to manage enterprise customer relationships across a range of stakeholders (e.g., business, tech, and ops teams) and collaborate with internal product and engineering teams on delivery.

  • Confidence and judgement, with the ability to decide when and how to challenge requests, and an awareness of scalability and trade-offs when making those judgement calls.

  • Excellent communication skills across both technical and non-technical audiences.

Why join us?

  • You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more
