raw.excerpt: About Us Our company is on a mission to reduce food waste and make high-quality, affordable food accessible to everyone.
raw.description:
About Us
Our company is on a mission to reduce food waste and make high-quality, affordable food accessible to everyone. Through our innovative app-based marketplace, we connect shoppers with discounted perishable items while helping retailers turn would-be waste into revenue and meaningful environmental impact. We’re growing quickly across North America and partnering with retailers of all sizes to expand our reach.

If you’re passionate about creating real change for people and the planet, we’d love for you to join us. Your work here will directly contribute to a mission that helps families save money, reduces waste, and builds a more sustainable future.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Senior Manager, B2B Marketing who brings an ownership mentality and sits at the intersection of marketing and revenue. This is a B2B and partner marketing seat, not a consumer marketing one: you'll own how Flashfood reaches and engages the enterprise grocery retailers we partner with, combining demand generation and account-based marketing aimed at retail buyers with co-marketing programs built jointly with our retail partners. You'll build the campaigns and account strategies that move buyers from awareness to signed partnership.

Our buyers are senior grocery operators — VPs and Directors of Merchandising, Operations, and Finance at major chains. Our go-to-market is focused and precise by design, which means every program needs to earn its place. You'll have real ownership over strategy and spend, reporting to the VP of Marketing and Communications and working closely with our Revenue and Partnerships teams to build a demand engine that's high impact and measurable.

What You'll Do

Own Flashfood's Market Presence

  • Define how Flashfood shows up to enterprise grocery retailers across every buyer touchpoint
  • Build the annual B2B marketing plan, establishing priorities, investment areas, and campaign themes that support revenue goals
  • Develop a deep understanding of grocery retail decision-makers and continuously refine how we engage them
  • Partner with Revenue leadership to identify market opportunities and strategic growth initiatives
  • Act as the connective tissue between Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, and Customer Success to ensure a consistent market narrative
  • Lay the groundwork to build and eventually lead a team as the B2B marketing function grows

Build Demand and Create Pipeline

  • Design and execute targeted campaigns that generate engagement and pipeline from priority retailer accounts
  • Develop account-based programs that combine paid media, email, and personalized outreach
  • Build co-marketing programs — joint, partner-funded campaigns developed together with retail partners — alongside retailer-directed demand generation and ABM
  • Create scalable approaches to engaging senior retail decision-makers while maintaining a highly targeted go-to-market motion
  • Leverage buyer signals, intent data, and AI-powered workflows to identify opportunities and activate campaigns
  • Continuously test, optimize, and evolve programs based on performance and business priorities

Establish Flashfood as an Industry Voice

  • Own Flashfood's LinkedIn strategy, including company presence, executive thought leadership, content promotion, and audience growth
  • Build a content strategy that supports awareness, consideration, and deal acceleration across the buyer journey
  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate customer insights, product innovation, and industry trends into compelling stories
  • Create customer success narratives, ROI-focused case studies, and proof points that demonstrate measurable retailer outcomes
  • Identify opportunities to elevate Flashfood's visibility within grocery, retail technology, and sustainability conversations

Create High-Value Customer and Prospect Experiences

  • Lead Flashfood's event and field marketing strategy, including trade shows, retailer meetings, executive dinners, and industry gatherings
  • Design programs that create meaningful interactions with senior grocery leaders and support relationship-building throughout the sales cycle
  • Ensure every event and engagement program has clear objectives, follow-up plans, and measurable business outcomes

Measure Impact and Improve Performance

  • Define the metrics that matter and build reporting that clearly connects marketing activity to pipeline and revenue outcomes
  • Partner with RevOps to strengthen attribution, lead management, and performance visibility across the funnel
  • Evaluate and implement AI, automation, and emerging technologies that improve efficiency and effectiveness
  • Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to leadership based on campaign, channel, and pipeline performance
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years in Marketing with 5+ in B2B or partner marketing, where the core of your work has been built in direct partnership with, or toward, other brands and organizations — this is not primarily a consumer or brand marketing background
  • Experience marketing within an industry that has gone through major evolution, and having been part of that shift from the B2B side
  • Comfort operating in highly cross-functional environments — you don't think about B2B marketing in a silo
  • A track record of owning strategy and making channel investment decisions
  • Proven campaign strategy and execution experience across channels, including building, tracking, and optimization
  • Experience owning company strategy for trade shows, industry events, hosted dinners, and other field programs
  • Strong content development experience, including campaign copy, targeted emails, and event promotion
  • A strategic thinker and clear communicator who can articulate the plan clearly to both marketing and sales stakeholders
  • Genuine fluency with AI tooling for B2B marketing activations
  • A natural cross-functional partner who keeps internal teams aligned and bought into the B2B marketing strategy

Nice-to-Haves

  • Product marketing experience
  • Direct experience in grocery, retail, or CPG — we're equally open to strong candidates from adjacent enterprise B2B industries with sharp ABM instincts

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits
  • 100% remote work with flexibility and trust
  • Mission-driven work that reduces food waste and expands access to affordable food
  • A fast-growing, collaborative team with big ambitions
  • Real opportunities for career growth

Flashfood is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we’re dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels supported and empowered to do their best work.

raw.description:
About Abridge

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

The Role

Join Abridge as a Senior Technical Sourcer and help us identify and engage exceptional Engineering and Product leaders—Managers, Directors, and other senior technical talent—who will shape the future of healthcare AI. Our Engineering and Product organizations are building world-class technology at the intersection of healthcare and machine learning, and this role is critical to fueling that leadership pipeline.

As a key member of the recruiting team, you’ll strategically source and cultivate relationships with high-impact leaders across the industry. You’ll map the leadership landscape within software, infrastructure, ML, and product teams, identifying where the next generation of technical and product leadership talent is emerging. You’ll also act as a strategic partner to recruiters and business leaders, bringing market insights that inform how we attract and engage senior talent.

This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives on building relationships with senior leaders, understands organizational design and technical team structures, and is excited to connect exceptional people to a mission-driven company.

What You’ll Do

  • Source Senior Engineering & Product Leaders: Identify, engage, and nurture relationships with Engineering Managers, Directors, Product Leaders, and senior technical talent across software, infrastructure, ML, and product domains.

  • Market & Org Mapping: Develop deep organizational intelligence on top companies—charting leadership structures, team compositions, and reporting lines across both engineering and product functions.

  • Talent Strategy: Partner closely with recruiters, engineering leaders, and product executives to define ideal leadership profiles, calibrate on role scope, and refine sourcing strategies for high-impact technical and product leadership roles.

  • Candidate Engagement: Craft thoughtful, personalized outreach to inspire engineering and product leaders to explore Abridge’s mission and vision. Build long-term relationships that position Abridge as a destination for top-tier leadership talent.

  • Pipeline Development: Build and manage a steady pipeline of current and future leadership talent to support both near-term and long-term hiring needs across engineering and product.

  • Talent Insights: Deliver actionable market intelligence on leadership talent availability, compensation trends, and competitive movement across engineering and product landscapes.

  • Operational Excellence: Maintain clear records and progress tracking in our ATS (Ashby) and ensure consistent communication on pipeline health and sourcing performance.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience: 5+ years in technical sourcing or recruiting, with a focus on machine learning, AI research, or advanced engineering roles.

  • Deep Market Knowledge: Familiarity with top ML/AI conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.), academic labs, and industry-leading researchers.

  • Proven Success: Track record of engaging and converting senior technical talent in competitive markets.

  • Strategic Mindset: Ability to go beyond filling roles—designing long-term talent mapping and pipeline strategies.

  • Strong Communication: Excellent written and verbal skills, with the ability to build authentic relationships with senior-level candidates.

  • Curiosity & Tenacity: A researcher’s mindset, driven to uncover hidden talent and creative in finding new pathways to connect.

This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of 2 days per week in our San Francisco or NYC office, with flexibility for remote work on other days.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Compensation Range: $156K - $180K

Through close collaboration with operations teams, we improve resource utilization, strengthen the customer experience, and build workforce practices that can scale with the business.

About the role

As Manager, Workforce Planning, you’ll lead a team of resource planning analysts to help achieve service-level and operational efficiency goals. You’ll shape workforce planning strategies, optimize staffing resources, and develop a team structure built for agility and scale.

Partnering across operations, you’ll translate data into actionable recommendations, strengthen workforce planning practices, and develop the team’s skills and expertise. Your work will help improve customer and partner experiences while positioning workforce planning as a trusted source of insight across the organization.

You will get to:

Who you are

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

About Pave Bank

Pave Bank is a fully licensed commercial bank, regulated by the National Bank of Georgia. We are reimagining how global businesses access and move capital by bridging the gap between traditional finance and digital assets. Joining Pave Bank means becoming part of a fast-growing institution redefining this convergence. You will have the opportunity to work alongside second-time founders and industry leaders, gain deep exposure to institutional banking and digital assets, and grow within a dynamic and ambitious team.

The Role

We are seeking a People Operations Manager to join our team. The position will be based in Malaysia (or SEA) with travel to Georgia. This role will be responsible for building, owning, and scaling the people operations infrastructure across Pave Bank as we grow across multiple countries and entities. The role will have end-to-end ownership of core HR processes, systems, policies, and employee administration, while partnering closely with leadership and managers to create a consistent and high-quality employee experience across the Group.

The ideal candidate will be highly hands-on, comfortable operating in a fast-growing environment, and able to build scalable processes rather than simply administer existing ones.

Key Responsibilities

  • People Operations: Own day-to-day people operations across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee changes, documentation, leave administration, benefits, and offboarding across Group entities.

  • HRIS & People Systems: Own and continuously improve the Group’s HRIS and people technology stack, ensuring employee data is accurate, processes are automated where possible, and systems can support a multi-entity and multi-country organization.

  • Payroll & Benefits: Coordinate payroll and benefits administration across jurisdictions, working with Finance, external payroll providers, and local partners to ensure accurate and timely processing.

  • Process Improvement: Continuously identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve people processes while maintaining appropriate controls and documentation.

  • Entity & Corporate Administration: Coordinate entity-level corporate administration and liaise with corporate secretarial providers across Group entities to maintain accurate corporate records, support required filings and governance processes, and provide entity documentation internally as needed.

Requirements

  • The ideal candidate has 6–10 years of experience in People Operations, HR Operations, or generalist HR roles, with meaningful ownership and hands-on experience of core HR processes rather than purely advisory experience.

  • Demonstrated experience building or significantly improving HR processes and systems, ideally within a startup, scale-up, fintech, financial services, or similarly fast-moving organization.

  • Experience supporting a multi-country and multi-entity workforce, with an understanding of the operational complexities of employment across different jurisdictions.

  • Strong experience with HRIS platforms, payroll administration, employee data management, and HR process automation.

  • Experience managing onboarding, offboarding, employment documentation, policies, and employee relations.

  • Comfortable working independently with a high degree of ownership, including identifying gaps and implementing solutions without requiring highly developed existing processes.

raw.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a strategic Mainframe Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end architectural design, integration, and modernization roadmap of our mission-critical IBM Z enterprise systems. In this role, you will bridge core legacy platforms with modern distributed and cloud ecosystems, ensuring scalability, high availability, security, and alignment with long-term business objectives.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and govern end-to-end technical architectures across mainframe (z/OS) and hybrid cloud/distributed environments.

  • Lead solution design for core system enhancements, API enablement, data replication, and legacy modernization initiatives.

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, and engineering leads to translate complex functional requirements into scalable architectural blueprints.

  • Evaluate and recommend modernization patterns (e.g., API wrapping, refactoring, co-existence, or rehosting) while minimizing operational risk and downtime.

  • Establish non-functional requirements covering transaction throughput, disaster recovery, security compliance, and high availability.

  • Provide architectural oversight, technical mentorship, and design reviews for onshore and offshore mainframe development teams.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 10+ years of experience in mainframe engineering, with at least 3+ years in a Solution Architect or Principal Technical Lead capacity.

  • Comprehensive mastery of the IBM z/OS ecosystem, including COBOL, JCL, DB2, CICS, VSAM, and IBM MQ.

  • Proven track record architecting hybrid integrations between mainframe backends and modern distributed/cloud platforms (REST APIs, microservices, Kafka).

  • Strong understanding of enterprise security, data privacy, and regulatory compliance standards in banking or financial services.

  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills with the ability to present complex architectural trade-offs to both technical and executive audiences.

Technical Depth

  • Deep architectural knowledge of high-volume online transaction processing (CICS/IMS) and large-scale batch processing patterns.

  • Hands-on familiarity with integration and modernization middleware such as IBM z/OS Connect, MQSeries, CDC (Change Data Capture), or API gateways.

  • Strong grasp of database architecture, capacity planning, and system-level performance optimization on DB2 for z/OS.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and mainframe-to-cloud migration or re-platforming projects.

  • Familiarity with modern mainframe DevOps toolchains (Git, Jenkins, IBM Developer for z/OS, SonarQube).

  • Relevant architectural certifications (e.g., TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect, or IBM Z certifications).

raw.description:
We're hiring a Product Marketing Manager to help us win new customers and grow the ones we have. You'll sit at the center of two motions: supporting new business with sales enablement, prospect-facing webinars, and our growing product-led growth (PLG) function, and bringing existing customers onto the latest version of our platform.

About FormAssembly

FormAssembly is a data collection and workflow automation platform that helps organizations in financial services, higher education, healthcare, nonprofit, and government collect accurate data and move it into the systems where work happens, including deep Salesforce integration. Thousands of organizations rely on us to replace manual processes with secure, automated workflows.

What you'll do

Support new business and PLG

  • Build sales enablement materials such as battlecards, talk tracks, one-pagers, and decks, and keep them current as the product and market change
  • Plan, produce, and host prospect-focused webinars that support demand generation and campaign goals
  • Help develop our PLG function by testing and improving trial and new-customer communications, and by reporting on activation and conversion

Drive customer migration and communications

  • Support and execute the marketing side of the plan to move existing customers onto the latest platform version
  • Plan, write, and send the monthly newsletter and lifecycle and announcement emails, and report on their performance
  • Own the customer training webinar program, using it to drive adoption and expansion

Build proof that sells

  • Own the customer success story and case study program, and package stories by industry, use case, and persona for use in deals and renewals

Work across teams

  • Partner with Product on launches and feedback loops, Support on recurring customer questions, and Sales on enablement, expansion, and renewal plays
  • Define goals, measure what works, and propose where to invest next

Requirements

  • 2–5 years in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, product marketing, or a similar B2B SaaS role
  • Experience running customer-facing programs end to end, such as webinars, newsletters, or case studies
  • Strong writing and interviewing skills: you can turn a customer conversation into a story that sells
  • Comfort with email and marketing automation platforms and basic reporting on engagement and conversion
  • Ability to explain a technical product change clearly to a non-technical audience
  • A habit of working across teams: you can get Product, Support, Sales, and Customer Success aligned without owning their roadmaps
  • Organized and self-directed, able to manage several recurring programs and deadlines at once
  • Product marketing experience, including sales enablement content and messaging
  • Experience with webinars or campaigns that support pipeline
  • Familiarity with testing and measurement, such as A/B tests, trial or onboarding flows, and conversion metrics

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting a PLG or free-trial motion
  • Experience with Salesforce
  • Experience with a webinar platform (ON24, Goldcast or similar)
  • Experience with Pendo, Appcues, or similar
  • Background supporting a platform migration, product transition, or major release
  • Basic video editing or content production skills
  • Familiarity with form, workflow, or data collection software

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: You've learned the platform and our customers, taken over training webinar development, case studies, and newsletter calendars, delivered your first enablement asset for Sales, and developed migration campaign content.
  • By 6 months: Migration communications are running on a segmented cadence, webinar attendance and on-demand views are trending up, and the case study pipeline is steady.
  • By 12 months: Customer marketing is a measurable contributor to adoption and expansion, with reporting you present to Product, Support, Sales, and Customer Success.

Why join us

You'll join at a pivotal moment: a newly updated platform, a customer base ready to move with it, and a small, cross-functional team where your programs are visible to the whole company. FormAssembly has a tight, supportive culture where everyone has a voice, great benefits and unlimited PTO.

Base salary range: $95,000 - $115,000

Benefits

FormAssembly is a completely remote/distributed team. We thrive through digital communication, and work to connect numerous times a day. Our culture is vibrant, fun, and unique! Some of our benefits include:

  • Health benefits (health, dental, vision) for Team Members based in the United States
  • Mental Health benefits with SpringHealth
  • 401(k) with 4% company match
  • Unlimited PTO (with a required minimum use of 2 weeks per year) for Salaried/Exempt staff, or 4 weeks of paid vacation for hourly/non-exempt employees.
  • 9 paid company holidays
  • Flexible work schedule; work from anywhere!
  • Generous Paid parental leave (up to 16 weeks)
  • Charitable contribution match
  • Budget for professional development
  • Company provided Mac laptop

You'll be joining a talented and fun team, working together to build something great!

raw.description:
About Refold

Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it.

Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves.

Traction: 30+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500+ active users, 10M+ API calls processed daily, seven-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time-to-go-live by 70% and recovered 8,000+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5-month builds to 90% faster delivery.

Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. We've raised $6.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating.

We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. This is an early BDR seat and the pipeline engine for our US market. If you want a role where your outbound directly decides whether the company hits its number, this is it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the top of the funnel: Research, target, and break into software companies in supply chain, procurement, finance, and professional services automation — the ones where an ERP connector is the thing standing between them and their next enterprise deal

  • Write outbound that earns a reply: No spray and pray. Our best sequences are built on real triggers — a company hiring integration engineers, an integrations page with six connectors and a "contact us" for the rest, a public complaint about implementation timelines

  • Work the signals: Learn to hear the buying triggers on a first call — "we rebuild integrations for every customer," "we lost a deal because we didn't have the connector," "our SI missed the deadline again" — and know exactly what to do with each one

  • Run the AI stack: We already run an AI SDR for enrichment and first-touch outreach. Your edge isn't volume; it's judgement — which accounts matter, which message lands, and when a human needs to take over

  • Qualify with rigour: Run sharp first conversations, qualify honestly, and hand off to the AE with context they can actually use. A meeting that shouldn't have been booked costs us more than a meeting we missed

  • Go multi-channel: Email, LinkedIn, phone, and in person. You will pick up the phone

  • Work the room: Book meetings around PMA, SAP Connect, TSIA, Ai4, and our executive dinner series — before, during, and after

  • Keep the data honest: HubSpot hygiene, clean notes, accurate stages. Our forecasting is only as good as your inputs

Role Information

  • Target accounts: Sales-led software companies with an integrations page, an internal professional services team or SI dependency, and enterprise deals that hinge on connectors

  • Personas you'll open: CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, and VPs of Professional Services / Delivery

  • Average deal size you're feeding: $50–100K land / $200–300K expand

  • Current growth team: 1 BDR, 1 AE, 2 Marketing, 4 Post-Sale, plus a 20-person engineering and delivery org

  • Path: This is a clear on-ramp to an AE seat for someone who earns it

Required Skills & Abilities

  • Outbound reps on the board: 1–3 years in a BDR, SDR, or business development role. At least a year of genuine cold outbound — you've built lists, run sequences, and made the calls

  • Phone-ready: You're not precious about cold calling, and you don't hide behind email

  • You can write: A four-sentence email that a CTO actually answers is a real skill, and you have it, or you're obsessed with getting it

  • Technically curious: You don't need an engineering background, but you should want to understand what an integration is, why it breaks, and why our customers care

  • High output, high coachability: You take feedback in the morning and apply it that afternoon. You track your own numbers before anyone asks

  • Presence matters: Based in the SF Bay Area and ready to collaborate in-office 3 days a week

Nice to Have

  • Prospected into technical buyers or software companies rather than SMB generalists

  • Hands-on with HubSpot, Clay, Sales Navigator, or AI-assisted prospecting tooling

  • Been the first or second BDR somewhere and had to build the motion, not inherit a playbook

  • A technical background, a side project, or anything that shows you can learn a complex product fast

Compensation:

  • $50,000-$70,000

Why do you want to work here?

  • Impact: Fast-growing seed-stage company ($6.5M from Eniac Ventures & Tidal Ventures) with early Fortune 500-scale deployments and real, quantified customer outcomes

  • Speed: Early GTM seat with direct founder access and a visible path to closing your own deals

  • Ownership: You'll help write the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's

Equal Employment Opportunity

We're a small, fast-growing team, and we're intentional about building an inclusive culture from day one. We welcome teammates of all backgrounds and don't discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. If you're excited by our mission, you belong here.

Compensation Range: $50K - $70K

raw.description:
Head of Strategy & Transformation – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Head of Strategy & Transformation is responsible for developing, coordinating, and executing the organization's strategic initiatives and business transformation programmes. The role translates corporate strategy into actionable plans, drives operational improvements, and ensures that transformation projects deliver measurable business outcomes.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the position focuses on strengthening business performance, improving operational efficiency, supporting digital innovation, enhancing customer experience, and ensuring alignment with regulatory and market developments.

The role works closely with senior leadership and departmental heads to ensure that strategic priorities are implemented effectively across the organization.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Support the development and implementation of corporate strategy and long-term business plans.
  • Translate organizational objectives into strategic initiatives, departmental priorities, and measurable action plans.
  • Conduct market research, competitor analysis, industry benchmarking, and strategic assessments.
  • Identify opportunities for business growth, market expansion, product development, and operational improvement.
  • Coordinate annual strategic planning and business performance reviews.

B. Business Transformation & Programme Management

  • Lead and coordinate enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across business functions.
  • Develop transformation roadmaps, implementation plans, milestones, and performance measures.
  • Identify opportunities to redesign business processes, operating models, and organizational structures.
  • Monitor transformation projects to ensure delivery within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
  • Resolve implementation challenges and escalate strategic risks to senior management.

C. Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

  • Evaluate existing business processes and identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Implement process optimization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Establish performance management frameworks to improve productivity and service delivery.
  • Collaborate with business units to standardize workflows and strengthen operational controls.
  • Drive cost optimization and resource utilization initiatives.

D. Digital Transformation & Innovation

  • Coordinate digital transformation initiatives involving automation, AI, data analytics, and enterprise technology platforms.
  • Work with IT and business teams to identify technology solutions that support strategic objectives.
  • Support modernization of legacy systems and improvement of digital service delivery.
  • Encourage innovation and technology adoption across business functions.
  • Track the business impact and adoption of digital transformation initiatives.

E. Performance Management & Strategic Reporting

  • Establish and monitor strategic KPIs, operational metrics, and transformation performance indicators.
  • Prepare management reports, dashboards, and progress updates for executive leadership.
  • Analyze business performance against strategic targets and recommend corrective actions.
  • Track financial and operational benefits generated by transformation initiatives.
  • Ensure accountability for the delivery of strategic objectives across departments.

F. Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Develop and coordinate change management plans to support organizational transformation.
  • Engage department heads, managers, and employees to encourage adoption of new processes and systems.
  • Coordinate internal communication, training, and capability-building initiatives.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and address resistance to organizational change.
  • Promote a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

G. Governance, Risk & Regulatory Alignment

  • Ensure transformation initiatives comply with relevant insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Identify and monitor strategic, operational, financial, and implementation risks.
  • Establish appropriate project governance, reporting structures, and escalation procedures.
  • Coordinate with compliance, risk, finance, and internal audit teams.
  • Maintain documentation and reporting for strategic programmes and transformation activities.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

raw.description:
Our Engineering organisation is scaling its AI Engineering capabilities under new leadership, creating an opportunity to shape the next generation of AI at Rapid7. We’re looking for Senior Principal AI Engineers to define and influence the technical direction of our LLM and agentic AI systems across the organisation. You’ll tackle our most complex technical challenges, establish architectural principles and engineering standards, and drive greenfield innovation that delivers meaningful impact for our global customers. Through technical leadership and mentoring, you’ll shape strategic product and platform investments and influence how we build and scale AI across Rapid7.


About the Team

AI is reshaping cybersecurity on both sides. Attackers can use AI to strike at machine speed, and only AI-powered defense can keep up. At the same time, organizations can only adopt AI with confidence if it is secure. Rapid7 sits at the intersection of security and AI, and we are building industry-defining products for this new era.


Rapid7's AI Engineering team builds the AI that powers our security platform. We are AI engineers and applied scientists who take models from research to production, combining open-source and frontier LLMs, AI agents, and fast predictive models with more than 20 years of Rapid7 security expertise. Our work drives core use cases across Detection and Response, such as alert triage, threat investigation, and automated response, and Exposure and Remediation, such as vulnerability prioritization, attack surface risk assessment, and guided remediation. Together, these help customers stop threats faster and fix what matters most.


About the Role

As a Senior Principal AI Engineer, you will set the technical direction for how Rapid7 builds, tunes and serves LLMs and agentic systems across its security products. You understand LLMs from the ground up, from transformer internals and training to fine-tuning and inference optimization, and you stay hands-on with the hardest problems. You know where LLMs shine and where they fall short, and you treat them as one tool in the AI toolbox, alongside predictive AI and classical ML, choosing the right approach for each problem. Specifically your focus will be to:

  • Set the AI technical vision, architecture and multi-year roadmap for LLM and agentic systems across Detection and Response and Exposure and Remediation
  • Define company-wide model strategy, including when to use frontier or open-source models, when to fine-tune, distill or post-train, and where to invest in new capabilities
  • Lead the most complex and highest-risk technical initiatives across multiple teams, including fine-tuning, distillation and post-training of open-source LLMs on security data
  • Establish company-wide standards for context engineering, inference optimization and evaluation, with evals as the release gate for every AI system we ship
  • Lead optimization of LLM inference at scale, balancing quality, latency and cost
  • Lead design reviews, resolve the most complex technical trade-offs, and stay hands-on by prototyping and building critical model, training and inference code
  • Mentor and develop Principal, Staff and Senior engineers, building the depth of AI engineering talent across Rapid7
  • Represent Rapid7’s AI engineering to executives, customers and the external community, influencing product, platform and business strategy

The skills and qualities you’ll bring include:

  • 14+ years of software or ML engineering experience, including 2+ years building production LLM or agentic AI systems. A PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI or a related field is preferred, or equivalent depth of expertise demonstrated through industry experience and technical contributions
  • A track record of building scalable, production-grade AI systems and shared platforms adopted across multiple products, with company-wide impact through technical leadership, mentoring and standards
  • Leading-edge expertise in LLMs, including transformer architecture, attention, tokenization and positional encodings, and how models are trained and served, with advanced PyTorch skills spanning custom model code, mixed precision and distributed training (e.g., FSDP, DeepSpeed)
  • Hands-on fine-tuning and post-training of open-weight LLMs, including full and parameter-efficient methods (LoRA, QLoRA), distillation, and preference or RL-based methods (e.g., DPO, GRPO), ideally including experience training LLMs from scratch
  • Deep experience with context engineering (retrieval, memory, and context management for long-running agent workflows) and with defining evaluation strategy and benchmarks for LLM and agent systems
  • Deep knowledge of inference optimization, including prefill and decode, KV-cache management, continuous batching, speculative decoding and quantization, and serving at scale with vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM, ideally on AWS and including GPU kernel work (CUDA or Triton)
  • Strong predictive AI, classical ML, distributed systems and Python fundamentals, with the judgment to make efficient, transparent decisions between these approaches and LLMs based on accuracy, latency and cost
  • Takes accountability for organisation-wide technical outcomes, proactively addressing systemic risks and removing barriers to delivery while ensuring technical decisions align with strategic priorities
  • An influential communicator who can articulate complex architectural trade-offs, build consensus and influence technical and product decisions across the organisation
  • Builds alignment across Engineering, Product and other functions on technical direction, driving decisions that shape product and platform investments.
  • Anticipates evolving customer needs and shapes AI architecture and technical strategy to maximise customer value, making informed trade-offs between capability, performance, cost and scalability to guide product and platform investment
  • Thrive in ambiguity at the leading edge of AI, driving change and focusing forward as the technology and the threat landscape evolve
  • Recognition as an expert in AI, evidenced by publications, patents, open-source contributions or industry engagement
  • Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success.

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That’s because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don’t be shy - apply today.


About Rapid7

At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.


Protecting 11,500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.


Rapid7, Inc. is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. We evaluate compensation decisions on a case-by-case basis, and it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the very top of the salary range.


The annual salary range for this role, depending on location, is:

Salary ranges may vary based on geographical location. This range does not include variable/incentive compensation, equity and benefits (where applicable/eligible).

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

Allara is a comprehensive women’s health provider that specializes in expert, longitudinal care that supports women through every life stage. Trusted by thousands of women nationwide, Allara makes expert healthcare accessible by connecting patients with multidisciplinary care teams that have a deep understanding of hormonal, metabolic, and reproductive care. Allara provides ongoing support for hormonal conditions like PCOS, chronic conditions like insulin resistance, and life stages like perimenopause, helping patients see improved health outcomes. As one of the fastest-growing women’s health platforms in the U.S., Allara is bridging long-overlooked gaps in healthcare for women.

The Opportunity

We're hiring board-certified Gynecologists who want to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care to women who have historically been underserved. Applicants must hold an active IMLC (Interstate Medical Licensure Compact) license or be actively in the process of obtaining one. To learn more about our mission and clinical approach, visit .

Location: Fully remote within the U.S.

Your Impact

  • Conduct thorough patient assessments and develop personalized treatment plans via video visits

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary care team to deliver the highest standards of care

  • Complete required training(s) and uphold Allara's clinical policies, standards, and best practices

  • Educate patients on preventative care and wellness using evidence-based strategies

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date patient records and complete charting in a timely manner

  • Respond to patient questions and administrative messages and tasks with clarity and care

  • Dedicate a minimum of 10-20 patient-facing hours per week, depending on hiring needs, including consultations and medical guidance, with prescribing when clinically appropriate

Required Qualifications

  • Degree: MD or DO from an accredited institution

  • Board Certification: Active national board certification in Gynecology

  • Experience: Minimum of 2 years of consecutive clinical experience as a Gynecologist, with a focus on chronic and complex women's health conditions including PCOS, Endometriosis, Hypothyroidism, Hashimoto's, Metabolic Syndrome, Menopause, Fertility, Postpartum, PMDD, and Obesity

  • IMLC license: Active IMLC license or be actively in the process of obtaining one

  • Clinical Independence: Proven ability to function as an autonomous provider with strong diagnostic judgment and critical thinking skills

  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with an emphasis on compassion and clarity

  • Webside Manner: A natural ability to build trust and connection with patients in a virtual setting

  • Evidence-Based Practice: A genuine commitment to delivering care rooted in current clinical research

  • Technical Proficiency: Comfortable working across multiple platforms including EMR systems, text expanders, Gmail, Google Calendar, Zoom, and scheduling tools

  • Telemedicine Experience: Prior telehealth experience is a plus

  • State License Requirements & Hiring Considerations: An active, unrestricted, and unencumbered professional license in at least one U.S. state is required.

IMLC License Requirement & Participating States

An active IMLC license - or active pursuit of one - is required for this role. The IMLC speeds up and simplifies the process of obtaining a medical license in additional states, creating an expedited licensure pathway to multi-state licensing.

To view a map of all current participating states, licensing costs by state, and the IMLC application, please visit the IMLC website.

A note on state licensing: All active and pending licenses held at the time of application are collected and reviewed during our process. Hiring decisions reflect current state-level needs, which evolve over time. Applicants may not move forward immediately if there is no active need in their licensed states. We regularly revisit candidates as needs expand and when experience, licensure, and role requirements align.

  • 1099 Contract: The flexibility and autonomy of an independent contractor arrangement

  • 1099 Longevity Recognition Bonus

  • Competitive Compensation: Per-visit rates plus additional pay for charting, administrative tasks, and other patient-related work

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the U.S.

  • Flexible Scheduling: Set hours that fit your life, not the other way around

  • Malpractice Insurance: Comprehensive coverage provided at no cost to you

  • Mission-Driven Work: Help transform the standard of care for women living with conditions that have historically been underdiagnosed and undertreated

  • Collaborative Provider Network: Connect with and learn from a community of skilled, like-minded Allara clinicians

  • Inclusive Culture: Join a supportive, diverse team that values innovation, equity, and belonging

At Allara, we believe in celebrating everything that makes us human and are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We embrace diversity and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better we can serve our members. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against candidates or patients based on race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence are at the heart of the Airbnb product. From Trust to Payments, and from Customer Service to Marketing we rely on ML to ensure that guests and hosts have the best possible experience with Airbnb.

Our ML team in Assistance Engineering is the team responsible for adopting the Agentic AI technologies to enable an intelligent, scalable and exceptional customer service experience. We are responsible for developing the Chat AI assistant, Voice AI Assistant and Human agent Assistant! The team is constantly exploring the SOTA Agentic architecture, develops and enhances various AI models, ML services and leverages tools including SFT, Reinforcement learning, Distillation, RAG/Search, LLM evaluation and testing automation, feedback-based learning and guardrail for a wide range of applications in Airbnb.

The Difference You Will Make:

We believe our current customer experiences in these domains are only scratching the surface of the innovations that are possible, and that science is at the heart of delivering a step-function change for our Guest and and Host on Airbnb.

You will build and leverage cutting edge AI technologies to transform Airbnb’s customer service by delivering personalized, easy-to-use and proactive customer service experience.

Many of the initiatives you’ll tackle are in their early conceptual stages. You will have the opportunity to shape these ideas from inception to production, turning visionary concepts into impactful realities.

  • Experience building Agentic AI systems — including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use, planning, memory, and autonomous reasoning pipelines (e.g., ReAct, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar)
  • Experience of shipping production-grade ML/AI systems at scale, with deep understanding of ML infrastructure, model serving, and MLOps best practices
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Product, and Design organizations

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

$196,000—$227,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

We’re hiring an account manager to run their own book of the founders we work with, and to be the person each of them works with every week.

About Pairs
Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout US founders, from seed to Series B, in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who know their market and can open the doors they need. We work only with the top 1% of deals, vet every founder and investor before they join, and invest our own money alongside our investors in a few of the companies we believe in most.

The role
You run the founder side of Pairs for your book. Every founder gets a call with you each week, you go through their investor meetings with them and what to change before the next one, and between calls you are the one they write to. Software and AI run the admin, so the role isn’t technical and your time goes to your founders.

What you will own

  • Your book of founders, from their first week with Pairs to their renewal.

  • A strategy call with every founder in your book each week, prepared before it starts and followed up the same day.

  • An answer to every question between calls, on the same day.

  • Renewals and upgrades in your book. We measure you on how many of your founders stay and how many take a longer plan.

  • What you hear from founders, passed to our investor team so the next meetings we book fit better.

You are a fit if you

  • Communicate clearly and with confidence, on calls and in writing.

  • Know how a seed to Series B round works, because you raised one yourself or worked at a fund or an accelerator.

  • Can walk us through a renewal or an upgrade you sold yourself.

  • Build trust by listening first and respecting a founder’s time.

  • Handle confidential deal and investor information with care.

Compensation
OTE of $100,000 to $160,000 USD, base plus commission.

Location and working style
Fully remote. Your founders are in the US, so your calls sit in US Eastern hours. The team works across London, New York, Dubai and San Francisco. You get the best AI tools, paid for, a written playbook for your calls and a senior team that coaches you every week.

How to apply
Apply through our short form. Tell us about the book of clients you ran and what you did when one of them wanted to leave. Describe your clients by type and leave their names out.

Compensation Range: $100K - $160K

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for full stack engineers to build fast across BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for product-minded engineers who can move across frontend, backend, internal tools and customer journeys to turn ideas into working products quickly.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship full product features across frontend, backend, APIs and databases.

  • Create customer and internal workflows for onboarding, accounts, payments, rewards, travel, FX, support automation, KYC and risk.

  • Turn ambiguous product problems into working systems with clean UX and reliable backend logic.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI engineers to launch fast and improve after release.

  • Build internal tools and automation that reduce manual work and help teams operate at scale.

  • Own your work beyond release: monitor, debug, learn and improve.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong full stack engineering experience with real shipped products.

  • Comfortable across frontend, backend, APIs, databases and production debugging.

  • Good frontend execution using React, Next.js, Vue or similar modern stack.

  • Good backend fundamentals around APIs, data models, authentication, integrations and reliability.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify messy workflows.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and own outcomes end-to-end.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want to work on one narrow layer.

  • People who need complete specs before starting.

  • Developers who ship UI without understanding backend or operations impact.

  • Candidates who avoid production support.

  • People who make vague claims without showing real shipped work.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Australia. We are hiring for this market specifically, so applicants should already be based in Australia.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Working closely with Engineering, you’ll ensure the platform runs seamlessly across devices, regions, and releases, setting the standard for quality, reliability, and user experience.

You'll split your time between hands-on QA work and leading the QA engineers in the QA chapter: helping them grow in their craft, spreading good practice, and raising the bar for quality across the teams you work with. A key part of this role will be driving smarter, more scalable testing approaches, including AI-driven testing and automation.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own the full QA lifecycle for JustPlay’s app and platform features - from test planning and execution to reporting and defect management.

  • Foster a strong quality culture across teams by embedding QA best practices early and tying quality goals to product velocity and platform reliability.

  • Drive innovation through AI-driven testing and predictive approaches to identify risks earlier, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort.

  • Partner with development, design, and product teams to integrate QA best practices early in the release cycle.

  • Design and maintain comprehensive test plans and automated suites for key user flows (login, payments, live events, notifications, etc.).

  • Lead, mentor, and scale the QA team - setting up clear processes, code quality standards, and testing frameworks.

  • Implement automation and regression testing strategies using tools such as Maestro, Espresso, XCTest, Appium, or similar frameworks.

  • Use contract testing (e.g., Pact) to validate backend and service integrations.

  • Apply performance and reliability testing across mobile platforms to ensure smooth user experiences.

Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in QA for mobile apps or platforms, including at least 2 years leading teams.

  • Proven ability to design scalable QA processes in fast-paced, development-heavy environments.

  • Strong experience with automation frameworks, regression testing, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with mobile debugging tools (Android Studio, Xcode) and network analysis tools like Charles.

  • Strong understanding of how to build a quality-first mindset across engineering and product teams.

  • Interest in or experience with AI-assisted testing and new QA technologies.

  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a user-first mindset.

  • Familiarity with project and documentation tools such as Jira and Notion.

Nice to have

  • Experience in backend integration testing and API monitoring.

  • Experience with contract testing frameworks such as Pact.

Job Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

Everyone's welcome here
At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. With team members from 30+ nationalities, different experiences and backgrounds are an important part of how we work and grow.
We hire based on skills, potential, and how you work. Your age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or background don't come into it. If you don't meet every requirement in this ad, apply anyway. We know great candidates don’t always tick every box and some of our best hires didn't either. We are looking forward to your application!

  • Partner with the CMO, the executive team and department heads to bring data into planning, budgeting and long-term strategy, and support leadership-level reporting with Finance.
  • Lead weekly and quarterly analytics planning, prioritizing initiatives, allocating resources based on business impact, strategic objectives, and team capacity.

Insights and analytics

  • Lead the analytics function for Marketing, Acquisition, Operations, CX, Finance and Product, equipping leaders across the business with regular, actionable insight on performance from pricing and promotions to CX feedback and operations metrics.
  • Provide strategic leadership for consumer research, partnering with cross-functional teams to set research priorities and turn consumer insight into recommendations that inform product, marketing and broader business strategy.
  • Partner with leaders across Growth, CX, and Finance to turn customer purchase behavior, retention, LTV and CAC into clear recommendations that shape decisions across the business.
  • Define how the organization measures channel and investment effectiveness through incrementality testing and marketing mix modeling, equipping cross functional leaders to act on the results.
  • Set the standard for omnichannel reporting, including Amazon and retail partners, so leadership has one trusted, comprehensive view of business performance.

Data stack and governance

  • Own and evolve the company's data infrastructure, including architecture, technology investments, vendor relationships, and budget, ensuring the stack is scalable, cost-effective, and aligned with business needs.
  • Set company-wide standards for metric definitions, dashboards, data modeling and analysis, so teams work from one source of truth.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and data products that enable self-service analytics and continue to build the team’s data literacy.
  • Work with technology partners and data engineers to make sure the data we capture is reliable and usable.
  • Partner with Finance to build and refine dashboards for key model inputs and support ad hoc analysis.

AI

  • Partner with cross-functional leaders to shape Caraway's AI strategy, identifying and prioritizing opportunities to improve business performance through applications such as forecasting, customer segmentation, marketing optimization, personalization, and operational efficiency.
  • Prioritize use cases by business impact and effort, run pilots, and measure results, so we scale what works and stop what does not.
  • Evaluate org-wide AI platforms and tools, and make build versus buy decisions based on cost, security and long-term flexibility. Support department AI tool evaluation as needed.
  • Help teams across Caraway build AI skills and use new tools well, so AI supports their judgment and their work with customers.
  • Establish responsible AI practices, including how customer data is used, governance for models and tools, human review where it matters, and clear measures of business impact. Partner with the People Team, Legal, Security and Digital Product as needed.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 10+ years of analytics experience in Consumer, DTC, E-Commerce or a similar industry, across marketing, operations, product, retail/wholesale and finance.
  • Excellent communicator and cross-functional partner, with a keen ability to build trust with stakeholders across the business, translate each function’s priorities into a shared analytics roadmap, and explain complex ideas clearly to executives and non-technical audiences alike, in writing and in person.
  • Track record of building and scaling a data and analytics team, including 5+ years leading analytics teams and of setting standards that other teams adopt.
  • Expert-level SQL skills and strong analytical ability, with a deep understanding of relational databases and how to use a wide variety of data structures to find insight in complex data sets and power customer-facing communications.
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports in BI tools & AI platforms (e.g., Omni, Claude, Looker, Tableau, etc.), using Shopify data and other data sets to power customer-facing insight and communications.
  • Strong background in incrementality tests or marketing mix models to measure marketing channel effectiveness.
  • Knowledge of statistical modeling and experimental design.
  • Familiarity with ETL processes and tools (e.g. Hevo, Snowflake and dbt.) and partnering with data engineering and cloud data platforms to ensure data stays reliable as Caraway scales.
  • Working knowledge of machine learning concepts, such as forecasting, segmentation and propensity models, and how they create business value. Hands-on exposure to generative AI tools in a business setting.
  • Experience evaluating analytics or AI vendors and making build versus buy decisions.
  • Understanding of data privacy and the responsible use of customer data and AI.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Statistics, or a related field preferred.

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $190,000 - $210,000. Final compensation will depend on a variety of factors determining the base pay at offer, including but not limited to: skills, qualifications, experience. This range provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role.

Life at Caraway:

Who We Are:

Caraway is a home goods brand on a mission to craft well-designed, non-toxic essentials that thoughtfully raises the standards of what you cook with. We’re passionate about creating elevated products, made without forever chemicals, that are better for you, your family, and the planet. We prioritize a holistic approach to the creation of Caraway products. We partner with ethical manufacturers where their employees are safe, paid fairly, given benefits, and work regulated hours. Our eco-friendly manufacturing process emits less CO2 than traditional non-stick coatings, and we use sustainable packaging practices and ship in packaging made from recycled materials. We pride ourselves on continuously striving to do and be better—for you and the planet—in every step of the process.

Since launching in November 2019, we’ve become one of the fastest growing digitally-native brands of the last decade and are now sold in retailers including Target, Bloomingdale’s, Crate & Barrel, The Container Store, Costco, Zola, and many more.

Workplace: Being a fully-remote company, we have no headquarters and are truly distributed across the country. Our leadership team sits on both the East and West Coast and we have folks in a variety of states. We offer a monthly stipend towards co-working space should folks need to switch up their working environment every now and then.

Benefits: We value you and your family. With this in mind, full-time eligible employees are provided:

  • Equity: We believe in our product and that the sky's the limit for where our business is going. You are an asset to Caraway’s success and we think you should be rewarded for it.
  • 401k: A 3% company match to help you plan for for your future
  • Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental + vision coverage options with generous employer contributions + access to FSA/HSA/Dependent Care FSA’s
  • Parental Leave: Up to 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, depending on tenure, and access to additional fertility care services via KindBody
  • A Setup that works for you: From MacBook to PC, we’ve got you covered. Let us know what you prefer and we’ll get your at-home set up stocked!
  • Elevate your Workspace: Annual reimbursements for you to elevate your workspace, from standing desks to desktop succulents, you got it!

  • #AwayFromCaraway: We believe healthy, happy humans do better work. We offer unlimited PTO in addition to our 11+ paid annual holidays and quarterly wellness days.
  • Wellness Reimbursement: Monthly reimbursements for you to stay well. From meal services to gym memberships to monthly massages, we want our team to have the flexibility to choose what wellness means for them.
  • Employee Discount: We provide an employee discount on all Caraway Home products so you can continue to level up your kitchen and home life, too!
  • Home Upgrade(s): Complimentary product as a new hire + continuous to expand your Caraway Home collection.

Caraway is an Equal Opportunity & Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Why should you join our team?

American AgCredit offers a unique opportunity to be a part of a national financial system supporting those who feed, clothe and fuel the world. We are a growing organization embracing collaboration and innovation while delivering transformative solutions. American AgCredit provides a cultivating environment where you truly make a difference for our customers and teams.

Benefits offered by American AgCredit:

  • Commitment to agriculture and the communities we serve
  • Family friendly work environment
  • Investment in employee development
  • Medical, Dental and Vision coverage
  • Outstanding 401k – automatic 3% employer contribution, plus match up to 6%
