Position will be posted until filled.

BASIC FUNCTION:

The Technology First Line Risk and Controls Manager will be responsible for overseeing and managing the first line of defense for technology-related risks and controls. This role involves partnering across the three lines of responsibility (Technology Teams and First Line Risk and Controls (1LoR), Risk (2LoR) and Internal Audit (3LoR)) and providing expertise in risk identification, control design, and adherence to regulatory requirements. Additionally, this role will partner with internal and external auditors.

While the primary reporting line is within Technology, this role will have a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Executive Head of First Line Risk and Controls to ensure alignment on risk management practices, consistency in control implementation and effective communication of technology related risks across the association.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

Technology Risk and Control Environment

  • Driving the development and implementation of governance policies and procedures to enhance and sustain a robust technology control environment
  • Collaborate with Technology leadership and 1LoR & Controls to evaluate and monitor the IT risk and control environment.
  • Perform control effectiveness testing and distill results into meaningful insights
  • Identify and document remediation recommendations and perform the necessary changes to resolve issues
  • Leads and/or participates all phases of 1LoR IT risk and control assessments
  • Coach and train teams in developing and executing effective action plans
  • Provide input into the establishment and maintenance of First line Risk and Controls policies and procedures
  • Stay updated on relevant changes to rules/regulations and other industry news.
  • Develops and maintains relevant monitoring mechanisms for management to know how the control environment is operating compared to the expected design results

2LoR Partnership Risk Management:

  • Collaboration with Technology Teams and liaison to Enterprise Risk, for 2LoR governed program connections to IT.
  • Partners with 2LoR to understand program requirements and operationalizes these requirements in 1LoR.

Audit Support:

  • Dedicated Technology Team liaison for internal and external audits related to Technology department.

Technology Review – System and Regulatory Compliance:


  • Conduct control and security reviews to identify gaps in key technologies, enabling proactive first-line risk management and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Support the implementation and monitoring of technology regulatory requirements.

  • Assist in the development and maintenance of policies and procedures ensuring controls are effective and risk is appropriately identified and mitigated.
  • Collaborate to understand regulatory requirements and align people, policies, procedures, and processes specific to technology-related regulatory requirements.

Collaboration, Communication & Training:

  • Dotted line reporting to the Executive Head of First Line Risk and Controls
  • Coordinate risk identification, assessment, and mitigation efforts, and 1LoR reporting of such matters.
  • Standardize practices for monitoring and reporting IT risk and controls
  • Standardized approach in incident evaluation and resolution
  • Align technology risk initiatives with broader 1LoR risk management strategies.
  • Support adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements through shared oversight and guidance.
  • Build strong partnerships within technology teams, and 1LoR risk and controls (1LoR), Risk (2LoR) and Internal Audit (3LoR).
  • Provide and/or contribute to training, lunch and learns, and other methods to promote and embed a culture of risk management in the association.

LEVELS OF SUPERVISION EXERCISED AND RECEIVED:

  • Reports to the Executive Head of Enterprise Technology within the Chief Business Technology Officer’s domain.
  • Dotted line to the Executive Head of First Line Risk and Controls

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree or Certifications in Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of directly related information technology experience required. Minimum of 2 years of experience in IT risk management, ITGC, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of ITGC frameworks, risk management, and compliance processes.
  • Strong understanding of Cloud environments, Infrastructure best practices and security best practices
  • Strong understanding of business applications to enhance IT controls and ensure compliance and risk management.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
  • Professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, or CRISC.
  • Experience in the financial services industry.
  • Knowledge of Farm Credit Administration (FCA) and other financial regulations.

FULL-TIME REMOTE: These roles and job functions can be done remotely, while maintaining our strong commitment to customer service and our business goals. Employees are welcome to come to an office to work if needed, and some travel for team meetings will be required.

Minimum $97,027.15 - Max $164,946.15 Annual

  • Process purchase ledger invoices, ensuring appropriate approvals are obtained or matching against POs where applicable.
  • Maintain bank feeds for all entities, ensuring all transactions are up to date.
  • Approve bank payment runs accurately and timely for allocated accounts and/or entities.
  • Perform balance sheet reconciliations for allocated accounts and entities, including journal preparation and posting.
  • To support with accurate and timely group reporting.

  • Prepare monthly profitability reports to support decision-making.
  • Produce ad-hoc reports as required.

  • Ability to analyse financial data and present insights clearly.

Soft skills:

  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities, capable of meeting strict deadlines.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across departments.

About DeleteMe:

DeleteMe is the leader in proactive privacy protection. We help Individuals, Families, Businesses and Security teams reduce their human attack surface by continuously monitoring and removing exposed personal data (PII) from the open web — the very data threat actors use to launch social engineering, phishing, Gen-AI deepfake, doxxing campaigns, physical threats, and identity fraud.

Operating as a fast-growing, global SaaS company, DeleteMe serves both consumers and enterprises. DeleteMe has completed over 100 million opt-out removals, helping customers reduce risks associated with identity theft, spam, doxxing, and other cybersecurity threats. We deliver detailed privacy reports, continuous monitoring, and expert support to ensure ongoing protection.

DeleteMe acts as a scalable, managed defense layer for your most vulnerable attack vector: your people. That’s why 30% of the Fortune 100, top tech firms, major banks, federal agencies, and U.S. states rely on DeleteMe to protect their workforce.

DeleteMe is led by a passionate and experienced team and driven by a powerful mission to empower consumers with privacy.

What you’ll own:

  • The member experience: signup, profile setup, the dashboard, and the privacy reports we deliver every cycle. Members should feel the value the moment they log in.

  • The privacy toolkit: masked email, phone, and card, plus search engine monitoring. Help us decide what comes next and where we expand internationally.

  • The growth engine: plan and pricing pages, checkout, renewals, cancellation and save offers, referrals, and promotions. You’ll run pricing tests with Marketing and Finance and see the results quickly.

  • The lifecycle: the messages that turn a signup into an active member, an upgrade, and a long-term customer.

What your week looks like:

  • Reading the numbers, then pairing them with support tickets, reviews, and member interviews to find the real problem.

  • Designing experiments, running them, and being honest about the ones that flop.

  • Writing tight PRDs and user stories with clear success criteria and edge cases, so engineering can start building right away.

  • Using AI coding and testing tools to build prototypes and shipping the changes yourself. Engineers spend their time on the hard problems.

  • Acting as the product point of contact for Support, Customer Success, and Marketing. You own escalations from intake to resolution and close the loop with everyone who raised them.

What you bring:

  • 3 to 5 years of consumer product experience in subscription or B2C SaaS, with real ownership of a checkout, onboarding, or retention surface.

  • A funnel win. You can tell us the experiment, the metric you moved, and what happened, including the ones that didn’t work.

  • Data fluency. You’re comfortable with SQL or equivalent and a product analytics tool, and you can spot a bad number before it leads you astray.

  • Subscription billing know-how. You’ve dealt with Stripe or something similar: plans, coupons, trials, renewals, refunds, and the edge cases that come with them.

  • Builder instincts. You use AI coding tools daily, have shipped to production yourself, and can hold your own in a conversation with engineers about APIs, schemas, and trade-offs. You also know where AI output falls short and check it before it ships.

  • Clear writing. Your requirements are complete enough to build from, and your updates are short enough that people actually read them.

  • A point of view on privacy and consumer trust. Experience in privacy, security, or identity is a plus, but a strong belief in what we do matters more.

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive health benefits - Medical, Vision, Dental

  • Flexible work schedule

  • Generous 401k matching up to 6%

  • 20 days paid time off

  • 15 sick days

  • 12 company-paid holidays

  • Childcare expense reimbursement

  • Fitness and cell phone reimbursement

  • Birthday time off

  • Competitive salary - We publish salary ranges to promote transparency and ensure fair compensation. Final offers are based on skills, experience, and internal equity.

  • Regularly interpret, analyze, and execute tasks based on given instructions.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • PhD in a chemistry-related field; OR a master's degree with 3+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas: research/laboratory, policy/regulatory, strategy and management (in STEM), editorial/scientific writing, scientific communications, scientific instrumentation.
  • English proficiency at CEFR C1 level or higher.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Expertise in chemistry-related subdomains including, but not limited to organic chemistry, physical chemistry, analytical chemistry, inorganic chemistry, organometallic chemistry, biochemistry, nuclear chemistry, computational/theoretical chemistry, polymer/materials chemistry, medicinal chemistry, catalysis, surface/colloid chemistry, or drug discovery.

  • Strong passion for and commitment to technological advancements and innovation.
  • Advanced expertise in chemistry, demonstrated by multiple publications, including at least one first-author paper, in reputable peer-reviewed journals.
  • Relevant industry experience in chemistry-related fields such as drug development, consulting, biotechnology, energy (esp. oil/gas), materials/polymer science, chemical manufacturing/regulation, or computational chemistry.
  • Prior data annotation or teaching experience (as a professor, teacher, or tutor).
  • Patents or other clear evidence of technological innovation.
  • Experience in academic, technical or professional writing, or journalism.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • This role may be offered as a full-time or part-time position depending on role/business needs and candidate availability; full-time positions are preferred and require working standard business hours in your local time zone.

About DeleteMe:

DeleteMe is the leader in proactive privacy protection. We help Individuals, Families, Businesses and Security teams reduce their human attack surface by continuously monitoring and removing exposed personal data (PII) from the open web — the very data threat actors use to launch social engineering, phishing, Gen-AI deepfake, doxxing campaigns, physical threats, and identity fraud.

Operating as a fast-growing, global SaaS company, DeleteMe serves both consumers and enterprises. DeleteMe has completed over 100 million opt-out removals, helping customers reduce risks associated with identity theft, spam, doxxing, and other cybersecurity threats. We deliver detailed privacy reports, continuous monitoring, and expert support to ensure ongoing protection.

DeleteMe acts as a scalable, managed defense layer for your most vulnerable attack vector: your people. That’s why 30% of the Fortune 100, top tech firms, major banks, federal agencies, and U.S. states rely on DeleteMe to protect their workforce.

DeleteMe is led by a passionate and experienced team and driven by a powerful mission to empower consumers with privacy.

What you’ll own:

  • The member experience: signup, profile setup, the dashboard, and the privacy reports we deliver every cycle. Members should feel the value the moment they log in.

  • The privacy toolkit: masked email, phone, and card, plus search engine monitoring. Help us decide what comes next and where we expand internationally.

  • The growth engine: plan and pricing pages, checkout, renewals, cancellation and save offers, referrals, and promotions. You’ll run pricing tests with Marketing and Finance and see the results quickly.

  • The lifecycle: the messages that turn a signup into an active member, an upgrade, and a long-term customer.

What your week looks like:

  • Reading the numbers, then pairing them with support tickets, reviews, and member interviews to find the real problem.

  • Designing experiments, running them, and being honest about the ones that flop.

  • Writing tight PRDs and user stories with clear success criteria and edge cases, so engineering can start building right away.

  • Using AI coding and testing tools to build prototypes and shipping the changes yourself. Engineers spend their time on the hard problems.

  • Acting as the product point of contact for Support, Customer Success, and Marketing. You own escalations from intake to resolution and close the loop with everyone who raised them.

What you bring:

  • 3 to 5 years of consumer product experience in subscription or B2C SaaS, with real ownership of a checkout, onboarding, or retention surface.

  • A funnel win. You can tell us the experiment, the metric you moved, and what happened, including the ones that didn’t work.

  • Data fluency. You’re comfortable with SQL or equivalent and a product analytics tool, and you can spot a bad number before it leads you astray.

  • Subscription billing know-how. You’ve dealt with Stripe or something similar: plans, coupons, trials, renewals, refunds, and the edge cases that come with them.

  • Builder instincts. You use AI coding tools daily, have shipped to production yourself, and can hold your own in a conversation with engineers about APIs, schemas, and trade-offs. You also know where AI output falls short and check it before it ships.

  • Clear writing. Your requirements are complete enough to build from, and your updates are short enough that people actually read them.

  • A point of view on privacy and consumer trust. Experience in privacy, security, or identity is a plus, but a strong belief in what we do matters more.

  1. Listen to and analyze multi-speaker conversational audio samples featuring a range of Canadian French dialects and accents.
  2. Tag audio and speaker metadata, including aspects such as audio quality, background noise, dialect, accent, age, and speaking style.
  3. Edit and correct automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcripts using Canadian French spelling, vocabulary, and conventions.
  4. Identify and annotate region-specific linguistic features, idioms, slang, and pronunciation patterns such as regional accents and informal speech (e.g., “tu sais,” “pis,” “icitte”).
  5. Ensure all annotations are accurate, consistent, and align with project guidelines emphasizing Canadian French distinctions.
  6. Collaborate with project team members through written and verbal channels to clarify guidelines or resolve linguistic ambiguities.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Fluent proficiency in Canadian French, with a strong command of its regional varieties.
  2. Background in linguistics, language teaching, transcription, editing, translation, journalism, or related fields.
  3. Demonstrated ability to distinguish between Canadian French dialects and accents (e.g., Québécois, Acadian, Franco-Ontarian, Franco-Manitoban, Montréal, Quebec City).
  4. Familiarity with Canadian French vocabulary, idioms, slang, and spelling conventions (including joual, anglicisms, and Indigenous-language influences).
  5. Meticulous attention to detail and a keen ear for subtle linguistic differences.
  6. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on clarity, accuracy, and collaboration.
  7. Experience in audio annotation or ASR transcript editing is an asset, though not required.

  • Track venue and sponsor logistics, identify risks, and resolve issues before they affect the program.
  • Direct on-site operations, vendor activity, and event staff to ensure seamless execution.
  • Source, evaluate, and recommend venues for future programs.
  • Partner with Legal to review contracts and negotiate business terms.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of proven experience planning and executing corporate events, conferences, meetings, exhibits, and sponsorships.
  • Experience with hosted buyer programs and related tasks such as participant logistics, travel/accommodation, communications, and on-site execution.

  • Collaborative leadership skills, including the ability to coordinate teams and delegate effectively.
  • Proficiency with event management platforms, such as event registrations, travel platforms, project management, collaboration, and virtual meeting platforms generally.
  • Ability to learn new systems quickly and adapt to changing event requirements.

All full-time employees of The Channel Company enjoy benefit offerings such as medical, dental, vision, tele-health, disability, life insurance, health savings accounts, paid parental leave, company matched 401k, unlimited PTO, sick time, and 15 company paid holidays. At The Channel Company we truly value work/life balance, are 100% remote, and employees enjoy flexible working hours. ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

We are seeking a highly analytical and technical Sr Software Engineer, Power BI Development candidate to design, develop, and maintain our suite of business intelligence solutions. The successful candidate will move beyond "drag-and-drop" reporting, instead focusing on a structured lifecycle that ensures data integrity and deployment reliability.

We are specifically looking for a candidate who treats BI development like software engineering. Advanced SQL proficiency and experience implementing CI/CD workflows for reporting assets are heavily favored and essential for our modern data stack.


Responsibilities:

  • Power BI Engineering: Develop and optimize complex Power BI reports, dashboards, and paginated reports.

Join Our Growing Team - Future Opportunities Await!

We are excited to share that our company is experiencing significant growth and expansion, and as a result, we're on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

We want to be upfront about our hiring process. At this moment, we are in the process of securing projects that align with our business goals and objectives. Our intention is to ensure that once we bring new team members on board, they will have a meaningful and impactful role to play from day one. If you're open to the idea of potentially joining our team in the future, we encourage you to continue with our interview process. We value your time and effort and believe that getting to know you better will help us make an informed decision.

Once you have effectively concluded the entire recruitment procedure, we will retain your profile and reach out to you once a suitable opportunity emerges. Additional interviews will not be necessary at this stage, and we anticipate being able to extend an offer to you promptly.

What does the recruitment process look like?

1. Recruiter Screen

In the first call, our recruiter will learn more about you and your story to check a potential fit for gravity9. This is also an opportunity to ask your questions about the role and company. This step might take around 60 mins.

2. Tech 1 Interview with our AI Practice Lead

In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team.

This step will take around 60 mins.

3. Tech 2 Interview with our software consultants

In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team.

This step will take around 60 mins.

4. Final Interview

You made it to the very last stage! Here we already strive to cooperate with you and give you an opportunity to meet our leadership team during this informal talk. This step will take around 30 mins.

The salary details for the role will be communicated ahead of the first recruitment meeting.

Thank you for considering the opportunity to be a part of our growing journey. We look forward to the possibility of working together and achieving great things.

Role Description

We are looking for a smart, enthusiastic AI/ML Engineer or Data Scientist who is passionate about leveraging artificial intelligence and machine learning to solve complex problems. As an integral member of our team, you'll be responsible for conceptualizing, developing, and deploying innovative AI/ML solutions. This role offers the opportunity to work on diverse projects, providing bespoke solutions to our clients.

We believe small, multi-disciplinary teams are most effective in delivering complex change. As such, we are looking for someone with a collaborative mindset who is happy to be flexible and take on different responsibilities over the lifetime of our projects.

As an AI/ML Engineer, you will be an experienced developer with a strong interest in state-of-the-art AI and Machine Learning technologies. You’ll be primarily “hands-on” and actively providing technical expertise across a broad range of AI/ML disciplines, developing AI applications using LLMs, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and particularly agentic AI solutions.


Responsibilities:

  • Engage with clients to understand their unique challenges and deliver tailored AI/ML solutions.

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable, efficient, and robust end-to-end ML/AI systems.

  • Manage the entire ML/AI development lifecycle, including planning, pipeline management, and deployment.

  • Provide technical support to engineering team members, promoting best practices in ML engineering.

  • Collaborate with AI Practice Lead to inform and shape the company's AI strategic direction.

Requirements

Role requirements - technical skills and experience

This role will suit a highly capable AI/ML Engineer with at least 5 years of experience. Skills and experience should include:

  • Extensive experience in AI/ML development, particularly in NLP, and machine learning domains.

  • Hands-on experience in developing AI applications using LLMs, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and particularly agentic AI solutions is essential

  • Knowledge of utilizing AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude Code) to accelerate and streamline development and everyday task

  • Proficiency in designing and maintaining AI/ML solutions that are cost-effective, accurate, and scalable.

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to think analytically.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the aptitude to navigate complex project requirements with clients and stakeholders.

  • A growth mindset with a commitment to personal and professional development.

  • Excellent command/highly proficient in spoken and written English (working directly with UK/US based clients).

Essential skills:

  • Advanced knowledge of Python specifically for machine learning and data science.

  • Experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen.

  • Proficiency in cloud services related to ML/AI (e.g., Azure, OpenAI, Hugging Face, AWS, GCP).

Nice to have:

  • Certification as an Azure AI Engineer Associate or equivalent credentials is highly advantageous.

  • AWS Professional Certifications.

  • Experience with ML/DL frameworks like TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, and scikit-learn.

  • Experience with C# or Java, node.js.

  • Knowledge in MLOps, encompassing the ML applications development lifecycle and toolsets.

  • Robust software engineering background, with a track record of leading agile teams and expedited delivery of complex projects.

  • Leadership experience.

Role requirements – soft skills
Key attributes and behaviours to succeed in this role will be:

  • Customer Focus – passion for understanding the problem we are trying to solve with software and to advocate solutions to your client.

  • Delivery focus - strong analysis and problem-solving skills. Ability to evaluate, design and implement effective solutions. Flexibility to adapt skills to a spectrum of client engagements, use cases and modes of change delivery.

  • Exemplary standards of personal integrity and respect for others – professional approach to all aspects of client engagement and collaborative team working, able to quickly build relationships based on trust and transparency. Strong presentation and written and verbal communication are essential given the client facing nature of the role.

  • Value driven - Creative thinking, with aptitude for innovation and strong desire to exceed client expectations.

  • Energy – positive attitude and determination to learn and succeed.

While this is a fully remote position, physical residence in Poland is required.

We are looking for a Senior Compliance Lead to join our Insurance Operations team. Reporting directly to our Director of Customer Ops & Strategy, you'll own our DOI, BBB and carrier complaint responses, build the AI tools and automation that scale the work, and manage one complaint specialist.

This role may be a fit for you if:

  • You know insurance compliance inside and out: You've investigated and answered DOI complaints, worked carrier audits, and know how expectations shift from state to state.

  • You're a tinkerer: When you see a broken process, you can't leave it alone. You take it apart, figure out why it breaks, and rebuild it better.

  • You reach for AI first: You already use AI tools in your daily work, and you're excited to build agents and automations that do the research and first drafts so your team can focus on judgment.

  • You think in systems: You'd rather fix the root cause than answer the same complaint 50 times, and you partner with Ops, Product and Legal to make the fix stick.

  • You write with precision: Regulators, carriers and customers read your work, and you take pride in getting it right the first time.

What you'll actually do:

  • Own Regulatory & Complaint Response: Lead the investigation and response for every DOI, Attorney General, BBB and carrier-escalated complaint, and hand Legal a clean, complete packet for final review.

  • Build Complaint Intelligence: Create the taxonomy, logging and trend reporting that show us root causes and size our exposure.

  • Automate the Heavy Lifting: Partner with our Ops automation team to build and keep improving AI agents that classify complaints, research accounts across our CRM and carrier portals, and draft responses for human review.

  • Build AI-Native Compliance Monitoring: Design and run AI-powered monitoring of calls, chats, messages and our app and web signup flows to catch compliance issues before they turn into complaints.

  • Run a QA Program: Set the quality bar for complaint handling and coach the team to it.

  • Turn Findings into Fixes: Bring together the teams involved to find the root cause of each issue, drive the fix through training, process or product changes, and confirm the same issue doesn't come back.

  • Carrier Compliance Partnership: Serve as the operational point of contact for carrier audits, information requests and complaint investigations.

  • Coach our Complaint Specialist: Manage and coach the specialist on our team, setting the quality bar for complaint handling.

What we're looking for:

  • Active Property & Casualty (P&C) license, or the ability to obtain one quickly.

  • 3+ years of experience in insurance compliance, complaints, regulatory affairs or claims. Experience leading or coaching others is a plus; formal management experience isn't required.

  • Hands-on experience owning DOI complaint responses, whether you wrote them or reviewed and finalized them, plus supporting carrier audits. P&C experience strongly preferred.

  • Regular use of AI tools in your own work, and examples of processes you've improved with technology, from spreadsheet automation to no-code tools to AI. Experience building automations or AI agents is a big plus.

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort turning messy data into clear trends and decisions.

  • Exceptional written communication with an eye for legal and compliance detail.

  • Bachelor's degree preferred (or equivalent practical experience).

What's in it for you?

  • Build It Your Way: Design a modern, AI-powered compliance program from the ground up, partnering with our Ops automation team.

  • Strategic Leadership & Impact: Work directly with Legal, Product, and Ops leadership to shape how Jerry earns and keeps the trust of customers, carriers and regulators, including a real say in product features and design.

  • 100% Remote Work: Work from home with all equipment provided.

  • Full Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision insurance, and 401(k) matching.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We support remote work for most roles, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.

We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer who enjoys working in a dynamic and supportive team. You’ll be a key player in making sure our web and mobile applications work smoothly and meet high quality standards. You’ll work closely with developers and product managers to test features both manually and through automation, mostly in JavaScript-based environments. Must-have Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in software testing, including at least 1 year in test automation.

  • Detail-oriented and reliable.

raw.description:
Job Description

  • Provides scientific and product/applications-focused continuity to the sales process and customer experience by providing both pre-sale and post-sale support.
  • Pre-sale activities include qualification of the scientific application; providing technical input to the sales representatives for bid proposals, projects and technical documents; and delivering scientific and methodical insights about Agilent’s products and services through technical presentations and product demonstrations.
  • Post-sale activities typically take place in the customer lab and consist of product installation, delivery of both onboarding and ongoing training, and consultation on the utilization of Agilent’s product(s) to complete/enhance the customer’s processes, applications and research goals.
  • Develops and applies scientific methods, theories, assays and research techniques to provide customers with technical solutions.
  • May work with vendors, sales team and/or other internal partners to ensure that optimum systems solutions are provided to continually meet the needs of new and existing customers.
  • Deepens the Agilent/customer relationship by working with interested customers in generating scientific manuscripts or Agilent-branded application notes on new or emerging applications.
  • May ensure that the product application/solution is functioning according to specifications and assists in the support strategy for current and prospective clients.
  • May provide follow-up support to Agilent sales, customer service and/or support staff by disseminating technical information on specific applications/systems and shares customer feedback with the management, R&D, Marketing, and/or Sales teams.
  • Delivers applications and product training to internal sales or support teams.
  • May represent Agilent at local/regional vendor shows, present at webinars/seminars and/or contribute to scientific blogs and posters.
  • May attend conferences to maintain scientific expertise, to remain aware of emerging applications technologies and research fields, and act as the voice of the customer to influence future product/application design.
  • Must consent to participate and meet Agilent approved customer/vendor credentialing requirements necessary to gain access to customer sites.
  • Requirements may include, but are not limited to, proof of identification, proof of certification to perform the work required, customer health and safety requirements, etc.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree or equivalent.
  • Post-graduate, certification and/or license may be required.
  • Typically, at least 4+ years relevant experience for entry into this level.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely.Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws.

raw.description:
Overview

Build, launch, and improve digital experiences that help customers discover relevant capabilities, complete key workflows, and develop sustained product habits. Translate the Director’s strategy into targeted in-app guidance, contextual education, automated adoption plays, and coordinated campaigns across Seismic and Highspot.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role combining digital platform configuration, audience targeting, testing, quality assurance, and performance analysis. Work in the approved digital adoption platform, if selected and deployed, and supporting systems; contribute to platform evaluation or implementation when needed. Pendo is an example of a potential platform.

Who you are:

Required

  • Hands-on delivery experience. Experience executing digital adoption, lifecycle campaigns, product onboarding, customer education, or customer operations programs in a SaaS environment.
  • Platform capability. Practical experience configuring a DAP such as Pendo or a comparable in-app engagement tool; transferable experience in lifecycle automation and product analytics is also relevant.
  • Data fluency. Ability to work with behavioral events, cohorts, funnels, dashboards, and A/B testing concepts; identify tracking issues and distinguish engagement from meaningful adoption.
  • Execution discipline. Strong quality assurance, documentation, project coordination, and troubleshooting skills, with attention to audience accuracy and the customer experience.
  • Customer communication. Ability to write concise instructional copy, adapt educational content to a product workflow, and collaborate with technical and nontechnical partners.

Preferred

Experience with CRM or marketing automation integrations, basic HTML or CSS for guide customization, and enterprise customer segmentation. Comfort supporting multiple products and evolving program requirements is valuable.

What you'll be doing:

  • Build in-app experiences. Configure guides, walkthroughs, prompts, checklists, and contextual resource links appropriate to the selected platform. Turn approved learning content into clear, concise guidance tied to customer tasks.
  • Configure audience targeting. Translate approved usage signals and feature-gap rules into cohorts, triggers, eligibility criteria, and exclusions. Check product access, permissions, lifecycle stage, and recent engagement before activating a play.
  • Coordinate automation. Work with Operations to connect in-app experiences with alerts, email journeys, and Customer Success follow-up. Maintain suppression rules, frequency limits, handoff logic, and campaign calendars.
  • Run experiments. Implement approved A/B tests or holdouts, validate exposure tracking, and monitor adoption outcomes. Record hypotheses, test conditions, results, limitations, and recommended next steps.
  • Own launch quality. Test audience accuracy, trigger behavior, links, copy, accessibility, supported devices, and relevant product versions. Confirm analytics events, secure approvals, and maintain rollback or disable procedures.
  • Report and optimize. Maintain dashboards covering eligible reach, engagement, workflow completion, sustained usage, and program quality. Investigate drop-off, recommend improvements, and implement changes within agreed guardrails.
  • Maintain the program library. Document configurations, reusable templates, experiment history, ownership, and review dates. Audit live experiences after product changes and retire stale or ineffective guidance.

What we have for you:

At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.

If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.

Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.

We are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.Seismic's annual base salary range for this position will vary based on applicant's location, experience, job level, skills, and abilities as well as internal equity and alignment market data. The range listed below is the minimum to the maximum of our target hiring range. Seismic's salary range for this position is: USD $80,900.00/Yr. - USD $116,300.00/Yr.This position is also eligible to participate in Seismic's incentive plans in addition to base salary. The actual incentive amount will very and will be subject to the terms and conditions set in the applicable incentive plan.

raw.description:
Get to know us

Do you want to help us shape what the future of work will look like and how it will best embrace our life's aspirations? If this sounds like a journey you want to embark on, we may have the right role for you! PayFit is an intuitive software as a service payroll and HRIS solution designed specifically for SMBs. Since 2015, we have set ourselves a mission to simplify payroll for SMBs and enable employers and employees to grow together. We are a European company operating from 3 main countries (France, Spain, and the UK) where we are supporting over 20,000 clients.

Creating a fulfilling work environment and culture is also a core mission at PayFit, and our day-to-day work philosophy is reflected in our four values:

Care:We genuinely care for others whoever they are, whatever they think.

Excellence:We aim to improve and achieve better results every day.

Humility:Staying humble and exchanging transparent feedback helps us to grow and improve.

Passion:We are the architects of PayFit's success.

A key part of our culture, and essential for our success, is also improving the diversity of our teams and building an inclusive culture where you can be yourself at work.

This is why our recruitment focuses on the skills you demonstrate, and not only on your academic background or previous professional experiences. At PayFit we understand that you can gain applicable skills through a variety of life experiences and we are interested in knowing them, too.

Location :Flexible location: work remotely from anywhere in Franceor Spain

Why this role, why now

AI is already embedded across Payfit’s operations. Now we’re doubling down and scaling it as a business-critical capability. We're redesigning high-value workflows so our teams execute faster, with greater accuracy and consistency — and we're doing it with direct CEO sponsorship.

To scale this reliably, we need engineers who blend product sense with strong software fundamentals: people who can go from an ambiguous business problem to a production solution that users actually adopt. You'll partner directly with business owners, integrate with our core systems, and iterate based on real usage and quality signals. The goal: ship production solutions that measurably improve service quality and execution speed across Payfit.

The team You'll join a dedicated AI Enablement team of 4, plus a team lead reporting directly to the CEO. The team's mandate is focused delivery - identifying the highest-value workflow opportunities across Payfit, building AI agents that connect to our business systems, and iterating until solutions become part of everyday work.

You'll work in close, structured collaboration with the Application Framework team in Engineering - co-building shared permissions, approved integrations, evaluation frameworks, monitoring, and human interaction patterns. The focus team owns workflow delivery and adoption; Application Framework owns shared infrastructure and technical standards.
Success is measured in net time saved, cycle time reduction, quality improvements, sustained usage, and operating cost.

What you'll do

  • Partner with business users to map workflows and turn needs into AI-powered solutions that teams actually adopt day-to-day.

  • Design and implement integrations with APIs, applications, and data sources; build agent orchestration, retrieval, and custom capabilities.

  • Ship production-ready AI features with evaluation, monitoring, exception handling, and human review where needed to ensure accuracy and safety.

  • Prioritise opportunities with named business owners, clear baselines, and selection criteria focused on value, feasibility, and readiness.

  • Iterate using user feedback and quality/time-saved signals to continuously raise reliability and adoption.

  • Co-develop reusable components, permissions, and human interaction patterns with the Application Framework team to scale safely.

  • Increase autonomy in business teams by creating templates, training local champions, and establishing clear ownership for ongoing operation and improvement.

What you'll bring

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including API and systems design.

  • Proven hands-on experience building with LLMs, agents, tools, orAI workflow automation in production.

  • Product sense: you can move from an ambiguous business problem to a reliable, maintainable production solution.

  • Care for security, permissions, evaluation, observability, and maintainability in AI-enabled systems.

  • Comfort working directly with non-technical users and collaborating across engineering and business teams.

  • Ownership mindset across the full cycle: discovery, delivery, production quality, and iteration.

Our hiring process

  • Step 1 — Quick catch-up with Talent Acquisition

  • Step 2 — 45' meeting with our a hiring manager

  • Step 3 — 60–90' Technical Interview

  • Step 4 — 45' Final Interview

Background Check (ISO27001 certification): identity, diploma, and past professional experience will be checked after the offer.

What we offer

Flexibility: We believe it is key to producing your best work and being fulfilled. We therefore offer the possibility to work away from our main offices, within France, as well as abroad for a defined period. Further requirements may apply depending on the role and your overall experience.

Learning & Development: At PayFit, we offer a comprehensive learning platform that enables you to acquire new skills daily, supported by our company.

Career Development: We want you to progress and be free to choose which direction you want to grow. There are also opportunities for internal moves.

Health insurance: Henner Mutuelle Insurance (60% covered by PayFit, free coverage for children)
Transportation: 50% of public transportation costs are covered by PayFit for those living within the Ile de France region, or assistance with sustainable mobility (a bicycle rental subscription, purchase of soft mobility equipment to get to work, etc.).

Meals: A restaurant card with our partner Swile (9€ per workday) covered at 60% by PayFit

A Work Council grant:A monthly allowance to be spent on culture, sports, personal services, etc., as well as a vacation bonus.

Work equipment: A MacBook is our standard working tool


Parental support program: Salary maintenance during the first month of additional parental leave.


Time off:25 days of holidays + RTT days (depending on the contract).

Disability Inclusion:All of our positions are open to any person living with a disability. To guarantee equal treatment and opportunities, we will take, based on individual needs, appropriate measures to adapt the work conditions of PayFiters with disabilities, and if needed also during the recruitment process. Please let us know what you need and we will do our best to accommodate!

Job Description: Legal Counsel

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Legal Counsels to contribute their legal expertise to a specialized AI training project. You will apply your knowledge of legal analysis, contract drafting, regulatory compliance, and legal communication to help improve the accuracy and reasoning capabilities of AI systems.

No prior AI experience is required. This opportunity is ideal for legal professionals with strong analytical abilities and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Analyze and review legal documents, providing accurate interpretations and relevant feedback.
  2. Draft, edit, and evaluate contracts, policies, and regulatory materials to ensure clarity, compliance, and accuracy.
  3. Identify potential legal risks and recommend solutions aligned with applicable laws and best practices.
  4. Translate complex legal concepts into clear, accessible language for project deliverables.
  5. Develop and refine sample legal scenarios, FAQs, and hypothetical situations to support AI training.
  6. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure alignment with project objectives and legal standards.
  7. Contribute to guidelines and frameworks supporting ethical AI practices and regulatory compliance.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Active legal qualification and substantial professional experience in legal practice.
  2. Expertise in contract law, regulatory compliance, intellectual property, or technology-related legal fields.
  3. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a strong focus on clarity and precision.
  4. Proven ability to interpret, draft, and analyze complex legal documents.
  5. Familiarity with international legal frameworks and cross-border compliance considerations.
  6. Experience working with cross-functional teams or in remote environments.
  7. Interest in the intersection of law, technology, and AI innovation is an advantage.

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in 55 countries, including Nigeria, United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, India, France, Netherlands.

Pay: $20–$60/hr

Role Title: Senior Specialty Inspection Expert, Crop, Auction and Rental

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Global-Remote

Job Type: Contractor (~10 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible-you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are engaging Senior Specialty Inspection Experts, Crop, Auction and Rentals to support a customer's project in specialized inspection domains. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is designed for established professionals with deep inspection experience in crop condition and loss assessment, auction and pre-sale grading, and rental or lease return evaluations. You will analyze authentic inspection records, field or aerial photos, and documented imagery, producing assessments that reflect current industry best practices. Communication excellence, both written and verbal, is essential, as your insights will drive accurate training data for advanced technology platforms.

Scope of Work

  1. Review field and aerial imagery, as well as inspection records, to assess crop conditions and determine loss in line with insurance protocols.
  2. Evaluate vehicles and equipment for auction or pre-sale, assigning accurate condition grades using photographic evidence and inspection data.
  3. Analyze rental or lease return inspection records, identifying damage and detailing findings in clear, expert-level reports.
  4. Document and articulate the reasoning behind each grade or assessment, ensuring transparency and traceability of your conclusions.
  5. Collaborate remotely with project coordinators to clarify requirements and address project-specific needs.
  6. Provide high-quality, real-world input that will inform the development and refinement of AI models.
  7. Contribute expertise in one or more specialty areas; specify your area of focus during the engagement process.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Minimum of 5 years’ professional experience in crop insurance adjusting, auction grading, or rental/lease return inspection.
  2. Demonstrated proficiency in interpreting field and aerial imagery for agricultural or industrial assessments.
  3. Thorough understanding of industry grading standards and loss assessment methodologies.
  4. Exceptional attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  5. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, well-supported justifications.
  6. Comfort with remote work environments and digital platforms for document review and communication.
  7. Experience across multiple specialty areas (crop, auction, rental) is a plus, but not required.

COMPANY 🌱

RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support. Built on a Direct-to-Consumer foundation with a performance marketing engine, RYZE achieved hockey-stick growth and a community of over 1 million active subscribers.

DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail, quickly becoming the #2 item in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness.

We're a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we're just getting started!

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯

You’ll play a key role in powering RYZE’s next wave of large-scale creator gifting by identifying and recruiting creators who align with the brand and audience. Your day-to-day will focus on sourcing new creators, evaluating their fit, and conducting outreach to bring qualified talent into the gifting program.


As a 1099 Independent Contractor, this role offers hands-on experience within one of the largest creator programs in consumer goods, with opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and grow as the team and program continue to scale.


Responsibilities will include:

Creator Sourcing

  • Source and identify creators for gifting based on brand fit, content quality, engagement, and audience relevance.
  • Build and maintain a sourcing pipeline segmented by platform, follower tier, and content niche.
  • Monitor emerging creators, formats, and trends to keep the sourcing pipeline fresh.
  • Dig into creator profiles, engagement quality, and audience fit before initiating outreach.

Outreach & Pipeline Management

  • Conduct outreach to prospective creators via email and DM to invite them into the gifting program.
  • Personalize outreach at volume and follow up persistently without letting prospects go cold.
  • Manage inbound interest and respond to creator questions about gifting opportunities.
  • Track outreach activity, response rates, and pipeline status in the creator CRM/spreadsheet.
  • Support onboarding of newly sourced creators into the gifting workflow.
  • Help scale outreach quickly ahead of large gifting waves, launches, and campaign pushes.

PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • 0–2 years of experience in influencer marketing, social media, or community management (internships count).
  • Strong instinct for identifying creators who fit a brand's voice and audience.
  • Comfortable with high-volume, personalized outreach.
  • Organized and detail-oriented, comfortable tracking a large pipeline across spreadsheets/CRM.
  • Experience with a creator/affiliate platform (AspireIQ or similar).
  • Background in high-volume outreach or prospecting (sales, recruiting, or community roles).
  • Native fluency in TikTok and Instagram.
  • Clear, warm written communication.

WHAT WE OFFER 🌟

  • Competitive hourly or monthly contract compensation 💰
  • Fully remote, flexible work environment 🌍
  • Opportunity to work on high-impact performance creative for a fast-growing brand 🚀
  • Access to RYZE creative assets, tools, templates, and performance insights 🎨

raw.description:
About Abridge

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

The Role

We are looking for a Sales Engineer to join our rapidly growing team and play a vital role in driving sales by communicating a deep understanding of the technical requirements for enterprise health systems and how Abridge technology can be incorporated seamlessly. This individual will operate at the intersection of our Sales, Implementation, Partner Success, and Product Engineering to ensure security reviews are successful and customers are positioned for success. With a deep understanding of EMRs, and the technical landscape of the enterprise healthcare organizations that use them, you will respond to information security questionnaires and RFPs, highlight Abridge’s platform features in the Sales motion, and serve as a trusted resource for our Sales team. You will report to the Director of Sales Engineering.

Our ideal candidate possesses deep technical knowledge, easily builds strong relationships, and prioritizes learning and maintaining trust, taking a consultative approach to our clients and stakeholders. We move quickly and thoughtfully, with a great deal of respect for team members who are results-oriented and who can thrive in a dynamic environment. As a Sales Engineer, we’re looking for someone who is energized by the opportunity to contribute to Abridge’s growth and can thrive in a cross-functional role.

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as the technical resource for the Sales team

  • Respond to RFPs and questionnaires to explain Abridge’s posture and accelerate the sales process

  • Identify and present ideal solution designs for customers by understanding their needs and incorporating Abridge’s recommendations

  • Leverage technical expertise to build relationships and establish credibility with customer technical executives and stakeholders

  • Act in a pre-sales capacity as an expert on integration.

  • Deliver product and technical demonstrations of Abridge’s technology

  • Work cross-functionally with Product Management and Engineering teams to improve Abridge’s technology by providing insight into your experience with customers

  • Support the implementation and partner success processes as needed

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of experience as a sales engineer, solutions consultant, solutions architect, or similar role in a Healthcare SaaS and technology sales environment

  • Solid technical background with deep understanding of and/or hands on experience with multiple EHR systems, enterprise desktop and VDI environments, SSO, identity, APIs, and integration standards.

  • Ability to creatively explain and compellingly present complex concepts in an easy-to-understand manner, across all levels of an organization

  • Excitement to always be learning and growing

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Eagerness to answer questions and solve challenges

  • An innate ability to figure things out, regardless of how complex the problem may be

  • Ability to occasionally travel within the assigned territory to support sales objectives

Bonus Points if:

  • Experience with clinical dictation tools, voice agents, or computer use technology.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Compensation Range: $170K - $195K

Description

For over 50 years, Sago has been constantly perfecting the art and science of qualitative and quantitative data collection. Put simply, we provide answers to your questions through practices of partnership, quality, and service excellence, powered by a talented team with a genuine passion for research.

Our engineering team is growing, and we’re hiring an experienced senior full-stack software engineer to be a key technical contributor. The ideal candidate has 7+ years of full-time C# .NET experience, deep expertise building reliable cloud-based applications with ASP.NET Core, familiarity with domain-driven design and event-based architectures, and 3+ years of modern front-end development with React/Redux and a strong understanding of the JavaScript toolchain. TypeScript experience is preferred. We are looking for an engineer who has made AI a core part of how they build software, working in an AI-driven development workflow that multiplies their impact rather than simply using AI as a reference tool.

This is a remote position and can be based in the US or Canada.

Responsibilities Include:

· Work in a .Net environment developing containerized applications on AWS, using the latest versions of .Net and C#

· Drive development through an AI-driven engineering workflow, directing AI coding agents to plan, implement, test, and refactor code while owning the quality, design, and correctness of the result

· Contribute to a maintainable codebase building performant back-end solutions using framework best practices

· Build and maintain the front end of the application using React, delivering user-facing features while making pragmatic decisions about UX/UI concerns

· Integrate with an established engineering team on new and existing software products

· Gather and evaluate user requirements in collaboration with product managers and engineers

· Work with UI/UX designers and product managers to translate interface designs into responsive, accessible, high-quality implementations

· Work with internal and external stakeholders to meet and exceed client expectations

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

· Substantial, demonstrated experience incorporating AI into the core of your engineering workflow, going well beyond using AI to answer questions or autocomplete code. You should be comfortable working in an AI-driven workflow: delegating multi-step tasks to agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot agent mode, OpenAI Codex), providing effective context and specifications, and iterating with AI agents across planning, implementation, testing, and code review

· Proven ability to critically review, validate, and take ownership of AI-generated code, maintaining high standards for security, maintainability, and test coverage while delivering significantly increased productivity

  • 7+ years C# .NET development experience (or equivalent), including ASP.NET Core, EF Core, and related frameworks and libraries

· 3+ years React/Redux (or comparable) experience, with proficiency in both class and functional components, Reselect, and HOC patterns

· Expert knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, SASS, and ES6; TypeScript experience preferred

· Proficiency with the SPA toolchain (Webpack, Babel, ESLint, Prettier, etc.) and CLI tools (git, npm, bash scripts, etc.)

· Experience building real-time, event-driven user interfaces using WebSockets or Server-Sent Events (SSE)

· Ability to own features end to end, from database and API through to the user interface

  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming
  • Experience building eventually-consistent, message-based, distributed systems
  • Experience using domain-driven design and/or CQRS/ES to solve real-world problems
  • Skill for writing reusable libraries
  • Proficient with SQL (preferably PostgreSQL), Document databases, and caching systems (e.g. Redis)
  • Experience running and maintaining applications in major cloud platforms, AWS a plus
  • Understanding of OpenIdConnect and OAuth2 a plus

· Strong communication and interpersonal skills, and a track record of successful remote work

If you are a smart, innovative, top performer, we want you! Join a team of talented, high-energy professionals focused on taking the company to the next level. You’ll never be bored in this fast-paced environment.

Sago is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment, and proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or disability.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Build backend services and APIs for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX, KYC and risk flows.

  • Design reliable systems that can support real customer transactions, operational workflows and future financial products.

  • Integrate with internal systems, financial partners, payment providers, AI services and third-party platforms.

  • Own backend quality across reliability, security, latency, observability, data integrity and incident handling.

  • Work with product, frontend, mobile and AI teams to launch features quickly and safely.

  • Improve existing systems by simplifying flows, removing manual work and automating repeatable processes.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong backend engineering experience in production systems.

  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, queues, jobs, events and integrations.

  • Experience building services used by real customers or internal operations at meaningful scale.

  • Strong debugging, reliability, security and data quality mindset.

  • Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, correctness, scalability and maintainability.

  • Fintech, payments, banking, wallet, KYC, fraud or risk experience is a strong plus, but not required if fundamentals are strong.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.

  • People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk.

  • Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.

  • Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems.

  • People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership.


The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Singapore. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Singapore.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
