raw.title: Strategic Account Executive
raw.excerpt: About Enlighten At Enlighten, we believe AI should expand what people can take on.
raw.description:
About Enlighten

At Enlighten, we believe AI should expand what people can take on. We build teams of AI agents alongside Fortune 500 companies so they can put their best thinking to work across the business. We want the people closest to the work to be able to ask hard questions and get answers they can trust. Our mission is to give every team the intelligence it needs to make decisions that shape the business.

About the role

You’ll own account strategy and executive relationships for some of Enlighten’s most complex enterprise opportunities. You’ll find where Enlighten can help and guide senior sponsors and their teams through evaluation and purchase.

What you'll do

  • Develop strategic opportunities through your own research, prospecting, and SDR collaboration. Build account plans around the customer’s priorities, current initiatives, and how decisions get made.
  • Build relationships with executive sponsors and the teams that influence the decision. Make the case for Enlighten in terms of the decisions and measurement questions the customer wants to improve.
  • Agree on a plan with the buying group that names owners, dependencies, open questions, and decision dates. Surface risks to scope, timing, or sponsorship early and ground commercial discussions in what you’ve validated.
  • Own technical discovery and validation across the account, including data, workflows, integrations, security, and measurement. Bring in executives or delivery leaders for specific expertise.
  • Build and run tailored live demos and proofs of concept yourself with agents. Prototype during or after discovery when it answers a buyer’s question, and document what you demonstrated, assumed, or still need to test.
  • Run multiple AI agents in parallel every day to research industries, prepare executive briefs, and check proposals. Build small tools to track relationships, decision risks, and agreed actions, and review the work before sharing it.

What you bring

  • A strong record leading complex enterprise AI, data platforms, analytics, or measurement sales cycles with senior sponsors and formal evaluation or procurement steps, plus an active enterprise buyer network relevant to Enlighten's work.
  • Strong account strategy skills and the patience to earn alignment across a buying group rather than relying on one enthusiastic contact.
  • Executive presence that is direct, prepared, and credible without overstating the product or the likely outcome.
  • Hands-on AI fluency. You use multiple agents to run parallel research, drafting, and checking work, then apply human judgment before acting.
  • Demonstrated ability to personally build a credible live demo and proof of concept with AI agents, then validate the technical claims it supports.
  • The ability to create small custom apps or workflows with agent assistance to improve account insight and operating discipline.
  • A self-directed working style. You see ambiguity, identify the most useful next move, and bring options rather than waiting for instructions.
  • Experience collaborating with delivery teams while protecting their time and bringing them into the right conversations.
  • Experience with strategic accounts in a complex or regulated industry, and a record of building executive relationships across a long buying process.
  • You work independently. You can take an unclear goal, decide what to do first, find what you need, and carry the work through to a result. You bring people in early when a decision, risk, or dependency needs their input.

How we work

AI agents are core to how we get work done. You'll spend a substantial part of your day running multiple agents in parallel, building tools and workflows with them, and checking what they produce. You own the result. Verify the facts, calculations, code, and claims before they go into a decision, a customer conversation, or a release.

What success looks like

  • Strategic accounts have a clear hypothesis, stakeholder map, decision path, and next action.
  • Senior buyers see Enlighten as prepared, candid, and useful throughout a complex evaluation.
  • Internal experts are coordinated around real buyer needs and arrive with the context required to contribute.
  • Agent-assisted account work is accurate, reviewed, and visibly improves speed and quality.

Compensation

Annual base salary is $155,000 to $185,000 USD. Target total cash compensation is $310,000 to $370,000 USD per year, including base salary and target incentive compensation.

Benefits

Eligible employees can enroll in medical, dental, and vision coverage.

The Paid Media Analyst translates raw campaign data across social, display, and video channels into actionable intelligence that drives strategy, improves efficiency, and demonstrates enrollment impact.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

The Digital Media Analyst is a core member of the Strayer in-house digital media team. This position is responsible for the design, development, and communication of paid media analytics that provide insight into the company's marketing performance across all in-house digital channels. This individual will regularly collaborate with the Digital Media Buyer, Media Strategy team, and the broader Marketing Analytics team to deliver end-to-end paid media analytics that meet and exceed requirements from internal clients. This role manages multiple priorities efficiently and independently, while facilitating knowledge transfer and self-service reporting. A natural curiosity for using data to understand paid media performance is very helpful in this position, as is a passion to collaborate with the team to continually improve reporting outputs and analytical processes.

1. Performance Reporting & Dashboards

  • Design, build, and maintain weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance dashboards across all in-house digital channels
  • Track and report on key KPIs including spend, impressions, clicks, leads, views, applications, and enrollments
  • Deliver standardized reporting packages to relevant stakeholders on a defined cadence; flag anomalies and pacing issues proactively
  • Support quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with analysis-ready data pulls, charts, and written commentary
  • Maintain a running pacing tracker updated no less than weekly across all active campaigns and budget lines

2. Campaign Analysis & Optimization Insights

  • Analyze campaign performance data to surface actionable insights on audience targeting, creative performance, placement mix, and bid strategy
  • Provide data-driven optimization recommendations; document and track the impact of changes made
  • Support A/B test design, execution tracking, and results analysis across all platforms; maintain a testing log with documented outcomes
  • Monitor creative fatigue and frequency metrics; generate creative performance reports to inform rotation decisions
  • Analyze cross-channel attribution and assist with media mix modeling inputs to help quantify incremental impact

3. Data Infrastructure & Tagging Integrity

  • Own the tracking taxonomy and ensure all campaigns are correctly tagged before launch; audit existing campaigns quarterly
  • Monitor platform pixels and conversion events across platforms; flag and escalate discrepancies to the tagging/analytics team
  • Maintain campaign naming conventions and trafficking documentation to ensure clean data downstream in BI tools and data warehouse
  • Serve as the internal QA checkpoint for campaign setup accuracy — verifying targeting, tracking, budgets, and creative assignments against the approved media plan
  • Pull and validate custom audience lists; ensure CRM/upload-based segments are refreshed on schedule

4. Cross-Team Collaboration & Self-Service

  • Collaborate with the Marketing Analytics Team to align paid media definitions, metrics, and data structures with the broader marketing data ecosystem
  • Develop and maintain self-service reporting documentation and SOPs so internal stakeholders can access and interpret campaign data independently
  • Support invoice reconciliation by producing spend-vs-plan reports and validating against media plan budgets
  • Contribute to knowledge-transfer documentation and maintain the team's analytics and process playbook

Job Skills

  • Demonstrated capability in analyzing paid media data to drive marketing strategy and support decision-making across paid social, display, and programmatic channels
  • Strong interpersonal skills — both verbal and written — with the ability to present complex data in an understandable and compelling manner
  • Demonstrated experience driving and achieving results through data-informed recommendations
  • Ability to work in a team setting while also being an assertive self-starter capable of managing multiple priorities independently
  • Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical skills with a natural curiosity for uncovering the story behind the numbers
  • Ability to present complex information in an understandable and compelling manner to non-technical stakeholders

Work Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant digital marketing analytics experience, preferably with direct exposure to paid media campaigns
  • Experience extracting and analyzing data from digital campaign management platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Google DV360, Google Ads, or DoubleClick/CM360
  • Knowledge and experience using analytical and data visualization tools, particularly Excel, Power BI, and/or Tableau
  • Experience with web reporting tools such as Adobe Analytics or Google Analytics, as well as SQL or similar query languages
  • Experience building and maintaining performance dashboards and recurring reporting packages for senior stakeholders

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in digital marketing, analytics, statistics, mathematics, business, or a web-relevant field

Other
